literature.headline_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期乙型肝炎病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 三分之二的病例有相关信息。对于乙型肝炎病毒,37.7%报告了当前的治疗或管理,而53.6%报告了转诊或正在进行评估;对于丙型肝炎病毒,这些比例分别为33.3%和54.7%。 [10.33321/cdi.2026.50.047]
该研究提供了特定时期内美国 乙型肝炎病毒 感染 患病率 和 发病率 的最新估计,但所提供的证据中没有详细说明具体的数字结果。 [10.3350/cmh.2026.0817]
结果表明,区域差距缩小,空间聚集性下降,东部和中部地区标准差椭圆向东南移动,发病率重心向东南移动351.25公里。 [10.1038/s41598-026-53490-8]
四个 (5%) 样本在两次 ID-NAT 检测中均无反应;所有捐献者的 HBV DNA 均得到证实,通常处于无法量化的水平,并且全部呈抗 HBc 阳性;没有发现一致的分子特征,但在 BCP、核心和 PreS1 中检测到异质的、病例特异性的 突变。 [10.1111/trf.70334]
病毒学应答率在第 3 个月达到 66%,第 6 个月达到 86%,第 1 年达到 89%,第 4-5 年达到 100%;10.2% 的患者出现部分病毒学缓解,并且与较高的基线 HBV-DNA 水平和第 24 周未能实现病毒学缓解显着相关。 [10.21203/rs.3.rs-9929523/v1]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Information was available for two-thirds of cases. For HBV, 37.7% reported current treatment or management, while 53.6% reported referral or assessment in progress; for HCV, these proportions were 33.3% and 54.7%. [10.33321/cdi.2026.50.047]

The study provided updated estimates of hepatitis B virus infection prevalence and incidence in the United States during the specified period, though specific numerical findings were not detailed in the supplied evidence. [10.3350/cmh.2026.0817]

A total of 102 patients were included (TAF n = 82; ETV n = 20), mean age 72 ± 10 years, 72% male; serum creatinine showed a non-significant increasing trend during TDF therapy (β = +0.008 mg/dL/year, p = 0.24) and after switching (β = +0.009 mg/dL/year, p = 0.07), with no significant difference between groups; serum phosphate declined during TDF in the ETV group (β = -0.175 mg/dL/year, p = 0.002) and showed a significant increase after switching (β = +0.111 mg/dL/year, p = 0.031) while the TAF group remained stable; total cholesterol showed a significant immediate increase at the time of switch (+18.3 mg/dL, 95% CI 11.0-25.6, p < 0.001), with no significant difference between TAF and ETV. [10.1007/s40121-026-01412-6]

Results showed narrowing regional disparities, declining spatial aggregation, and a standard deviation ellipse located in eastern and central regions with a southeastward shift, alongside the incidence gravity center moving 351.25 km southeast. [10.1038/s41598-026-53490-8]

Four (5%) samples were nonreactive by the two ID-NAT assays; HBV DNA was confirmed in all donors, often at unquantifiable levels, and all were anti-HBc positive; no consistent molecular signature was identified, but heterogeneous, case-specific mutations were detected in BCP, core, and PreS1. [10.1111/trf.70334]

news.headline_zh: 非洲CDC发布乙肝操作工具包,全球多国推进消除肝炎行动。
news.lead_zh: 非洲CDC推出基于WHO 2024指南的乙肝管理工具包,旨在改善非洲6400万慢性乙肝患者的诊断与治疗;同时,中国、孟加拉国、尼日利亚等国加强消除母婴传播和疫苗接种,而新型疗法与诊断技术取得突破。
key_findings_zh: 非洲CDC发布乙肝操作工具包,覆盖社区至医院五级护理,并配套移动应用,以应对仅6%诊断率和1.6%治疗率的严峻挑战 [news-632d4c14704c1528]。
中国北京启动乙肝消除健康运动,5岁以下儿童感染率降至0.30%,但仍有7500万慢性感染者,占全球三分之一 [news-a1912f67bec17f0e]。
孟加拉国圆桌会议指出,全国有1000万乙肝和丙肝患者,消除肝炎需社会参与,重点解决就业歧视和母婴传播问题 [news-8336271b1c8cab32]。
3期临床试验显示,反义寡核苷酸药物bepirovirsen使约20%慢性乙肝患者实现功能性治愈,低基线HBsAg者治愈率达26% [news-1e18e98cd33aa2ef]。
罗氏推出全自动cobas HDV检测,可标准化定量丁肝病毒RNA,惠及全球近1200万丁肝患者 [news-1cec996018e99148]。
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 尽管全球乙肝疫苗接种覆盖提升,但非洲和亚洲部分地区诊断与治疗缺口巨大,隐匿性感染和免疫抑制再激活风险持续存在,而新疗法和诊断工具为消除肝炎带来希望。
news.caveats_zh: 部分研究为回顾性或单中心设计,结论需进一步验证;临床试验结果尚需长期随访和更广泛人群评估。
news.headline_en: Africa CDC Releases Hepatitis B Toolkit as Global Efforts Intensify Toward Elimination.
news.lead_en: Africa CDC launched a WHO 2024-based operational toolkit to improve diagnosis and treatment for 64 million chronic hepatitis B patients in Africa. Meanwhile, China, Bangladesh, and Nigeria strengthened prevention of mother-to-child transmission and vaccination, while new therapies and diagnostics showed breakthroughs.
key_findings_en: Africa CDC released a hepatitis B toolkit covering five levels of care with a mobile app, addressing only 6% diagnosis and 1.6% treatment rates in Africa [news-632d4c14704c1528].
Beijing health campaign reported 0.30% HBV prevalence in children under five, but 75 million chronic infections remain, one-third of global cases [news-a1912f67bec17f0e].

Bangladesh roundtable highlighted 10 million living with hepatitis B and C, calling for social participation to tackle employment discrimination and mother-to-child transmission [news-8336271b1c8cab32].
Phase 3 trials showed bepirovirsen achieved functional cure in ~20% of chronic hepatitis B patients, with 26% cure in those with low baseline HBsAg [news-1e18e98cd33aa2ef].
Roche launched fully automated cobas HDV test for standardized HDV RNA quantification, benefiting nearly 12 million hepatitis D patients globally [news-1cec996018e99148].
news.trend_or_risk_en: Despite improved vaccination coverage, huge diagnosis and treatment gaps persist in Africa and parts of Asia, with ongoing risks from occult infection and immunosuppression reactivation, while new therapies and diagnostics offer hope for elimination.
news.caveats_en: Some studies are retrospective or single-center, requiring further validation; clinical trial results need long-term follow-up and broader population assessment.
news.brief_en: Africa CDC released a hepatitis B operational toolkit for healthcare workers, while China, Bangladesh, and Nigeria advanced elimination campaigns. Phase 3 bepirovirsen data showed 20% functional cure, and Roche launched an automated HDV test.

papers.title: Risk of Virological Failure After Switch to a Tenofovir‐Sparing Dual Therapy in Virologically Suppressed People With HIV and Past HBV Infection
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT We compared the effectiveness of tenofovir (TFV)‐based triple regimens (TT) to TFV‐sparing dual therapies (DT) in virologically suppressed, HBsAg−/HBcAb+ people living with HIV (PLWH). We emulated a target trial including adults PLWH from five University Hospitals, with HBsAg−/HBcAb+ serostatus, starting a TT with unsuppressed serum HIV‐RNA and reaching HIV‐RNA 50 cp/mL or a single HIV‐RNA ≥ 200 cp/mL) were estimated through a weighted Kaplan–Meier estimator. Overall, 415 PLWH were eligible for study analysis: 71 (17.1%) started a DT (3TC‐based: 78.9%) during follow‐up. They were mainly men (329, 79.3%), with a median age of 48 years. In the weighted analysis, the estimated probabilities of VF were: 29.3% for DT and 29.9% for TT at 5 years (difference: 0.5%; 95% CI: −28.7, +21.6). A higher VF risk was seen in the subset of PLWH with undetectable HBsAb at the longest follow‐up available (4 years), independently of treatment group: 15.5% and 36.8% with DT and TT, respectively (difference: −21.3%; 95% CI: −30.3, −13.8). Switch to a TFV‐sparing DT, compared with continuing a TT, was not associated with an increased risk of VF in PLWH and prior HBV infection.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study compared the effectiveness of tenofovir (TFV)-based triple regimens to TFV-sparing dual therapies in virologically suppressed people living with HIV who had past HBV infection (HBsAg−/HBcAb+).
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study emulated a target trial including 415 adults from five University Hospitals with HBsAg−/HBcAb+ serostatus who started a triple regimen with unsuppressed serum HIV-RNA and reached suppression. Participants were mainly men (329, 79.3%) with a median age of 48 years, and 71 (17.1%) started a dual therapy during follow-up.
analysis.methods: The probabilities of virological failure, defined as two consecutive HIV-RNA ≥ 50 cp/mL or a single HIV-RNA ≥ 200 cp/mL, were estimated through a weighted Kaplan–Meier estimator.
analysis.main_results: In the weighted analysis, the estimated probabilities of virological failure at 5 years were 29.3% for dual therapy and 29.9% for triple therapy (difference: 0.5%; 95% CI: −28.7, +21.6). A higher risk was seen in the subset with undetectable HBsAb at 4 years, with rates of 15.5% for dual therapy and 36.8% for triple therapy (difference: −21.3%; 95% CI: −30.3, −13.8).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that switching to a TFV-sparing dual therapy was not associated with an increased risk of virological failure compared with continuing a triple regimen in this population.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that TFV-sparing dual therapy may be a viable option for virologically suppressed people living with HIV and past HBV infection, particularly for those with detectable HBsAb.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate due to the observational emulation of a target trial, which may be subject to residual confounding despite weighted analysis.

analysis.summary_en: This study emulated a target trial to compare tenofovir-based triple regimens with tenofovir-sparing dual therapies in 415 virologically suppressed adults living with HIV and past HBV infection. Using a weighted Kaplan–Meier estimator, the analysis found no significant difference in the 5-year risk of virological failure between the two strategies (29.3% vs. 29.9%). However, a higher risk of failure was observed in the subset of participants with undetectable HBsAb at 4 years, regardless of treatment group. The authors conclude that switching to a dual therapy is not associated with increased virological failure risk, suggesting it may be a safe alternative for this patient population.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究比较了基于替诺福韦 (TFV) 的三联疗法与保留 TFV 的双重疗法对既往感染过 HBV(HBsAg−/HBcAb+)且病毒学受到抑制的 HIV 感染者的有效性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究模拟了一项目标试验,包括来自五家大学医院的 415 名 HBsAg−/HBcAb+ 血清状态成人,他们开始使用未抑制血清 HIV-RNA 的三联疗法并达到抑制效果。参与者主要为男性(329 名,79.3%),中位年龄为 48 岁,71 名(17.1%)在随访期间开始接受双重治疗。
elements_zh.methods: 病毒学失败的概率定义为两个连续的 HIV-RNA ≥ 50 cp/mL 或单个 HIV-RNA ≥ 200 cp/mL,通过加权 Kaplan-Meier 估计器进行估计。
elements_zh.main_results: 在加权分析中,双联疗法5年病毒学失败的估计概率为29.3%,三联疗法为29.9%(差异:0.5%;95% CI:-28.7,+21.6)。在 4 年时 HBsAb 检测不到的子集中,双联治疗的发生率为 15.5%,三联治疗的发生率为 36.8%(差异:-21.3%;95% CI:-30.3,-13.8)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,在该人群中,与继续三联疗法相比,改用保留 TFV 的双重疗法与病毒学失败的风险增加无关。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,对于病毒学受到抑制的 HIV 感染者和既往 HBV 感染者,尤其是可检测到 HBsAb 的患者,保留 TFV 的双重疗法可能是一种可行的选择。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于目标试验的观察模拟,证据强度中等,尽管进行了加权分析,但可能会受到残留混杂因素的影响。

papers.title: Correlates of hepatitis B virus awareness and disease specific knowledge in Uganda: a meta-analysis and meta-regression of studies published between 2018 and 2025
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains a major public health challenge in Uganda, where prevalence varies by region and population group despite national vaccination and screening initiatives. Understanding awareness and knowledge levels is essential for guiding HBV prevention and control strategies. This study synthesized available evidence on the correlates of HBV awareness and disease specific knowledge among different Ugandan populations. METHODS: We systematically searched PubMed, African Journals Online (AJOL), and Google Scholar for cross-sectional studies reporting on HBV awareness or disease-specific knowledge in Uganda, published between January 2018 and December 2025. Study selection, data extraction, and quality appraisal were conducted independently by two reviewers using the Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) Critical Appraisal Checklist for Analytical Cross-Sectional Studies. Eighteen studies meeting the eligibility criteria were included in the final synthesis. Pooled estimates of HBV awareness and correlates of disease-specific knowledge were computed using a random-effects model in MedCalc software (version 10.10), with heterogeneity quantified using the I2 statistic. Sources of heterogeneity were explored through subgroup analysis and sensitivity analysis. Meta-regression was performed to examine trends in HBV awareness by region, year of publication, and study population. Publication bias was assessed using Begg's and Egger's tests. Statistical significance was set at p < 0.05, and all estimates are reported with 95% confidence intervals. RESULTS: Eighteen studies met the inclusion criteria. The pooled prevalence of HBV awareness was 75.3% (95% CI: 61.5%-86.9%), with substantial heterogeneity observed across regions and population groups (I2=99.24%). Subgroup analysis revealed that awareness was significantly higher in Central Uganda compared to the northern, eastern, and western regions (p < 0.05), and among healthcare workers compared to the general population and antenatal care attendees (p < 0.05). Knowledge of specific HBV domains varied considerably: awareness of the causative agent, screening services, and vaccination availability was significantly higher among knowledgeable participants compared to those with no prior HBV knowledge (p < 0.05), whereas awareness of post-exposure prophylaxis and completion of the full HBV vaccination schedule remained low compared to those who had received at least partial vaccination (p < 0.05). Awareness of key transmission routes including sexual contact, needle sharing, and mother-to-child transmission was moderate, though knowledge of transmission through infected body fluids remained poor. Participants who were of higher education level were more likely to take up vaccination compared to lower education level (p < 0.05), and participants with a positive attitude toward vaccine effectiveness were significantly more likely to be vaccinated compared to those with a negative attitude (p < 0.05). The meta-regression analysis further revealed a paradoxical overall decline in HBV awareness over the study period. CONCLUSION: Critical gaps still persist in HBV awareness and key knowledge areas highlighting the need for alternative strategies tailored to the social dynamics of the current generation during the delivery of health messages. papers.title_zh: 乌干达 乙型肝炎病毒 意识与疾病特定知识的相关性:对 2018 年至 2025 年发表的研究进行荟萃分析和荟萃回归
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains a major public health challenge in Uganda, where prevalence varies by region and population group despite national vaccination and screening initiatives. Understanding awareness and knowledge levels is essential for guiding HBV prevention and control strategies. This study synthesized available evidence on the correlates of HBV awareness and disease specific knowledge among different Ugandan populations. METHODS: We systematically searched PubMed, African Journals Online (AJOL), and Google Scholar for cross-sectional studies reporting on HBV awareness or disease-specific knowledge in Uganda, published between January 2018 and December 2025. Study selection, data extraction, and quality appraisal were conducted independently by two reviewers using the Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) Critical Appraisal Checklist for Analytical Cross-Sectional Studies. Eighteen studies meeting the eligibility criteria were included in the final synthesis. Pooled estimates of HBV awareness and correlates of disease-specific knowledge were computed using a random-effects model in MedCalc software (version 10.10), with heterogeneity quantified using the I2 statistic. Sources of heterogeneity were explored through subgroup analysis and sensitivity analysis. Meta-regression was performed to examine trends in HBV awareness by region, year of publication, and study population. Publication bias was assessed using Begg's and Egger's tests. Statistical significance was set at p < 0.05, and all estimates are reported with 95% confidence intervals. RESULTS: Eighteen studies met the inclusion criteria. The pooled prevalence of HBV awareness was 75.3% (95% CI: 61.5%-86.9%), with substantial heterogeneity observed across regions and population groups (I2=99.24%). Subgroup analysis revealed that awareness was significantly higher in Central Uganda compared to the northern, eastern, and western regions (p < 0.05), and among healthcare workers compared to the general population and antenatal care attendees (p < 0.05). Knowledge of specific HBV domains varied considerably: awareness of the causative agent, screening services, and vaccination availability was significantly higher among knowledgeable participants compared to those with no prior HBV knowledge (p < 0.05), whereas awareness of post-exposure prophylaxis and completion of the full HBV vaccination schedule remained low compared to those who had received at least partial vaccination (p < 0.05). Awareness of key transmission routes including sexual contact, needle sharing, and mother-to-child transmission was moderate, though knowledge of transmission through infected body fluids remained poor. Participants who were of higher education level were more likely to take up vaccination compared to lower education level (p < 0.05), and participants with a positive attitude toward vaccine effectiveness were significantly more likely to be vaccinated compared to those with a negative attitude (p < 0.05). The meta-regression analysis further revealed a paradoxical overall decline in HBV awareness over the study period. CONCLUSION: Critical gaps still persist in HBV awareness and key knowledge areas highlighting the need for alternative strategies tailored to the social dynamics of the current generation during the delivery of health messages. CLINICAL TRIAL NUMBER: Not applicable.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 仍然是乌干达的一个主要公共卫生挑战,尽管有国家 疫苗接种 和筛查举措,但 患病率 因地区和人群而异。了解意识和知识水平对于指导乙肝预防和控制策略至关重要。这项研究综合了乌干达不同人群对乙肝病毒的认识和疾病具体知识之间的相关性的现有证据。方法:我们系统地检索了 PubMed、非洲期刊在线 (AJOL) 和 Google Scholar,查找 2018 年 1 月至 2025 年 12 月期间发表的关于乌干达 HBV 认知或特定疾病知识的横断面研究。研究选择、数据提取和质量评估由两名评审员使用 Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) 分析横断面研究批判评估清单独立进行。最终综合报告中纳入了十八项符合资格标准的研究。使用 MedCalc 软件(版本 10.10)中的随机效应模型计算 HBV 认知度和特定疾病知识相关性的汇总估计,并使用 I2 统计量量化异质性。通过亚组分析和敏感性分析探讨异质性的来源。进行元回归以检查按地区、出版年份和研究人群划分的 HBV 认知趋势。使用 Begg 和 Egger 测试评估发表偏倚。统计显着性设置为 p < 0.05,所有估计值均以 95% 置信区间报告。结果:十八项研究符合纳入标准。汇总的 患病率 乙肝病毒知晓率为 75.3%(95% CI:61.5%-86.9%),不同地区和人群之间存在显着异质性(I2=99.24%)。亚组分析显示,与北部、东部和西部地区相比,乌干达中部地区的知晓率显着较高(p < 0.05),与一般人群和产前护理人员相比,医护人员的知晓率显着较高(p < 0.05)。对特定 HBV 领域的了解差异很大:与先前没有 HBV 知识的参与者相比,知识丰富的参与者对病原体、筛查服务和 疫苗接种 可用性的认识显着较高 (p < 0.05),而与至少接受部分 疫苗接种 的参与者相比,对暴露后预防和完成完整 HBV 疫苗接种 时间表的认识仍然较低 (p < 0.05)。对主要 传播 途径(包括性接触、共用针头和母婴 传播)的了解程度中等,但通过感染体液对 传播 的了解仍然很少。与教育水平较低的参与者相比,教育水平较高的参与者更有可能接种 疫苗接种 (p < 0.05),而对 疫苗 有效性持积极态度的参与者比持消极态度的参与者更有可能接种疫苗 (p < 0.05)。荟萃回归分析进一步揭示了研究期间乙肝病毒认知度整体下降的矛盾现象。结论:对乙肝病毒的认识和关键知识领域仍然存在严重差距,这突出表明在传播健康信息时需要针对当代社会动态制定替代策略。临床试验编号:不适用。

papers.title: Enhanced surveillance for hepatitis B and C: insights into clinical care after diagnosis
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: There are known gaps in care uptake for hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection, and public health surveillance represents an opportunity to support health service engagement for cases; however, specific data are lacking regarding follow-up after diagnosis. We assessed outcomes of a Victorian initiative to enhance data availability and to support linkage to care. METHODS: Notified cases of HBV and HCV within Victoria during 2023-2024 were analysed to determine post-diagnosis follow-up, including variation by demographics and setting, and reported reasons for lack of linkage to care. RESULTS: Information was available for two-thirds of cases. For HBV, 37.7% reported current treatment or management, while 53.6% reported referral or assessment in progress; for HCV, these proportions were 33.3% and 54.7%. Reasons for gaps included loss to follow-up, cost barriers, and misapplication of HBV treatment criteria. DISCUSSION: Cascade of care information can be effectively collected via public health surveillance, and these systems represent an opportunity to support prioritisation of public health follow-up.

We assessed outcomes of a Victorian initiative to enhance data availability and to support linkage to care. Methods Notified cases of HBV and HCV within Victoria during 2023-2024 were analysed to determine post-diagnosis follow-up, including variation by demographics and setting, and reported reasons for lack of linkage to care. Results Information was available for two-thirds of cases. For HBV, 37.7% reported current treatment or management, while 53.6% reported referral or assessment in progress; for HCV, these proportions were 33.3% and 54.7%. Reasons for gaps included loss to follow-up, cost barriers, and misapplication of HBV treatment criteria. Discussion Cascade of care information can be effectively collected via public health surveillance, and these systems represent an opportunity to support prioritisation of public health follow-up.

analysis.summary_en: This study assessed a Victorian initiative from 2023 to 2024 aimed at enhancing data availability and supporting linkage to care for notified hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) cases. Analysis of post-diagnosis follow-up revealed that information was available for two-thirds of cases. For HBV, 37.7% reported current treatment or management and 53.6% reported referral or assessment in progress, while for HCV, these proportions were 33.3% and 54.7% respectively. Reasons for gaps in care included loss to follow-up, cost barriers, and misapplication of HBV treatment criteria. The authors conclude that cascade of care information can be effectively collected via public health surveillance, offering an opportunity to support the prioritisation of public health follow-up.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对 2023 年至 2024 年期间维多利亚州报告的 HBV 和 HCV 病例进行了分析,以确定 诊断 后的随访情况,包括人口统计和环境的变化。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究通过分析通知病例和报告的缺乏护理联系的原因,评估了维多利亚州一项旨在提高数据可用性和支持护理联系的举措的成果。
elements_zh.main_results: 三分之二的病例有相关信息。对于乙型肝炎病毒,37.7%报告了当前的治疗或管理,而53.6%报告了转诊或正在进行评估;对于丙型肝炎病毒,这些比例分别为33.3%和54.7%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 可以通过公共卫生 监测 有效收集级联护理信息,这些系统为支持公共卫生后续行动的优先顺序提供了机会。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,增强的 监测 系统可用于支持公共卫生随访的优先顺序,并改善与病毒性肝炎病例护理的联系。

papers.title: Hepatitis B virus infection with high HBsAg and undetectable DNA levels in untreated blood donors: Viral mechanisms and transfusion safety implications
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Blood donor screening occasionally identifies individuals with high HBV surface antigen (HBsAg) levels despite undetectable or extremely low HBV DNA. Molecular basis and transfusion risk of this discordant profile remain unclear. STUDY DESIGN AND METHODS: Seventy-five blood donors with HBsAg >100 IU/mL and undetectable or very low HBV DNA (<6 IU/mL), including 39 ID-NAT-nonreactive, were investigated. HBV DNA was further assessed using a second ID-NAT assay, confirmatory PCR following virion concentration, and sequencing. Sequences were compared with those from genotype-matched high-viremia controls. Selected basic core promoter (BCP) and core mutations were introduced into 1.18-mer replication-competent Hepatitis B virus (HBV) plasmids to assess effects on extracellular virion-associated DNA production. RESULTS: Four (5%) samples were nonreactive by the two ID-NAT assays. HBV DNA was confirmed in all donors, often at unquantifiable levels, and all were anti-HBc positive. No consistent molecular signature was identified. Heterogeneous, case-specific mutations were detected in BCP, core, and PreS1, including variants predicted to affect pregenomic RNA transcription, encapsidation, or virion assembly, with no evidence of impaired polymerase activity. In vitro, selected BCP mutations significantly reduced extracellular HBV DNA without affecting HBsAg production. Most core mutations had minimal impact, although two strains carrying cN92T/cM93T or cS170F showed reduced virion-associated DNA. Some constructs exhibited impaired virion secretion or increased naked capsid production. CONCLUSION: HBsAg-positive/low-DNA profile largely reflects chronic inactive infection with minimal viremia. Diverse regulatory and structural mutations may contribute in a multifactorial manner. Persistent viral genomes and residual replication support continued HBsAg screening where NAT sensitivity is suboptimal and anti-HBc testing cannot be implemented.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Blood donor screening occasionally identifies individuals with high HBV surface antigen (HBsAg) levels despite undetectable or extremely low HBV DNA, but the molecular basis and transfusion risk of this discordant profile remain unclear.
analysis.study_design_and_population: Seventy-five blood donors with HBsAg >100 IU/mL and undetectable or very low HBV DNA (<6 IU/mL), including 39 ID-NAT-nonreactive, were investigated.
analysis.methods: HBV DNA was further assessed using a second ID-NAT assay, confirmatory PCR following virion concentration, and sequencing; selected basic core promoter (BCP) and core mutations were introduced into replication-competent HBV plasmids to assess effects on extracellular virion-associated DNA production.
analysis.main_results: Four (5%) samples were nonreactive by the two ID-NAT assays; HBV DNA was confirmed in all donors, often at unquantifiable levels, and all were anti-HBc positive; no consistent molecular signature was identified, but heterogeneous, case-specific mutations were detected in BCP, core, and PreS1.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The HBsAg-positive/low-DNA profile largely reflects chronic inactive infection with minimal viremia, and diverse regulatory and structural mutations may contribute in a multifactorial manner.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Persistent viral genomes and residual replication support continued HBsAg screening where NAT sensitivity is suboptimal and anti-HBc testing cannot be implemented.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate, as the study identified no consistent molecular signature and relied on in vitro assays to confirm mutation effects, though the sample size was adequate for the observed findings.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated 75 blood donors with high HBsAg (>100 IU/mL) and undetectable or very low HBV DNA (<6 IU/mL), including 39 ID-NAT-nonreactive cases. HBV DNA was confirmed in all donors, often at unquantifiable levels, with all testing anti-HBc positive. No consistent molecular signature was identified, but heterogeneous mutations in BCP, core, and PreS1 regions were detected. In vitro experiments showed that selected BCP mutations reduced extracellular HBV DNA without affecting HBsAg production, while some core mutations impaired virion secretion. The authors concluded that this discordant profile reflects chronic inactive infection with minimal viremia, driven by diverse regulatory and structural mutations. The findings support continued HBsAg screening in settings with suboptimal NAT sensitivity and limited anti-HBc testing.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 献血者筛查有时会发现乙肝表面抗原 (HBsAg) 水平较高的个体,尽管乙肝病毒 DNA 无法检测到或极低,但这种不一致特征的分子基础和输血风险仍不清楚。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对 75 名 HBsAg >100 IU/mL 且 HBV DNA 检测不到或极低 (<6 IU/mL) 的献血者进行了调查,其中包括 39 名 ID-NAT 无反应的献血者。
elements_zh.methods: 使用第二次 ID-NAT 测定、病毒粒子浓缩后的验证性 PCR 和测序进一步评估 HBV DNA;将选定的基本核心启动子 (BCP) 和核心 突变 引入具有复制能力的 HBV 质粒中,以评估对细胞外病毒粒子相关 DNA 产生的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 四个 (5%) 样本在两次 ID-NAT 检测中均无反应;所有捐献者的 HBV DNA 均得到证实,通常处于无法量化的水平,并且全部呈抗 HBc 阳性;没有发现一致的分子特征,但在 BCP、核心和 PreS1 中检测到异质的、病例特异性的 突变。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: HBsAg 阳性/低 DNA 谱在很大程度上反映了具有最小病毒血症的慢性非活动性感染,并且不同的调节和结构 突变 可能以多因素的方式起作用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 持续性病毒 基因组 和残留复制支持持续的 HBsAg 筛查,其中 NAT 敏感性次优且无法实施抗 HBc 检测。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,因为该研究没有发现一致的分子特征,并依赖体外测定来确认 突变 效应,尽管样本量足以满足观察到的结果。

papers.title_zh: 未经治疗的献血者中出现高 HBsAg 和检测不到 DNA 水平的 乙型肝炎病毒 感染:病毒机制和输血安全影响
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Blood donor screening occasionally identifies individuals with high HBV surface antigen (HBsAg) levels despite undetectable or extremely low HBV DNA. Molecular basis and transfusion risk of this discordant profile remain unclear. STUDY DESIGN AND METHODS: Seventy-five blood donors with HBsAg >100 IU/mL and undetectable or very low HBV DNA (<6 IU/mL), including 39 ID-NAT-nonreactive, were investigated. HBV DNA was further assessed using a second ID-NAT assay, confirmatory PCR following virion concentration, and sequencing. Sequences were compared with those from genotype-matched high-viremia controls. Selected basic core promoter (BCP) and core mutations were introduced into 1.18-mer replication-competent Hepatitis B virus (HBV) plasmids to assess effects on extracellular virion-associated DNA production. RESULTS: Four (5%) samples were nonreactive by the two ID-NAT assays. HBV DNA was confirmed in all donors, often at unquantifiable levels, and all were anti-HBc positive. No consistent molecular signature was identified. Heterogeneous, case-specific mutations were detected in BCP, core, and PreS1, including variants predicted to affect pregenomic RNA transcription, encapsidation, or virion assembly, with no evidence of impaired polymerase activity. In vitro, selected BCP mutations significantly reduced extracellular HBV DNA without affecting HBsAg production. Most core mutations had minimal impact, although two strains carrying cN92T/cM93T or cS170F showed reduced virion-associated DNA. Some constructs exhibited impaired virion secretion or increased naked capsid production. CONCLUSION: HBsAg-positive/low-DNA profile largely reflects chronic inactive infection with minimal viremia. Diverse regulatory and structural mutations may contribute in a multifactorial manner. Persistent viral genomes and residual replication support continued HBsAg screening where NAT sensitivity is suboptimal and anti-HBc testing cannot be implemented.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:尽管 HBV DNA 检测不到或极低,但献血者筛查偶尔会发现 HBV 表面抗原 (HBsAg) 水平较高的个体。这种不一致特征的分子基础和输血风险仍不清楚。研究设计和方法:对 75 名 HBsAg >100 IU/mL 且 HBV DNA 检测不到或极低 (<6 IU/mL) 的献血者进行了调查,其中包括 39 名 ID-NAT 无反应性的献血者。使用第二次 ID-NAT 测定、病毒粒子浓缩后的验证性 PCR 和测序进一步评估 HBV DNA。将序列与基因型匹配的高病毒血症对照的序列进行比较。将选定的基本核心启动子 (BCP) 和核心 突变 引入具有复制能力的 1.18 聚体 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 质粒中,以评估对细胞外病毒粒子相关 DNA 产生的影响。结果:两个 ID-NAT 检测中有四个 (5%) 样品没有反应。所有捐献者的 HBV DNA 均得到证实,通常处于无法量化的水平,并且全部呈抗 HBc 阳性。没有发现一致的分子特征。在 BCP、核心和 PreS1 中检测到异质的、病例特异性的 突变,包括预测会影响前基因组 RNA 转录、衣壳化或病毒颗粒组装的变体,没有证据表明聚合酶活性受损。在体外,选定的 BCP 突变 显着减少细胞外 HBV DNA,而不影响 HBsAg 的产生。尽管携带 cN92T/cM93T 或 cS170F 的两种菌株显示病毒体相关 DNA 减少,但大多数核心 突变 的影响很小。一些构建体表现出病毒颗粒分泌受损或裸衣壳产量增加。结论:HBsAg 阳性/低 DNA 谱很大程度上反映了慢性非活动性感染,病毒血症极少。多样化的监管和结构 突变 可能以多因素的方式做出贡献。持续性病毒 基因组 和残留复制支持持续的 HBsAg 筛查,其中 NAT 敏感性次优且无法实施抗 HBc 检测。

papers.title: Structural barriers drive the intention-action gap in hepatitis B prevention among migrants in Shandong Province, China: a triangulated study of serological, spatial, and behavioral data.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major public health challenge in China. Migrant workers constitute a highly vulnerable population due to high geographic mobility and occupational vulnerability. Despite public health education efforts, a notable intention-action gap disrupts the HBV care cascade. This study integrates serological, spatial, and behavioral data to investigate whether this gap is primarily driven by cognitive deficits or interrupted by underlying structural barriers. METHODS: A triangulated cross-sectional study was conducted in Yantai, China, involving structured questionnaire surveys (N = 1,184) and serological testing (N = 2,364). The spatial distribution of regional anti-HBs positive rates was mapped using Geographic Information Systems (GIS). An adapted Health Belief Model was tested using Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) with a Robust Maximum Likelihood estimator to evaluate the disruptive effects of objective structural constraints-specifically, time poverty, economic constraints, and systemic lack of medical insurance. RESULTS: The serologically confirmed anti-HBs positive rate was 51.10% (1,208/2,364), substantially lower than the 70% threshold recommended by the World Health Organization. Spatial analysis revealed significant geographic heterogeneity (χ2 = 74.38, P < 0.001), with higher immunity concentrated in large-scale industrial belts (67.33%) and lower immunity clustered in dispersed service-sector districts (36.81%). SEM results indicated that while external cues strongly predicted HBV knowledge (β = 0.894), knowledge had only a marginal effect on preventive intention (β = 0.192). Preventive intention significantly predicted actual behavior (β = 0.655). However, this motivational process was severely undermined by structural barriers, predominantly time poverty (β = -0.563, P < 0.001), followed by economic constraints (β = -0.278, P < 0.001) and lack of medical insurance (β = -0.056, P = 0.030). CONCLUSIONS: The intention-action gap in HBV prevention among migrant workers is primarily driven by socioeconomic structural barriers-most notably time poverty-while basic HBV knowledge remains a foundational but insufficient condition for preventive action. Achieving the goal of viral hepatitis elimination requires a shift from individual cognitive persuasion to structural interventions, emphasizing workplace-based service delivery, spatially targeted resource allocation, and insurance reforms to alleviate out-of-pocket and opportunity costs.

papers.title: Impact of Switching from Tenofovir Disoproxil Fumarate to Tenofovir Alafenamide or Entecavir in Older Patients with Chronic Hepatitis B
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF) is highly effective for chronic hepatitis B (CHB) but may induce progressive renal impairment and proximal tubular dysfunction. Switching to tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) or entecavir (ETV) may reduce TDF-related nephrotoxicity. This study evaluated renal and metabolic changes before and after switching from TDF to TAF or ETV in a real-world cohort of older patients. METHODS: This retrospective longitudinal cohort study included adults with CHB who switched from TDF to TAF or ETV at a tertiary center (2012-2023). Eligible patients had ≥ 2 years of TDF treatment and ≥ 2 years of post-switch follow-up. Those with virological failure, major coinfections, or non-HBV-related kidney disease were excluded. Clinical and laboratory data were collected at 6-month intervals from 2 years before to 4 years after switching. analysis.summary_en: This retrospective cohort study evaluated renal and metabolic changes in 102 older patients with chronic hepatitis B who switched from tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF) to tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) or entecavir (ETV). Despite previous studies suggesting creatinine improvement after switching, this cohort showed no significant reduction in creatinine levels, though an attenuation of progression and phosphate recovery were observed. Serum phosphate declined during TDF in the ETV group but increased after switching, while total cholesterol showed an immediate increase at the time of switch. papers.title_zh: 老年 慢性乙型肝炎 患者从富马酸替诺福韦二吡呋酯转换为替诺福韦艾拉酚胺或恩替卡韦的影响
papers.source_body_en: INTRODUCTION: Tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF) is highly effective for chronic hepatitis B (CHB) but may induce progressive renal impairment and proximal tubular dysfunction. Switching to tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) or entecavir (ETV) may reduce TDF-related nephrotoxicity. This study evaluated renal and metabolic changes before and after switching from TDF to TAF or ETV in a real-world cohort of older patients. METHODS: This retrospective longitudinal cohort study included adults with CHB who switched from TDF to TAF or ETV at a tertiary center (2012-2023). Eligible patients had ≥ 2 years of TDF treatment and ≥ 2 years of post-switch follow-up. Those with virological failure, major coinfections, or non-HBV-related kidney disease were excluded. Clinical and laboratory data were collected at 6-month intervals from 2 years before to 4 years after switching. Biomarker trajectories were analyzed using linear mixed-effects models with time centered at switch comparing treatments and with multivariable adjustment for key confounders. RESULTS: A total of 102 patients were included (TAF n = 82; ETV n = 20), mean age 72 ± 10 years, 72% male. All patients had undetectable HBV-DNA at switch. During TDF therapy, serum creatinine showed a non-significant increasing trend (β = + 0.008 mg/dL/year, p = 0.24), which persisted after switching (β = + 0.009 mg/dL/year, p = 0.07), with no significant difference between groups. Serum phosphate declined during TDF in the ETV group (β = - 0.175 mg/dL/year, p = 0.002) and showed a significant increase after switching (β = + 0.111 mg/dL/year, p = 0.031) while the TAF group remained stable throughout. Total cholesterol ishowed a significant immediate increase at the time of switch (+ 18.3 mg/dL, 95% CI 11.0-25.6, p < 0.001), with no significant difference between TAF and ETV. CONCLUSIONS: Unlike previous studies reporting clear creatinine improvement after switching from TDF, this cohort did not show a statistically significant reduction in creatinine levels after the switch although an attenuation of creatinine progression and recovery of phosphate levels were observed, suggesting mitigation of TDF-related renal and tubular toxicity.

papers.title: Factors Associated With Surface Antigen (HBsAg) Clearance in a Spanish Cohort of Chronic Hepatitis B Patients: Influence on the Long‐Term Prognosis
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The objective is to identify factors that contribute to hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) clearance in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) infection in an unselected, long‐term follow‐up hepatitis B open cohort in southern Spain. A prospective open cohort study of 453 patients with CHB infection was recruited in the Liver Unit of the Internal Department of two hospitals in Málaga (Spain) between 1991 and 2022 to assess the incidence of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) clearance during follow‐up, identify factors related to it, and determine the influence that clearance had on the long‐term prognosis. The duration of follow‐up ranged from 0.5 to 36.08 years. A multivariate Cox regression analysis was conducted to identify factors associated with HBsAg clearance. The impact of clearance on long‐term prognosis was evaluated using a combined prognostic end point: need for liver transplantation, liver complications, or liver‐related mortality. The construction of time‐to‐event curves was achieved by employing the Kaplan‐Meir method, with subsequent comparison of event occurrence between groups conducted via log‐rank test. During the subsequent follow‐up period, 96/453 patients (21.2%) lost surface antigen (1.96/100 patients per year). Multivariate Cox regression analysis identified as independent factors associated with HBsAg clearance: age at first assessment over 40 years: HR 2.21 (1.38–3.52); a baseline DNA HBV peak below 3.3log 10 (< 2000 IU/mL): HR 3.44 (2.01–5.89); loss of hepatitis B e‐antigen (HBeAg) during follow‐up: HR 7.23 (3.87–13.50). The incidence of HBsAg clearance was 1.96 cases/100 patient‐years. It was more frequent in patients older than 40 years, with baseline DNA‐HBV below 3.3 log 10 (< 2000 IU/mL), and in chronic HBeAg+ patients who lost HBeAg during follow‐up. HBsAg clearance was associated with a better long‐term hepatic prognosis.

A prospective open cohort study of 453 patients with CHB infection was recruited in the Liver Unit of the Internal Department of two hospitals in Málaga (Spain) between 1991 and 2022 to assess the incidence of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) clearance during follow‐up, identify factors related to it, and determine the influence that clearance had on the long‐term prognosis. The duration of follow‐up ranged from 0.5 to 36.08 years. A multivariate Cox regression analysis was conducted to identify factors associated with HBsAg clearance. The impact of clearance on long‐term prognosis was evaluated using a combined prognostic end point: need for liver transplantation, liver complications, or liver‐related mortality. The construction of time‐to‐event curves was achieved by employing the Kaplan‐Meir method, with subsequent comparison of event occurrence between groups conducted via log‐rank test. During the subsequent follow‐up period, 96/453 patients (21.2%) lost surface antigen (1.96/100 patients per year). Multivariate Cox regression analysis identified as independent factors associated with HBsAg clearance: age at first assessment over 40 years: HR 2.21 (1.38–3.52); a baseline DNA HBV peak below 3.3log 10 (< 2000 IU/mL): HR 3.44 (2.01–5.89); loss of hepatitis B e‐antigen (HBeAg) during follow‐up: HR 7.23 (3.87–13.50). The incidence of HBsAg clearance was 1.96 cases/100 patient‐years. It was more frequent in patients older than 40 years, with baseline DNA‐HBV below 3.3 log 10 (< 2000 IU/mL), and in chronic HBeAg+ patients who lost HBeAg during follow‐up. HBsAg clearance was associated with a better long‐term hepatic prognosis.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated factors associated with hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) clearance in a Spanish cohort of chronic hepatitis B patients and its impact on long-term prognosis. A prospective open cohort study of 453 patients with chronic hepatitis B infection was conducted between 1991 and 2022 in Málaga, Spain. The study used multivariate Cox regression analysis to identify independent factors linked to HBsAg clearance, including age over 40 years, baseline HBV DNA levels below 3.3 log 10, and loss of hepatitis B e-antigen during follow-up. The results showed that 21.2% of patients lost HBsAg, with an incidence rate of 1.96 cases per 100 patient-years. HBsAg clearance was associated with improved long-term hepatic prognosis, as measured by the combined endpoint of liver transplantation, complications, or mortality. The study's evidence is strong due to its large sample size and extended follow-up, though its observational design limits causal inference.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 目的是在西班牙南部未经选择的长期随访乙型肝炎开放 队列研究 中,确定有助于 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 感染患者乙型肝炎表面抗原 (HBsAg) 清除的因素。一项前瞻性开放 队列研究 研究于 1991 年至 2022 年间在马拉加(西班牙)两家医院内科肝脏病房招募了 453 名 CHB 感染患者,以评估随访期间乙型肝炎表面抗原(HBsAg)清除率的 发病率,确定与其相关的因素,并确定清除率对长期预后的影响。随访时间为0.5至36.08年。进行多变量 Cox 回归分析以确定与 HBsAg 清除相关的因素。使用联合预后终点评估清除率对长期预后的影响:需要肝移植、肝脏并发症或肝脏相关的 死亡率。采用 Kaplan-Meir 方法构建时间-事件曲线,随后通过对数秩检验对组间事件发生情况进行比较。在随后的随访期间,96/453 名患者(21.2%)失去表面抗原(每年 1.96/100 名患者)。多变量 Cox 回归分析确定为与 HBsAg 清除率相关的独立因素:首次评估年龄超过 40 岁:HR 2.21 (1.38–3.52);基线 DNA HBV 峰值低于 3.3log 10 (< 2000 IU/mL):HR 3.44 (2.01–5.89);随访期间乙型肝炎 e 抗原 (HBeAg) 丢失:HR 7.23 (3.87–13.50)。HBsAg 清除率的 发病率 为 1.96 例/100 患者年。这种情况在 40 岁以上、基线 DNA-HBV 低于 3.3 log 10 (< 2000 IU/mL) 的患者以及随访期间 HBeAg 消失的慢性 HBeAg+ 患者中更为常见。HBsAg 清除率与更好的长期肝脏预后相关。

papers.title: Chronic HBV Infection Disrupts CCL5‐Secreting cNK Cells and Attenuates Liver Accumulation and Activation of DCs and HBV‐Specific T Cells
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Understanding the immunological mechanisms underlying chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection‐induced immune tolerance is critical for developing effective therapeutic strategies, yet the mechanisms by which natural killer (NK)‐cell subsets regulate dendritic cell (DC)‐mediated antiviral immunity during chronic HBV infection remain unclear. Here, we demonstrated that chronic HBV infection disrupted intrahepatic DCs accumulation and activation by suppressing CC chemokine ligand 5 (CCL5) production from hepatic NK cells. Importantly, chronic HBV infection reduced the number of hepatic conventional NK (cNK) cells, the main source of hepatic CCL5, whereas liver‐resident NK (LrNK) cells increased and exhibited lower CCL5 expression and immunosuppressive features. Adoptive transfer of CCL5‐competent hepatic cNK cells promoted DCs accumulation and activation, enhanced HBV‐specific CD8 + T‐cell responses, and facilitated viral clearance. Mechanistically, chronic HBV infection promoted the activation of adenosine A2a receptor (ADORA2A)/nuclear factor kappa‐B (NF‐κB) pathway in hepatic NK cells, thereby antagonizing NF‐κB activation, reducing the proportion of cNK cells, suppressing CCL5 production, and ultimately impairing hepatic aggregation and activation of DCs, leading to defective anti‐HBV immune responses. This study revealed a novel mechanism involved in chronic HBV infection‐induced immune tolerance and indicated that targeting the ADORA2A/NFκB/CCL5 axis in cNK cells may represent a potential therapeutic strategy for chronic HBV infection.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 研究表明,慢性 HBV 感染通过抑制肝 NK 细胞产生 CC 趋化因子配体 5 (CCL5),从而破坏肝内 DC 的积累和激活。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究涉及过继转移具有 CCL5 活性的肝脏常规 NK (cNK) 细胞,以促进 DC 积累和激活,增强 HBV 特异性 CD8+ T 细胞反应并促进病毒清除。
elements_zh.main_results: 慢性HBV感染减少了肝脏cNK细胞(肝脏CCL5的主要来源)的数量,而肝脏驻留NK(LrNK)细胞增加并表现出较低的CCL5表达和免疫抑制特征。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 慢性HBV感染促进肝NK细胞中腺苷A2a受体(ADORA2A)/核因子κ-B(NF-κB)通路的激活,从而拮抗NF-κB激活,降低cNK细胞比例,抑制CCL5产生,最终损害肝脏聚集和DCs活化,导致抗HBV 免疫应答缺陷。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这项研究揭示了慢性 HBV 感染诱导免疫耐受的新机制,并表明靶向 cNK 细胞中的 ADORA2A/NFκB/CCL5 轴可能代表慢性 HBV 感染的潜在治疗策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究为慢性 HBV 感染期间 cNK 细胞在调节 DC 介导的 抗病毒药物 免疫中的作用提供了强有力的证据,但需要进一步的研究来在临床环境中验证这些发现。

This study revealed a novel mechanism involved in chronic HBV infection‐induced immune tolerance and indicated that targeting the ADORA2A/NFκB/CCL5 axis in cNK cells may represent a potential therapeutic strategy for chronic HBV infection.

papers.title: Medication adherence in Chinese adults with chronic hepatitis B based on theory of planned behavior
papers.abstract: Purpose To investigate the factors related to medication adherence in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) infection by considering the theory of planned behavior (TPB). Methods In this cross-sectional study, medication adherence information was collected from outpatients with CHB in China. Pearson correlation analysis was performed to evaluate the association between medication adherence and TPB items. A structural equation model was established to further assess the effects of the latent TPB variables on medication adherence. Results A total of 225 patients with CHB recruited from the outpatient department of Qingdao Public Health Clinical Center were included, 67.6% of whom reported moderate medication adherence, as assessed using Morisky Adherence Assessment Score. Medication adherence was significantly positively correlated with behavioral intention ( r = 0.51, P < 0.001), perceived behavioral control ( r = 0.63, P < 0.001), and subjective norms ( r = 0.52, P < 0.001). Perceived behavioral control both directly and indirectly affected medication adherence, with the correlation coefficients being 0.14 and 0.32, respectively. The structural equation model revealed behavioral attitude and subjective norms as the strongest predictors of medication adherence, both of which indirectly affected behavior (correlation coefficients: 0.13 × 0.66 = 0.09 and 0.39 × 0.66 = 0.25, respectively). The optimal fitted model of TPB variables explained 58.5% of the variance in medication adherence. Conclusions Moderate medication adherence was discovered among Chinese adults with CHB. Behavioral attitude, subjective norms, and perceived behavioral control indirectly affected medication adherence.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项横断面研究纳入了从中国青岛公共卫生临床中心门诊部招募的 225 名慢性乙型肝炎患者。
elements_zh.methods: 采用 Pearson 相关分析评估药物依从性与 TPB 项目之间的关联,并建立结构方程模型来评估潜在 TPB 变量对药物依从性的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 在225例CHB患者中,67.6%经Morisky依从性评估量表评估报告了中等药物依从性。药物依从性与行为意向(r = 0.51,P < 0.001)、感知行为控制(r = 0.63,P < 0.001)和主观规范(r = 0.52,P < 0.001)呈显著正相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,行为态度、主观规范和感知行为控制间接影响药物依从性,结构方程模型解释了药物依从性差异的 58.5%。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以为干预措施提供信息,通过基于 TPB 框架的行为态度、主观规范和感知行为控制来提高慢性乙型肝炎患者的药物依从性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是横断面的,限制了因果推断,但大样本量和经过验证的措施的使用提供了中等的证据强度。

papers.source_body_en: Purpose To investigate the factors related to medication adherence in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) infection by considering the theory of planned behavior (TPB). Methods In this cross-sectional study, medication adherence information was collected from outpatients with CHB in China. Pearson correlation analysis was performed to evaluate the association between medication adherence and TPB items. A structural equation model was established to further assess the effects of the latent TPB variables on medication adherence. Results A total of 225 patients with CHB recruited from the outpatient department of Qingdao Public Health Clinical Center were included, 67.6% of whom reported moderate medication adherence, as assessed using Morisky Adherence Assessment Score. Medication adherence was significantly positively correlated with behavioral intention ( r = 0.51, P < 0.001), perceived behavioral control ( r = 0.63, P < 0.001), and subjective norms ( r = 0.52, P < 0.001). Perceived behavioral control both directly and indirectly affected medication adherence, with the correlation coefficients being 0.14 and 0.32, respectively. The structural equation model revealed behavioral attitude and subjective norms as the strongest predictors of medication adherence, both of which indirectly affected behavior (correlation coefficients: 0.13 × 0.66 = 0.09 and 0.39 × 0.66 = 0.25, respectively). The optimal fitted model of TPB variables explained 58.5% of the variance in medication adherence. Conclusions Moderate medication adherence was discovered among Chinese adults with CHB. Behavioral attitude, subjective norms, and perceived behavioral control indirectly affected medication adherence.

papers.title: Trends in Hepatitis B, Hepatitis C, and HIV Seroprevalence in the Netherlands: Insights From Two Decades of Nationwide PIENTER Serosurveys.
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B (HBV), hepatitis C (HCV), and HIV remain public health challenges despite effective treatments and preventive options. Infections are often asymptomatic, leading to undiagnosed cases, onward transmission, and preventable morbidity and mortality. In the Netherlands, disease burden is concentrated in specific populations, with many undetected infections. We estimated HBV, HCV, and HIV seroprevalence, identified determinants, and assessed trends over 20 years using data from 14,444 participants aged 15-79 years from three nationwide cross-sectional serosurveys (PIENTER: 1995-1996, 2006-2007, and 2016-2017). Participants completed questionnaires on demographics, behaviour, and socio-economic factors, and serum samples were tested for HBV and HCV in all rounds and HIV in 2017. Seroprevalence estimates were weighted to the Dutch population, trends were analysed using weighted Poisson regression, and determinants were evaluated using multivariable Poisson regression. Weighted HBV seroprevalence remained stable across surveys (3%-5% past or present infection; < 0.4% active infection). HBV prevalence was highest among first-generation migrants, with older age, migration background, and STI history as key determinants. HCV seroprevalence remained low (< 0.4%) and was highest among non-Western migrants. HIV prevalence was 0.1% and highest among non-Western migrants and men who have sex with men. Only 9% of active HBV cases were aware of their status. Overall, HBV, HCV, and HIV seroprevalence remain low in the Netherlands but are concentrated in specific groups with limited awareness. These findings support targeted prevention, screening, and linkage-to-care strategies to achieve the 2030 WHO elimination goals and highlight the importance of continued population-based (sero-)monitoring to guide public health policy.

Eline L M Op de Coul

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed three nationwide cross-sectional serosurveys (PIENTER) from 1995-1996, 2006-2007, and 2016-2017, involving 14,444 participants aged 15-79 years, to assess trends in HBV, HCV, and HIV seroprevalence in the Netherlands. Infections were concentrated among first-generation and non-Western migrants and men who have sex with men, with only 9% of active HBV cases aware of their status. These findings support targeted prevention and screening strategies to achieve WHO elimination goals and underscore the need for continued population-based monitoring.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 尽管有有效的 传播 和预防措施,乙型肝炎 (HBV)、丙型肝炎 (HCV) 和 HIV 仍然是公共卫生挑战,感染通常无症状,导致未确诊病例和进一步的 传播。在荷兰,疾病负担集中在特定人群中,有许多未发现的感染,因此需要对 血清流行率 随着时间的推移的趋势进行评估。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究利用了三项全国性横断面血清调查(PIENTER:1995-1996、2006-2007 和 2016-2017)的数据,包括 14,444 名 15-79 岁的参与者,以估计 HBV、HCV 和 HIV 血清流行率、确定决定因素并评估 20 年来的趋势。
elements_zh.methods: 参与者完成了有关人口统计、行为和社会经济因素的问卷调查,并在 2017 年对所有轮次的 HBV 和 HCV 以及 HIV 样本进行了血清样本检测。血清流行率 估计值根据荷兰人口进行加权,使用加权泊松回归分析趋势,并使用多变量泊松回归评估决定因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 加权 HBV 血清流行率 在整个调查中保持稳定(3%-5% 过去或现在感染;< 0.4% 活动性感染),在第一代移民中最高,只有 9% 的活动性 HBV 病例知道自己的状况。HCV 血清流行率 仍然较低(< 0.4%),在非西方移民中最高,而 HIV 患病率 为 0.1%,在非西方移民和男男性行为者中最高。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 总体而言,荷兰的HBV、HCV和HIV 血清流行率仍然较低,但集中在认知有限的特定群体中,这表明虽然一般人群患病率稳定,但在这些亚群中存在持续的传播风险。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持有针对性的预防、筛查和与护理挂钩的战略,以实现世卫组织 2030 年消除目标,并强调持续进行基于人群的(血清)监测以指导公共卫生政策的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据没有报告具体的设计限制、偏差或混杂因素,但使用二十年来三项大规模全国性调查的加权数据为评估人口趋势提供了中等水平的证据。

In the Netherlands, disease burden is concentrated in specific populations, with many undetected infections. We estimated HBV, HCV, and HIV seroprevalence, identified determinants, and assessed trends over 20 years using data from 14,444 participants aged 15-79 years from three nationwide cross-sectional serosurveys (PIENTER: 1995-1996, 2006-2007, and 2016-2017). Participants completed questionnaires on demographics, behaviour, and socio-economic factors, and serum samples were tested for HBV and HCV in all rounds and HIV in 2017. Seroprevalence estimates were weighted to the Dutch population, trends were analysed using weighted Poisson regression, and determinants were evaluated using multivariable Poisson regression. Weighted HBV seroprevalence remained stable across surveys (3%-5% past or present infection; < 0.4% active infection). HBV prevalence was highest among first-generation migrants, with older age, migration background, and STI history as key determinants. HCV seroprevalence remained low (< 0.4%) and was highest among non-Western migrants. HIV prevalence was 0.1% and highest among non-Western migrants and men who have sex with men. Only 9% of active HBV cases were aware of their status. Overall, HBV, HCV, and HIV seroprevalence remain low in the Netherlands but are concentrated in specific groups with limited awareness. These findings support targeted prevention, screening, and linkage-to-care strategies to achieve the 2030 WHO elimination goals and highlight the importance of continued population-based (sero-)monitoring to guide public health policy.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 尽管有有效的 传播 和预防措施,乙型肝炎 (HBV)、丙型肝炎 (HCV) 和 HIV 仍然是公共卫生挑战,感染通常无症状,导致未确诊病例和进一步的 传播。在荷兰,疾病负担集中在特定人群中,有许多未发现的感染,因此需要对 血清流行率 随着时间的推移的趋势进行评估。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究利用了三项全国性横断面血清调查(PIENTER:1995-1996、2006-2007 和 2016-2017)的数据,包括 14,444 名 15-79 岁的参与者,以估计 HBV、HCV 和 HIV 血清流行率、确定决定因素并评估 20 年来的趋势。
analysis_zh.methods: 参与者完成了有关人口统计、行为和社会经济因素的问卷调查,并在 2017 年对所有轮次的 HBV 和 HCV 以及 HIV 样本进行了血清样本检测。血清流行率 估计值根据荷兰人口进行加权,使用加权泊松回归分析趋势,并使用多变量泊松回归评估决定因素。
analysis_zh.main_results: 加权 HBV 血清流行率 在整个调查中保持稳定(3%-5% 过去或现在感染;< 0.4% 活动性感染),在第一代移民中最高,只有 9% 的活动性 HBV 病例知道自己的状况。HCV 血清流行率 仍然较低(< 0.4%),在非西方移民中最高,而 HIV 患病率 为 0.1%,在非西方移民和男男性行为者中最高。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 总体而言,荷兰的HBV、HCV和HIV 血清流行率仍然较低,但集中在认知有限的特定群体中,这表明虽然一般人群患病率稳定,但在这些亚群中存在持续的传播风险。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持有针对性的预防、筛查和与护理挂钩的战略,以实现世卫组织 2030 年消除目标,并强调持续进行基于人群的(血清)监测以指导公共卫生政策的重要性。

papers.title: Spatiotemporal evolution characteristics and influencing factors of hepatitis B incidence rate in China
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a persistent public health challenge in China, with significant spatiotemporal heterogeneity in incidence. This study aimed to examine regional disparities in hepatitis B incidence, explore its spatiotemporal evolution patterns, and analyze the spatiotemporal heterogeneity of associated factors across China, using incidence data from 2008 to 2023. The Dagum Gini coefficient decomposition method assessed regional disparity sources, the standard deviation ellipse explored spatiotemporal direction and global characteristics, exploratory spatial data analysis (ESDA) examined spatial correlation and aggregation, and the geographically and temporally weighted regression (GTWR) model was used to examine spatiotemporal heterogeneity of influencing factors. Results showed narrowing regional disparities, declining spatial aggregation, and a standard deviation ellipse located in eastern and central regions with a southeastward shift, alongside the incidence gravity center moving 351.25 km southeast. Patterns shifted from clustered to dispersed, likely due to vaccination and improved healthcare allocation. Six socioeconomic factors exerted significant yet spatiotemporally heterogeneous impacts, with diverse, regionally varying effects based on economic and policy contexts.

papers.title: Long-Term Outcomes of Entecavir Therapy in Treatment-Naive Patients with Chronic Hepatitis B
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) requires long-term antiviral therapy to prevent disease progression. This study evaluated the long-term efficacy and safety of entecavir (ETV) therapy and investigated predictors of partial virological response (PVR) in treatment-naive CHB patients. Methods This retrospective study included 230 nucleoside-naive CHB patients treated with entecavir between January 2020 and December 2024. Virological response (VR) was defined as HBV-DNA 1 log10 IU/mL reduction in HBV-DNA despite detectable viral DNA after at least 12 months of therapy. Clinical, biochemical, and virological parameters were analyzed during follow-up. Results The mean age was 44 ± 18 years, and 54.7% were male. Baseline HBV-DNA was 6.8 log10 IU/mL. VR rates reached 66% at month 3, 86% at month 6, 89% at year 1, and 100% by years 4–5. ALT normalization improved progressively, while HBeAg seroconversion was highest during years 2–3. PVR occurred in 10.2% of patients. PVR was significantly associated with higher baseline HBV-DNA levels and failure to achieve virological response VR at week 24. No serious adverse events were observed. Conclusions ETV therapy provides effective, durable viral suppression and excellent safety in treatment-naive CHB patients. Continued treatment in patients with PVR may still achieve complete virological suppression.

analysis.methods: Virological response was defined as HBV-DNA reduction of at least 1 log10 IU/mL with detectable viral DNA after at least 12 months of therapy, and clinical, biochemical, and virological parameters were analyzed during follow-up.

analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that entecavir therapy provides effective, durable viral suppression and excellent safety in treatment-naive chronic hepatitis B patients, and continued treatment in patients with partial virological response may still achieve complete virological suppression.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings support the use of entecavir as a first-line therapy for chronic hepatitis B, with implications for long-term viral suppression and reduced disease progression, and suggest that even patients with partial virological response may benefit from continued treatment.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate due to the retrospective study design and single-center population, which may limit generalizability, though the large sample size and long follow-up period provide robust data on entecavir's efficacy and safety.

papers.title: Longitudinal Patterns of Chronic Hepatitis B Care and Treatment Adherence in Australia: A National Linked Data Cohort Study.
papers.abstract: Current uptake of chronic hepatitis B (CHB) treatment and care in Australia is well below target levels, leading to an ongoing burden of preventable liver disease and cancer. Understanding individual-level trajectories of care engagement and variation by sociodemographic factors is essential to guide efforts to improve access to and retention in care. This study analysed records of hepatitis B viral load (VL) testing and antiviral treatment provided through Australia's national health insurance system, which were linked to migration, death, and sociodemographic data from various government datasets. Treatment and VL testing by population group were assessed, and uptake was calculated using modelled estimates of the number living with CHB. VL testing frequency and treatment adherence based on scripts dispensed were also assessed. Of the estimated 219,800 people living with CHB in Australia in 2023, 118,334 (53.8%) received either VL testing or treatment during 2014-2023. Estimated uptake of VL testing and treatment uptake were lower among Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people and also varied by region of birth. Of the 81,360 who received any VL testing, only 17,352 (21.3%) received it regularly, while 31,715 (39.0%) had evidence of prior monitoring but no VL testing since 2019. The majority of those who initiated treatment continued therapy and received supply sufficient for adherence. This study shows that substantial gaps exist in CHB care in Australia, particularly in continued monitoring among those not on treatment. Disparities in uptake are evident by priority population. Re-engaging those lost to follow-up should be prioritised.

This study analysed records of hepatitis B viral load (VL) testing and antiviral treatment provided through Australia's national health insurance system, which were linked to migration, death, and sociodemographic data from various government datasets. Treatment and VL testing by population group were assessed, and uptake was calculated using modelled estimates of the number living with CHB. VL testing frequency and treatment adherence based on scripts dispensed were also assessed. Of the estimated 219,800 people living with CHB in Australia in 2023, 118,334 (53.8%) received either VL testing or treatment during 2014-2023. Estimated uptake of VL testing and treatment uptake were lower among Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people and also varied by region of birth. Of the 81,360 who received any VL testing, only 17,352 (21.3%) received it regularly, while 31,715 (39.0%) had evidence of prior monitoring but no VL testing since 2019. The majority of those who initiated treatment continued therapy and received supply sufficient for adherence. This study shows that substantial gaps exist in CHB care in Australia, particularly in continued monitoring among those not on treatment. Disparities in uptake are evident by priority population. Re-engaging those lost to follow-up should be prioritised.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the patterns of chronic hepatitis B (CHB) care and treatment adherence in Australia using national health insurance and government datasets. It highlights that current treatment and care uptake is below target levels, contributing to preventable liver disease and cancer. The analysis reveals disparities in VL testing and treatment among Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander populations and by region of birth. While the majority of those who initiated treatment continued therapy, significant gaps in monitoring persist for those not on treatment. These findings underscore the need for targeted interventions to improve care and retention, particularly for vulnerable groups. The study's reliance on modelled estimates and linked data may limit the precision of its conclusions, but the evidence is strong enough to identify critical areas for public health action.

papers.title: Hepatocellular Carcinoma Risk Between Untreated Immune Tolerant Vs. Treated Immune Active Chronic Hepatitis B Patients.
papers.abstract: The risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) between chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients in the untreated immune tolerant (U-IT) vs. treated immune active (T-IA) phases is not clear, and most data are in Asian populations. We aim to evaluate long-term risks of cirrhosis, HCC, and overall mortality between U-IT vs. T-IA CHB patients among a national cohort of U.S. We conducted a propensity score weighted analysis of Veterans with CHB who met criteria for U-IT or T-IA from 1/1/2010 to 12/31/2021 (with follow-up through 12/31/2024). Incidence of cirrhosis, HCC, or death were compared between U-IT and T-IA groups. A total of 591 U-IT and 555 T-IA CHB patients were identified (mean age 56.4-57.5 years, 45%-50% non-Hispanic white, 37%-40% African American, 9%-10% Asian, 25%-29% concurrent diabetes, 35%-39% with FIB-4 > 3.25). Over a median follow up of 6.4 years (IQR 3.0-10.4), incidence of HCC was significantly lower in U-IT patients vs. T-IA patients (0.28 vs. 0.54 per 100 person-years; HR 0.52, 95% CI 0.32-0.83, p = 0.007). However, the risk of cirrhosis or all-cause mortality was similar between both T-IA and U-IT CHB patients. Among a predominantly non-Asian cohort of adults with CHB, we observed that HCC risk was lower in U-IT patients compared to T-IA patients. While this contrasts with some studies in Asian countries, these data do emphasize the importance of prioritizing and ensuring timely therapy for CHB patients in the IA phase. However, routine treatment in IT patients remains controversial and more data are needed to better understand long-term outcomes.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 患者在未经治疗的免疫耐受 (U-IT) 与治疗的免疫活跃 (T-IA) 阶段发生肝细胞癌 (HCC) 的风险尚不清楚,并且大多数数据来自亚洲人群。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们对 2010 年 1 月 1 日至 2021 年 12 月 31 日期间符合 U-IT 或 T-IA 标准的慢性乙型肝炎退伍军人进行了倾向评分加权分析(随访至 2024 年 12 月 31 日)。总共确定了 591 名 U-IT 和 555 名 T-IA CHB 患者。
elements_zh.methods: 使用倾向评分加权分析比较 U-IT 组和 T-IA 组之间的肝硬化、HCC 或死亡的 发病率。
elements_zh.main_results: Over a median follow up of 6.4 years (IQR 3.0-10.4), incidence of HCC was significantly lower in U-IT patients vs. T-IA patients (0.28 vs. 0.54 per 100 person-years; HR 0.52, 95% CI 0.32-0.83, p = 0.007). However, the risk of cirrhosis or all-cause mortality was similar between both T-IA and U-IT CHB patients.
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在主要为非亚裔的慢性乙型肝炎成人 队列研究 中,我们观察到与 T-IA 患者相比,U-IT 患者的 HCC 风险较低。虽然这与亚洲国家的一些研究形成鲜明对比,但这些数据确实强调了在 IA 阶段优先考虑并确保及时治疗 CHB 患者的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了在免疫活跃期及时治疗慢性乙型肝炎患者的重要性,尽管免疫耐受患者的常规 治疗 仍存在争议,并且需要更多数据来更好地了解长期结果。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是在主要非亚洲人 队列研究 中进行的,这可能会限制对亚洲人群的普遍适用性。尽管有倾向评分加权,但由于观察设计和潜在的残留混杂因素,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Innovative Multisectoral Approaches to Overcome Hepatitis B Elimination Barriers in Indonesia: Systematic Literature Review
papers.abstract: This study aims to identify the main challenges and multisectoral strategies in hepatitis B elimination efforts in Indonesia, using a global, evidence-based systematic literature review approach.This study was motivated by the high prevalence of chronic hepatitis B and the slow progress in achieving the World Health Organization elimination target of 2030.The literature search was conducted in the Scopus database using the keywords "hepatitis B elimination", "Indonesia", and "multisectoral challenges", covering publications between 2019 and 2025.The analysis followed the PRISMA 2020 guidelines and comprised four main stages: identification, screening, eligibility assessment, and inclusion.Of the initial 135 articles, 20 studies met the criteria and were thematically analyzed to identify trends, challenges, and elimination strategies.The synthesis identified three main dimensions of barriers: (1) biomedical, including limited detection of latent infection (occult hepatitis B infection) and the presence of covalently closed circular DNA; (2) health-system, including weak surveillance, poor cross-program coordination, and manual reporting; and (3) social, including stigma and low vaccination awareness.On the other hand, innovative strategies such as the implementation of digital surveillance systems, the strengthening of cross-country networks, and the development of national vaccines with high effectiveness show the potential to accelerate elimination.This study emphasizes the need for an integrative, cross-sectoral, and evidence-based approach to achieve hepatitis B elimination in Indonesia.The results make conceptual and practical contributions to strengthening global public health policy, particularly in developing countries.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic literature review examines barriers and multisectoral strategies for hepatitis B elimination in Indonesia. Following PRISMA 2020 guidelines, the authors analyzed 20 studies from Scopus published between 2019 and 2025. The review identifies three primary barrier dimensions: biomedical challenges like occult hepatitis B infection; health-system deficiencies such as weak surveillance and manual reporting; and social obstacles including stigma. Conversely, innovative strategies like digital surveillance systems, cross-country networks, and high-efficacy national vaccines demonstrate potential to accelerate progress toward the World Health Organization 2030 target. The authors conclude that an integrative, cross-sectoral approach is essential and highlight the study's contribution to strengthening public health policy in developing countries.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 这是遵循 PRISMA 2020 指南的系统文献综述。该搜索是在 Scopus 数据库中进行的,以查找 2019 年至 2025 年间的出版物。在 135 篇初始文章中,有 20 项研究符合标准,并进行了主题分析,以确定趋势、挑战和消除策略。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综合报告确定了障碍的三个主要方面:生物医学问题,如潜在感染和共价闭合环状 DNA 的有限检测;卫生系统的弱点,包括不良的 监测 和手动报告;以及社会因素,例如耻辱和低 疫苗接种 意识。数字 监测、跨国网络和有效的国家 疫苗 等创新战略显示出加速消除的潜力。

papers.title_zh: 印度尼西亚克服乙型肝炎消除障碍的创新多部门方法:系统文献综述
papers.source_body_en: This study aims to identify the main challenges and multisectoral strategies in hepatitis B elimination efforts in Indonesia, using a global, evidence-based systematic literature review approach.This study was motivated by the high prevalence of chronic hepatitis B and the slow progress in achieving the World Health Organization elimination target of 2030.The literature search was conducted in the Scopus database using the keywords "hepatitis B elimination", "Indonesia", and "multisectoral challenges", covering publications between 2019 and 2025.The analysis followed the PRISMA 2020 guidelines and comprised four main stages: identification, screening, eligibility assessment, and inclusion.Of the initial 135 articles, 20 studies met the criteria and were thematically analyzed to identify trends, challenges, and elimination strategies.The synthesis identified three main dimensions of barriers: (1) biomedical, including limited detection of latent infection (occult hepatitis B infection) and the presence of covalently closed circular DNA; (2) health-system, including weak surveillance, poor cross-program coordination, and manual reporting; and (3) social, including stigma and low vaccination awareness.On the other hand, innovative strategies such as the implementation of digital surveillance systems, the strengthening of cross-country networks, and the development of national vaccines with high effectiveness show the potential to accelerate elimination.This study emphasizes the need for an integrative, cross-sectoral, and evidence-based approach to achieve hepatitis B elimination in Indonesia.The results make conceptual and practical contributions to strengthening global public health policy, particularly in developing countries.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在采用全球循证系统文献综述方法,确定印度尼西亚消除乙型肝炎工作中的主要挑战和多部门策略。本研究的动机是 患病率 的高 慢性乙型肝炎 以及实现世界卫生组织 2030 年消除乙型肝炎目标进展缓慢。在 Scopus 数据库中使用关键词“消除乙型肝炎”、“印度尼西亚”和“多部门挑战”进行文献检索,涵盖2019 年至 2025 年间发表的出版物。分析遵循 PRISMA 2020 指南,包括四个主要阶段:识别、筛选、资格评估和纳入。在最初的 135 篇文章中,有 20 项研究符合标准,并进行了主题分析,以确定趋势、挑战和消除策略。综合确定了三个主要障碍维度:(1) 生物医学,包括对潜伏感染(隐匿性乙型肝炎感染)的有限检测和共价闭合循环的存在脱氧核糖核酸;(2) 卫生系统,包括薄弱的 监测、跨项目协调差和手工报告;(3) 社会,包括耻辱和低 疫苗接种 认识。另一方面,实施数字 监测 系统、加强跨国网络以及高效发展国家 疫苗 等创新战略显示出加速消除乙型肝炎的潜力。本研究强调需要采取综合、跨部门和基于证据的方法来实现印度尼西亚消除乙型肝炎。研究结果为加强乙型肝炎消除做出了概念和实践贡献。全球公共卫生政策,特别是发展中国家的公共卫生政策。

analysis.methods: The study employed systematic data collection and analysis to assess hepatitis B infection status and identify potential risk factors in the rural South Indian population.
analysis.main_results: The study reported the prevalence of hepatitis B infection and identified specific factors associated with its occurrence in the rural South Indian setting.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide important data for public health planning and targeted interventions to control hepatitis B in rural South Indian communities.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's evidence strength is limited by the cross-sectional design and potential sampling biases, which may affect the generalizability of the results.

The findings contribute to understanding hepatitis B epidemiology in understudied rural populations, though the cross-sectional design limits causal inferences. The study emphasizes the need for targeted interventions and surveillance in rural South Indian communities.

papers.title: LIMITED DIAGNOSTIC ACCURACY OF FIB-4 FOR DETECTING SIGNIFICANT LIVER FIBROSIS IN CHRONIC HEPATITIS B: A CROSS-SECTIONAL STUDY.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Liver disease linked to the hepatitis B virus (HBV) is a serious public threat worldwide and in Egypt. The incidence of HBV infection in Egypt is about 1.4%. Accurate liver fibrosis assessments are crucial in the evaluation and follow-up of HBV patients, but traditional biopsies have limitations, prompting the use of non-invasive methods like the vibration controlled transient elastography (VCTE), which may not be available in limited-resource treatment centers. OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to assess the diagnostic accuracy of Fibrosis-4 (FIB-4) and Aminotransferase to Platelet Ratio Index (APRI) compared to VCTE in detecting significant liver fibrosis in adult chronic HBV patients, potentially offering a more accessible and less costly approach to disease management. Methods - In this cross-sectional study, 247 subjects with chronic HBV from Alexandria University Viral Hepatitis Treatment Unit were included. Data collected included demographic details, HBV viral load, liver function tests, Complete Blood Count (CBC), international normalized ratio (INR), prothrombin time, albumin, total and direct bilirubin, APRI score, FIB-4 score, imaging, and VCTE data. IBM SPSS software was used for statistical analysis, with qualitative and quantitative data described appropriately. Logistic regression and receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC) curves were used to identify significant predictors of advanced fibrosis and assess diagnostic performance. RESULTS: Based on VCTE results, 247 chronic hepatitis B patients were classified into two groups: 140 with no or mild fibrosis (F0/1) and 107 with significant fibrosis (F2-F4). Significant differences were found in hemoglobin, albumin, and INR levels between the groups. The FIB-4 and APRI scores were significantly higher in the significant fibrosis group, with median FIB-4 scores of 1.26 vs 0.79 and median APRI scores of 0.40 vs 0.27. The FIB-4 index remained a significant predictor of significant fibrosis in multivariate analysis, with an odds ratio of 1.558. At a cut-off value of >0.88, the FIB-4 score achieved a sensitivity of 65.42% and a specificity of 60.0% in differentiating patients with and without significant fibrosis. CONCLUSION: Although the use of FIB-4 score is potentially useful in resource-limited settings, a significant number of misclassifications can occur due to its moderate sensitivity and specificity which necessitate further incorporation of additional diagnostic methods to ensure the accurate staging of liver fibrosis.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study evaluated the diagnostic accuracy of FIB-4 and APRI scores against vibration controlled transient elastography (VCTE) in 247 Egyptian patients with chronic hepatitis B. VCTE classified 140 patients with no or mild fibrosis and 107 with significant fibrosis. Results showed that while FIB-4 and APRI scores were significantly higher in the significant fibrosis group, FIB-4 demonstrated only moderate diagnostic performance. At a cut-off of >0.88, FIB-4 achieved a sensitivity of 65.42% and specificity of 60.0%, remaining a significant predictor in multivariate analysis with an odds ratio of 1.558. The authors concluded that although FIB-4 is potentially useful in resource-limited settings, its moderate accuracy leads to misclassifications, necessitating additional diagnostic methods for accurate fibrosis staging.
