analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Liver disease linked to the hepatitis B virus (HBV) is a serious public threat worldwide and in Egypt, with an infection incidence of about 1.4%. This study aimed to assess the diagnostic accuracy of Fibrosis-4 (FIB-4) and Aminotransferase to Platelet Ratio Index (APRI) compared to VCTE in detecting significant liver fibrosis in adult chronic HBV patients.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: This cross-sectional study included 247 subjects with chronic HBV from Alexandria University Viral Hepatitis Treatment Unit. Based on VCTE results, patients were classified into two groups: 140 with no or mild fibrosis (F0/1) and 107 with significant fibrosis (F2-F4).
analysis_en.methods: Data collected included demographic details, HBV viral load, liver function tests, Complete Blood Count (CBC), international normalized ratio (INR), prothrombin time, albumin, total and direct bilirubin, APRI score, FIB-4 score, imaging, and VCTE data. IBM SPSS software was used for statistical analysis, employing logistic regression and receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC) curves to identify significant predictors of advanced fibrosis and assess diagnostic performance.
analysis_en.main_results: Significant differences were found in hemoglobin, albumin, and INR levels between the groups, with median FIB-4 scores of 1.26 vs 0.79 and median APRI scores of 0.40 vs 0.27 in the significant fibrosis group. The FIB-4 index remained a significant predictor of significant fibrosis in multivariate analysis with an odds ratio of 1.558, and at a cut-off value of >0.88, it achieved a sensitivity of 65.42% and a specificity of 60.0%.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: Although the use of FIB-4 score is potentially useful in resource-limited settings, a significant number of misclassifications can occur due to its moderate sensitivity and specificity. This necessitates the further incorporation of additional diagnostic methods to ensure the accurate staging of liver fibrosis.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Accurate liver fibrosis assessments are crucial in the evaluation and follow-up of HBV patients, but traditional biopsies have limitations, prompting the use of non-invasive methods like VCTE. The findings suggest that while FIB-4 offers a more accessible and less costly approach, its moderate diagnostic performance requires supplementation with other methods for reliable disease management.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The supplied evidence does not report specific design limitations or biases beyond the moderate sensitivity and specificity of the FIB-4 score. The evidence strength is moderate due to the cross-sectional design and the reliance on VCTE as the reference standard without biopsy confirmation.

papers.title_zh: FIB-4 在 慢性乙型肝炎 中检测显着肝纤维化的诊断准确性有限:一项横断面研究。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Liver disease linked to the hepatitis B virus (HBV) is a serious public threat worldwide and in Egypt. The incidence of HBV infection in Egypt is about 1.4%. Accurate liver fibrosis assessments are crucial in the evaluation and follow-up of HBV patients, but traditional biopsies have limitations, prompting the use of non-invasive methods like the vibration controlled transient elastography (VCTE), which may not be available in limited-resource treatment centers. OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to assess the diagnostic accuracy of Fibrosis-4 (FIB-4) and Aminotransferase to Platelet Ratio Index (APRI) compared to VCTE in detecting significant liver fibrosis in adult chronic HBV patients, potentially offering a more accessible and less costly approach to disease management. Methods - In this cross-sectional study, 247 subjects with chronic HBV from Alexandria University Viral Hepatitis Treatment Unit were included. Data collected included demographic details, HBV viral load, liver function tests, Complete Blood Count (CBC), international normalized ratio (INR), prothrombin time, albumin, total and direct bilirubin, APRI score, FIB-4 score, imaging, and VCTE data. IBM SPSS software was used for statistical analysis, with qualitative and quantitative data described appropriately. Logistic regression and receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC) curves were used to identify significant predictors of advanced fibrosis and assess diagnostic performance. RESULTS: Based on VCTE results, 247 chronic hepatitis B patients were classified into two groups: 140 with no or mild fibrosis (F0/1) and 107 with significant fibrosis (F2-F4). Significant differences were found in hemoglobin, albumin, and INR levels between the groups. The FIB-4 and APRI scores were significantly higher in the significant fibrosis group, with median FIB-4 scores of 1.26 vs 0.79 and median APRI scores of 0.40 vs 0.27. The FIB-4 index remained a significant predictor of significant fibrosis in multivariate analysis, with an odds ratio of 1.558. At a cut-off value of >0.88, the FIB-4 score achieved a sensitivity of 65.42% and a specificity of 60.0% in differentiating patients with and without significant fibrosis. CONCLUSION: Although the use of FIB-4 score is potentially useful in resource-limited settings, a significant number of misclassifications can occur due to its moderate sensitivity and specificity which necessitate further incorporation of additional diagnostic methods to ensure the accurate staging of liver fibrosis.

papers.title: High Rates of Advanced Chronic Liver Disease in Patients With Chronic Hepatitis D Virus Infection in Uzbekistan.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is endemic in Uzbekistan. Previous data showed a high prevalence of anti-hepatitis D virus (HDV) antibodies in HBsAg-positive individuals. Limited data are available on disease severity, treatment availability and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) prevalence in patients with chronic HDV infection in Uzbekistan. METHODS: The Scientific Research Institute of Virology (SRIoV) is the leading medical and scientific reference centre for viral hepatitis in Uzbekistan. In this retrospective study, epidemiological, clinical and laboratory data were collected and analysed from all HBsAg-positive patients presenting to the SRIoV between June 2023 and May 2024. Data from HDV-coinfected and HBV-monoinfected patients were compared. RESULTS: Data of 1393 individual patients were included. HDV coinfection was more prevalent than HBV-monoinfection (73.9% [n = 1030/1393]) vs. 26.1% [n = 363/1393]. HDV-infected patients were significantly younger (41.9 vs. 45.4, p upper limit of normal. The HCC detection rate was low in both patient groups due to insufficient screening measures (HDV: n = 7/1030, HBV: n = 11/363). CONCLUSIONS: In this retrospective cohort of 1393 individual patients, HDV coinfection exceeds HBV monoinfection in prevalence and disease severity. Most HDV-infected patients present with advanced liver disease and currently lack access to HDV-directed therapy.

analysis.study_design_and_population: This retrospective study analysed data from 1393 HBsAg-positive patients presenting to the Scientific Research Institute of Virology between June 2023 and May 2024, comparing HDV-coinfected and HBV-monoinfected groups.
analysis.methods: Epidemiological, clinical and laboratory data were collected and analysed from all included patients to assess disease characteristics and outcomes.
analysis.main_results: HDV coinfection was more prevalent than HBV monoinfection (73.9% [n = 1030/1393] vs. 26.1% [n = 363/1393]), with HDV-infected patients being significantly younger (41.9 vs. 45.4, p < 0.001) and having higher ALT levels.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Most HDV-infected patients present with advanced liver disease and currently lack access to HDV-directed therapy, highlighting a need for improved screening and treatment access.

analysis.summary_en: This retrospective study analysed 1393 HBsAg-positive patients in Uzbekistan to compare HDV-coinfected and HBV-monoinfected individuals. HDV coinfection was significantly more prevalent than HBV monoinfection (73.9% vs. 26.1%). HDV-infected patients were younger and exhibited higher ALT levels, indicating greater disease severity. The study found that most HDV-infected patients present with advanced liver disease but lack access to HDV-directed therapy. Additionally, hepatocellular carcinoma detection rates were low in both groups due to insufficient screening measures. These findings highlight the substantial burden of HDV in Uzbekistan and the urgent need for improved diagnostic and therapeutic strategies.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 慢性乙型肝炎 病毒 (HBV) 感染在乌兹别克斯坦流行,但关于慢性 HDV 感染患者的疾病严重程度、治疗 可用性和肝细胞癌 患病率 的数据有限。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项回顾性研究分析了 2023 年 6 月至 2024 年 5 月期间到病毒学科学研究所就诊的 1393 名 HBsAg 阳性患者的数据,比较了 HDV 合并感染组和 HBV 单一感染组。
elements_zh.methods: 收集并分析所有纳入患者的流行病学、临床和实验室数据,以评估疾病特征和结果。
elements_zh.main_results: HDV 合并感染比 HBV 单一感染更为普遍(73.9% [n = 1030/1393] vs. 26.1% [n = 363/1393]),HDV 感染患者明显更年轻(41.9 vs. 45.4,p < 0.001)并且具有较高的 ALT 水平。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,在本 队列研究 中,HDV 合并感染在 患病率 和疾病严重程度方面均超过 HBV 单一感染。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 大多数丁型肝炎病毒感染患者均患有晚期肝病,目前无法获得针对丁型肝炎病毒的治疗,这突出表明需要改进筛查和 治疗 的获取。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于筛查措施不足,两组 HCC 检出率均较低,且由于回顾性设计和单中心数据,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Multi-omics and artificial intelligence nominate PCLAF as a prognostic and druggable target for hepatitis B virus-associated hepatocellular carcinoma.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: PCLAF (PCNA clamp-associated factor) is a protein involved in DNA replication and DNA repair. Aberrant PCLAF expression has been reported in multiple malignancies and is associated with tumor progression and poor clinical outcomes. However, the biological role of PCLAF in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) remains incompletely understood, particularly with respect to its relationship with the tumor immune microenvironment. Therefore, this study aimed to systematically investigate the clinical significance, biological functions, and therapeutic potential of PCLAF in HCC through integrated multi-omics analyses, experimental validation, and drug screening approaches. METHODS: In this study, an integrative multi-omics framework was employed to systematically investigate the molecular characteristics and biological functions of PCLAF in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Transcriptomic datasets from the GEO database (GSE83148 and GSE121248) and the TCGA-LIHC cohort were analyzed to identify differentially expressed genes, followed by protein-protein interaction network construction and machine learning algorithms to screen and validate key hub genes. Pan-cancer analysis, clinicopathological correlation analysis, survival analysis, and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis were subsequently performed to evaluate the clinical significance of PCLAF. Single-cell RNA sequencing data (GSE202642) were analyzed to characterize the cellular heterogeneity of hepatitis B virus-associated HCC and identify PCLAF-associated cell populations. Functional module scoring and gene set enrichment analysis were performed to investigate the biological features of Cycling T cells. Spatial transcriptomic data (GSE245908) were integrated with deconvolution, cell-cell communication, and spatial regulatory analyses to explore the spatial distribution patterns and intercellular interactions associated with PCLAF. To identify potential therapeutic agents targeting PCLAF, virtual drug screening, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulations were conducted. Finally, clinical specimens and HCC cell lines were used for experimental validation. Immunohistochemistry, RT-qPCR, western blotting, colony formation, wound-healing, Transwell migration, and CCK-8 assays were performed to evaluate the effects of PCLAF on HCC cell proliferation and migration. RESULTS: Through integrated transcriptomic analysis, protein-protein interaction network construction, and machine learning approaches, PCLAF was identified as a key candidate gene associated with HCC. Pan-cancer and clinical analyses demonstrated that elevated PCLAF expression was associated with advanced tumor stage, higher pathological grade, and poor prognosis across multiple cancer types. Single-cell transcriptomic analysis revealed that PCLAF was predominantly enriched in Cycling T cells. Functional characterization showed that Cycling T cells exhibited a hyperproliferative but functionally restricted phenotype, characterized by enhanced proliferation accompanied by reduced activation and cytotoxicity. Spatial transcriptomic and cell-cell communication analyses further identified a potential epithelial cell-Cycling T cell interaction network, in which the MIF-CD74-CXCR4 signaling axis represented a major communication pathway. To explore therapeutic opportunities, AI-assisted drug screening, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulations were performed, leading to the identification of BRD-K12189280 as a promising candidate compound targeting PCLAF. Experimental validation confirmed that PCLAF was significantly overexpressed in HCC tissues, and its knockdown markedly inhibited the proliferation, migration, and viability of HCC cells in vitro. CONCLUSION: Our findings demonstrate that PCLAF is significantly upregulated in HBV-associated hepatocellular carcinoma and promotes malignant cellular phenotypes. Multi-omics analyses revealed a close association between PCLAF expression and a hyperproliferative but functionally restricted Cycling T-cell state, highlighting a potential link between tumor progression and immune microenvironment remodeling. These results identify PCLAF as a promising prognostic biomarker and therapeutic target in HCC, while BRD-K12189280 emerges as a potential candidate compound for future drug development.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: PCLAF 是一种参与 DNA 复制和修复的蛋白质,虽然其异常表达与恶性肿瘤有关,但其在肝细胞癌 (HCC) 中的生物学作用仍不完全清楚,特别是在肿瘤免疫微环境方面。本研究旨在通过综合多组学分析、实验验证和药物筛选方法,系统研究 PCLAF 在 HCC 中的临床意义、生物学功能和治疗潜力。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究采用了综合多组学框架,使用来自 GEO 数据库(GSE83148 和 GSE121248)的转录组数据集、TCGA-LIHC 队列研究、单细胞 RNA 测序数据(GSE202642)和空间转录组数据(GSE245908)。该研究包括泛癌分析、临床病理学相关性、生存分析以及使用临床标本和 HCC 细胞系的验证。
elements_zh.methods: 作者进行了蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络构建、机器学习算法和基因集富集分析,以识别和表征关键的枢纽基因。为了评估生物功能和治疗潜力,他们利用了免疫组织化学、RT-qPCR、蛋白质印迹、集落形成、伤口愈合、Transwell 迁移、CCK-8 检测以及通过分子对接和分子动力学模拟进行的人工智能辅助虚拟药物筛选。
elements_zh.main_results: PCLAF被确定为与HCC相关的关键候选基因,其表达升高与肿瘤分期晚期、病理分级较高和预后不良相关。单细胞分析显示 PCLAF 主要富集于表现出过度增殖但功能受限表型的循环 T 细胞,空间分析通过 MIF-CD74-CXCR4 轴确定了上皮细胞-循环 T 细胞相互作用网络。实验验证证实 PCLAF 在 HCC 组织中过度表达,并表明其敲低可抑制增殖、迁移和活力,而 BRD-K12189280 被认为是一种有前途的候选化合物。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,PCLAF 在 HBV 相关肝细胞癌中显着上调,并促进恶性细胞表型。该研究强调了 PCLAF 表达与过度增殖但功能受限的循环 T 细胞状态之间的新联系,表明肿瘤进展与免疫微环境重塑之间存在联系。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果表明 PCLAF 是 HCC 中有前途的预后生物标志物和治疗靶点,而 BRD-K12189280 则成为未来药物开发的潜在候选化合物。该研究提供了对肿瘤进展与免疫微环境之间相互作用的见解,这可能为未来的治疗策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据未报告具体的设计限制、偏见、混杂因素或证据强度的详细评估。该研究仅依赖于抽象证据,这限制了评估研究结果的完整方法论严谨性和普遍性的能力。

Pan-cancer analysis, clinicopathological correlation analysis, survival analysis, and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis were subsequently performed to evaluate the clinical significance of PCLAF. Single-cell RNA sequencing data (GSE202642) were analyzed to characterize the cellular heterogeneity of hepatitis B virus-associated HCC and identify PCLAF-associated cell populations. Functional module scoring and gene set enrichment analysis were performed to investigate the biological features of Cycling T cells. Spatial transcriptomic data (GSE245908) were integrated with deconvolution, cell-cell communication, and spatial regulatory analyses to explore the spatial distribution patterns and intercellular interactions associated with PCLAF. To identify potential therapeutic agents targeting PCLAF, virtual drug screening, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulations were conducted. Finally, clinical specimens and HCC cell lines were used for experimental validation. Immunohistochemistry, RT-qPCR, western blotting, colony formation, wound-healing, Transwell migration, and CCK-8 assays were performed to evaluate the effects of PCLAF on HCC cell proliferation and migration. Pan-cancer and clinical analyses demonstrated that elevated PCLAF expression was associated with advanced tumor stage, higher pathological grade, and poor prognosis across multiple cancer types. Single-cell transcriptomic analysis revealed that PCLAF was predominantly enriched in Cycling T cells. Functional characterization showed that Cycling T cells exhibited a hyperproliferative but functionally restricted phenotype, characterized by enhanced proliferation accompanied by reduced activation and cytotoxicity. Spatial transcriptomic and cell-cell communication analyses further identified a potential epithelial cell-Cycling T cell interaction network, in which the MIF-CD74-CXCR4 signaling axis represented a major communication pathway. Experimental validation confirmed that PCLAF was significantly overexpressed in HCC tissues, and its knockdown markedly inhibited the proliferation, migration, and viability of HCC cells in vitro. Multi-omics analyses revealed a close association between PCLAF expression and a hyperproliferative but functionally restricted Cycling T-cell state, highlighting a potential link between tumor progression and immune microenvironment remodeling. These results identify PCLAF as a promising prognostic biomarker and therapeutic target in HCC, while BRD-K12189280 emerges as a potential candidate compound for future drug development.

papers.title: High Prevalence of Occult Hepatitis B Virus Co-Infection Identified in Treponema Pallidum-Positive Blood Donations: Implications for HBV Risk Reduction
papers.abstract: Over the past decade, the incidence of infectious syphilis has been on the rise in the general Chinese population. Consequently, Treponema Pallidum (TP) testing has been proposed as a surrogate marker for sexually transmitted pathogens and for monitoring risky sexual behaviors among blood donors globally. In addition, sexual contact with individuals chronically infected with hepatitis B virus (HBV) is recognized as one of the primary routes of HBV transmission. Blood donors may acquire HBV infection through sexual contact with chronically infected partners, particularly with occult hepatitis B infections (OBIs), which are characterized by intermittent and extremely low viral loads. Therefore, the prevalence of OBIs among syphilis-positive blood donations and the corresponding risks to blood safety require further investigation. This study aimed to investigate the prevalence of OBIs among syphilis-positive blood donors and assess the surrogate value of TP testing for evaluating OBI-related risks to blood supply. After routine screening using serological assays and nucleic acid testing (NAT), blood donation samples with positive anti-TP enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) results were collected and further confirmed by the Treponema Pallidum Particle Agglutination Assay (TPPA). For blood donations confirmed positive for syphilis, further tests were performed to characterize whether the donations had HBV co-infection, including electrochemiluminescence immunoassay (ECLI) for the detection of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), anti-hepatitis B surface antibody (anti-HBs), hepatitis B e antigen (HBeAg), anti-hepatitis B e antibody (anti-HBe), and anti-hepatitis B core antibody (anti-HBc). Additionally, quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction (qPCR) was used for HBV DNA quantification, and nested PCRs for the S and basal core promoter/precore (BCP/PC) region were conducted in combination with high-volume nucleic acid extraction. Subsequently, molecular characterization of HBV DNA in these co-infected samples was carried out by DNA sequencing to analyze the viral genetic features. Of 252 anti-TP ELISA+ donations screened from 64,871 blood samples, 138 (138/250, 55.2%) donations were confirmed syphilis-positive but NAT−, among which 78 (78/138, 56.5%) were anti-HBc-positive, and 88 (88/138, 63.7%) had anti-HBs. Notably, seven donations (7/138, 5.1%) were diagnosed as OBI co-infections, and available sequence analysis revealed that three cases were genotype B and one case was genotype C. In addition, several mutations in the S region of the HBV genome were identified, including Q101R, K122R, Q129H, T131N, M133T, G145R, and Y161F mutations. Furthermore, nucleotide mutations such as T1719G, A1752T, G1896A, and A1762T/G1764A in the BCP/PC regions were also detected in these OBI donations. These mutations may contribute to the extremely low HBV viral loads and/or failure in HBsAg detection, collectively leading to OBIs. These data indicate that syphilis screening of blood donors has potential to serve as an additional safeguard measure for excluding donations co-infected with OBIs. The high prevalence of undetected OBIs in syphilis-positive blood donors further supports that syphilis screening has the potential to serve as a surrogate marker for HBV-related risks in the blood supply.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study was needed to investigate the prevalence of occult hepatitis B virus (HBV) infections among syphilis-positive blood donors and assess the surrogate value of Treponema pallidum (TP) testing for evaluating OBI-related risks to blood supply, given the rising incidence of syphilis and the recognition of sexual contact as a primary route of HBV transmission.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This study analyzed blood donation samples from a total of 64,871 individuals, focusing on 252 anti-TP ELISA-positive donations that were further confirmed by TPPA testing, with 138 confirmed syphilis-positive but NAT-negative donations included in the analysis.
analysis.methods: Blood donations confirmed positive for syphilis underwent additional testing for HBV co-infection, including ECLI for HBsAg, anti-HBs, HBeAg, anti-HBe, and anti-HBc, followed by qPCR for HBV DNA quantification, nested PCRs for the S and BCP/PC regions, and molecular characterization via DNA sequencing.
analysis.main_results: Among 138 syphilis-positive donations, 78 (56.5%) were anti-HBc-positive, 88 (63.7%) had anti-HBs, and 7 (5.1%) were diagnosed as OBI co-infections; sequence analysis revealed three cases of genotype B and one case of genotype C, along with several mutations in the S region and BCP/PC regions.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that the high prevalence of undetected OBIs in syphilis-positive blood donors supports the potential of syphilis screening as a surrogate marker for HBV-related risks in the blood supply, with mutations in the HBV genome potentially contributing to the low viral loads and HBsAg detection failure.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings suggest that syphilis screening of blood donors could serve as an additional safeguard measure to exclude donations co-infected with OBIs, thereby enhancing blood safety and reducing HBV transmission risks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate, as the study was limited to a single-center analysis of confirmed syphilis-positive donations, and the sample size for OBI co-infections was small (n=7), which may limit generalizability.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the prevalence of occult hepatitis B virus (OBI) co-infections among syphilis-positive blood donors to assess the surrogate value of Treponema pallidum (TP) testing for evaluating OBI-related risks to blood supply. Among 138 confirmed syphilis-positive donations, 7 (5.1%) were diagnosed as OBI co-infections, with three cases of genotype B and one case of genotype C detected. The study identified several mutations in the HBV genome that may contribute to low viral loads and HBsAg detection failure. The findings suggest that syphilis screening could serve as an additional safeguard measure to exclude OBI co-infected donations, enhancing blood safety. However, the evidence strength is moderate due to the small sample size of OBI cases and single-center design.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 鉴于梅毒 发病率 的上升以及认识到性接触是 HBV 传播 的主要途径,需要开展这项研究来调查梅毒阳性献血者中隐匿性 发病率 (HBV) 感染的 发病率,并评估梅毒螺旋体 (TP) 检测对评估 OBI 相关血液供应风险的替代价值。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项研究分析了总共 64,871 人的献血样本,重点关注了 252 例抗 TP ELISA 阳性献血者,这些献血者经 TPPA 检测进一步证实,其中 138 例确诊梅毒阳性但 NAT 阴性献血者纳入分析。
elements_zh.methods: 确认梅毒阳性的献血者接受了额外的 HBV 合并感染检测,包括针对 HBsAg、抗 HBs、HBeAg、抗 HBe 和抗 HBc 的 ECLI,然后进行 HBV DNA 定量的 qPCR、针对 S 和 BCP/PC 区域的嵌套 PCR 以及通过 DNA 测序进行分子表征。
elements_zh.main_results: 138例梅毒阳性献血者中,78例(56.5%)抗-HBc阳性,88例(63.7%)抗-HBs阳性,7例(5.1%)诊断为OBI合并感染;序列分析显示3例B基因型和1例C基因型,以及S区和BCP/PC区的数个突变。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,梅毒阳性献血者中未检测到的 OBI 较高的 患病率 支持梅毒筛查作为血液供应中 HBV 相关风险替代标记的潜力,而 HBV 基因组 中的 突变 可能导致低病毒载量和 HBsAg 检测失败。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,对献血者进行梅毒筛查可以作为一项额外的保障措施,排除与 OBI 合并感染的献血者,从而提高血液安全并降低 HBV 传播 风险。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,因为该研究仅限于对已确认的梅毒阳性捐赠者的单中心分析,并且 OBI 合并感染的样本量较小(n = 7),这可能限制了普遍性。

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,对献血者进行梅毒筛查可以作为一项额外的保障措施,排除与 OBI 合并感染的献血者,从而提高血液安全并降低 HBV 传播 风险。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,因为该研究仅限于对已确认的梅毒阳性捐赠者的单中心分析,并且 OBI 合并感染的样本量较小(n = 7),这可能限制了普遍性。

papers.title: The efficacy of traditional Chinese medicine on immune function in patients with hepatitis B-related liver fibrosis or cirrhosis: a systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.abstract: Objective Currently, there is no effective treatment to reverse hepatitis B-related liver fibrosis or cirrhosis. Current nucleos(t)ide analogs (NAs) control but rarely eliminate hepatitis B virus (HBV), leaving chronic hepatitis B at risk of developing liver fibrosis/cirrhosis. Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) shows promise in slowing the progression of hepatitis B-related liver fibrosis/cirrhosis, but its impact on immune function remains debated. Methods The electronic databases, including Chinese National Knowledge Infrastructure, Wanfang, SinoMed, Weipu, PubMed, Web of Science, EMBASE, and Cochrane databases, were retrieved (April 7, 2026), and the randomized controlled trials (RCTs) that met the inclusion criteria were included. Methodologic quality assessment of the included RCTs was done based on the Cochrane RoB 2 tool. Subsequently, the valid data were screened and analyzed by meta-analysis with Review Manager 5.4.1, and the quality of the evidence was assessed using the GRADE method. This study was registered in the PROSPERO (CRD420261351373). Results Finally, 25 RCTs were included, containing 2,585 patients with hepatitis B-related liver fibrosis or cirrhosis. Risk of bias evaluations suggested some concerns for the majority of RCTs. The results of meta-analysis indicated that TCM with NAs could improve CD3 + [MD = 5.83, 95%CI (3.93, 7.73), p < 0.00001], CD4 + [MD = 4.32, 95%CI (3.56, 5.08), p < 0.00001], CD4+/CD8 + [MD = 0.24, 95%CI (0.18, 0.29), p < 0.00001], and NK cells, and decrease CD8 + cells [MD = −2.67, 95%CI (−3.46, −1.89), p < 0.00001], interleukin (IL)-6, transforming growth factor (TGF- β ), tumor necrosis factor- α (TNF-α), hyaluronic acid (HA), laminin (LN), type IV collagen (IV-C), type III procollagen (PC-III), liver stiffness measurement (LSM), alanine aminotransferase (ALT), aspartate aminotransferase (AST), total bilirubin, and albumin in serum compared with NAs alone. Moreover, descriptive data showed that TCM was safe, and the funnel plot suggested the included research might have slight publication bias. The GRADE classification showed that the certainty of evidence was low for the immune function, liver function, and liver fibrosis indexes. Conclusion A combination of NAs and TCM could improve immune cell metrics, cytokines, liver function indexes, and liver fibrosis indexes of patients with hepatitis B-related liver fibrosis or cirrhosis. Due to the low quality of research, more high-quality RCTs are needed to improve the level of evidence. Systematic review registration https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420261351373 .

papers.title_original: The efficacy of traditional Chinese medicine on immune function in patients with hepatitis B-related liver fibrosis or cirrhosis: a systematic review and meta-analysis

analysis.scope_and_question: The review evaluates the efficacy of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) combined with nucleos(t)ide analogs (NAs) on immune function in patients with hepatitis B-related liver fibrosis or cirrhosis, addressing the need for effective treatments to reverse these conditions given that NAs control but rarely eliminate HBV.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: This systematic review and meta-analysis, registered in PROSPERO, searched Chinese National Knowledge Infrastructure, Wanfang, SinoMed, Weipu, PubMed, Web of Science, EMBASE, and Cochrane databases on April 7, 2026. It included 25 randomized controlled trials with 2,585 patients, assessed methodologic quality using the Cochrane RoB 2 tool, analyzed data with Review Manager 5.4.1, and evaluated evidence certainty using the GRADE method.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Meta-analysis results indicated that TCM combined with NAs significantly improved immune cell metrics (CD3+, CD4+, CD4+/CD8+, NK cells) and decreased CD8+ cells, cytokines (IL-6, TGF-β, TNF-α), liver fibrosis indexes (HA, LN, IV-C, PC-III), liver stiffness measurement, and liver function indexes (ALT, AST, total bilirubin, albumin) compared with NAs alone. Descriptive data suggested TCM was safe.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: Risk of bias evaluations suggested some concerns for the majority of included RCTs. The GRADE classification indicated that the certainty of evidence was low for immune function, liver function, and liver fibrosis indexes. A funnel plot suggested the included research might have slight publication bias.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: More high-quality randomized controlled trials are needed to improve the level of evidence regarding the efficacy of TCM in this patient population.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated the efficacy of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) combined with nucleos(t)ide analogs (NAs) on immune function in 2,585 patients with hepatitis B-related liver fibrosis or cirrhosis. Meta-analysis results indicated that the combination therapy significantly improved immune cell metrics, including CD3+, CD4+, and NK cells, while reducing CD8+ cells and inflammatory cytokines. Additionally, TCM with NAs improved liver fibrosis indexes and liver function tests compared to NAs alone. However, risk of bias evaluations raised concerns about the majority of the 25 included randomized controlled trials, and the GRADE assessment rated the certainty of evidence as low. Although TCM appeared safe with slight potential publication bias, the authors conclude that more high-quality RCTs are necessary to strengthen the evidence base.

elements_en.scope_and_question: The review evaluates the efficacy of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) combined with nucleos(t)ide analogs (NAs) on immune function in patients with hepatitis B-related liver fibrosis or cirrhosis, addressing the need for effective treatments to reverse these conditions given that NAs control but rarely eliminate HBV.
elements_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: This systematic review and meta-analysis, registered in PROSPERO, searched Chinese National Knowledge Infrastructure, Wanfang, SinoMed, Weipu, PubMed, Web of Science, EMBASE, and Cochrane databases on April 7, 2026. It included 25 randomized controlled trials with 2,585 patients, assessed methodologic quality using the Cochrane RoB 2 tool, analyzed data with Review Manager 5.4.1, and evaluated evidence certainty using the GRADE method.
elements_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Meta-analysis results indicated that TCM combined with NAs significantly improved immune cell metrics (CD3+, CD4+, CD4+/CD8+, NK cells) and decreased CD8+ cells, cytokines (IL-6, TGF-β, TNF-α), liver fibrosis indexes (HA, LN, IV-C, PC-III), liver stiffness measurement, and liver function indexes (ALT, AST, total bilirubin, albumin) compared with NAs alone. elements_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: Risk of bias evaluations suggested some concerns for the majority of included RCTs. The GRADE classification indicated that the certainty of evidence was low for immune function, liver function, and liver fibrosis indexes. A funnel plot suggested the included research might have slight publication bias.
elements_en.research_and_practice_implications: More high-quality randomized controlled trials are needed to improve the level of evidence regarding the efficacy of TCM in this patient population.

papers.title_zh: 中药对乙型肝炎相关性肝纤维化或肝硬化患者免疫功能的影响:系统评价和荟萃分析
papers.source_body_en: Objective Currently, there is no effective treatment to reverse hepatitis B-related liver fibrosis or cirrhosis. Current nucleos(t)ide analogs (NAs) control but rarely eliminate hepatitis B virus (HBV), leaving chronic hepatitis B at risk of developing liver fibrosis/cirrhosis. Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) shows promise in slowing the progression of hepatitis B-related liver fibrosis/cirrhosis, but its impact on immune function remains debated. Methods The electronic databases, including Chinese National Knowledge Infrastructure, Wanfang, SinoMed, Weipu, PubMed, Web of Science, EMBASE, and Cochrane databases, were retrieved (April 7, 2026), and the randomized controlled trials (RCTs) that met the inclusion criteria were included. Methodologic quality assessment of the included RCTs was done based on the Cochrane RoB 2 tool. Subsequently, the valid data were screened and analyzed by meta-analysis with Review Manager 5.4.1, and the quality of the evidence was assessed using the GRADE method. This study was registered in the PROSPERO (CRD420261351373). Results Finally, 25 RCTs were included, containing 2,585 patients with hepatitis B-related liver fibrosis or cirrhosis. Risk of bias evaluations suggested some concerns for the majority of RCTs. The results of meta-analysis indicated that TCM with NAs could improve CD3 + [MD = 5.83, 95%CI (3.93, 7.73), p < 0.00001], CD4 + [MD = 4.32, 95%CI (3.56, 5.08), p < 0.00001], CD4+/CD8 + [MD = 0.24, 95%CI (0.18, 0.29), p < 0.00001], and NK cells, and decrease CD8 + cells [MD = −2.67, 95%CI (−3.46, −1.89), p < 0.00001], interleukin (IL)-6, transforming growth factor (TGF- β ), tumor necrosis factor- α (TNF-α), hyaluronic acid (HA), laminin (LN), type IV collagen (IV-C), type III procollagen (PC-III), liver stiffness measurement (LSM), alanine aminotransferase (ALT), aspartate aminotransferase (AST), total bilirubin, and albumin in serum compared with NAs alone. Moreover, descriptive data showed that TCM was safe, and the funnel plot suggested the included research might have slight publication bias. The GRADE classification showed that the certainty of evidence was low for the immune function, liver function, and liver fibrosis indexes. Conclusion A combination of NAs and TCM could improve immune cell metrics, cytokines, liver function indexes, and liver fibrosis indexes of patients with hepatitis B-related liver fibrosis or cirrhosis. Due to the low quality of research, more high-quality RCTs are needed to improve the level of evidence. Systematic review registration https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420261351373 .

papers.title: Skrining HBSAG untuk Deteksi Dini Infeksi Hepatitis B pada Populasi Dewasa di Kelurahan Semanan
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B remains a public health problem with the potential to cause chronic liver disease, cirrhosis, and hepatocellular carcinoma. Early detection through community-based screening is essential to improve case identification and prevent transmission. This community service activity aimed to conduct HBsAg screening and provide education regarding hepatitis B among the community. A total of 155 participants were involved, with a mean age of 46.49 ± 10.29 years and an age range of 19–80 years. Most participants were female, accounting for 109 individuals (70.3%), while males accounted for 46 individuals (29.7%). Screening results showed that 153 participants (98.7%) were HBsAg negative and 2 participants (1.3%) were HBsAg positive. Gender-based distribution demonstrated that all positive cases were found among female participants. The low proportion of HBsAg-positive results indicates that most screened individuals did not have active hepatitis B infection. Nevertheless, the identification of positive cases highlights the importance of regular screening and health education as strategies for early detection, prevention of liver disease complications, and control of hepatitis B transmission within the community.

papers.title_zh: 乙型肝炎 (Hepatitis B) 流行病学调查
papers.source_body_en: Hepatitis B remains a public health problem with the potential to cause chronic liver disease, cirrhosis, and hepatocellular carcinoma. Early detection through community-based screening is essential to improve case identification and prevent transmission. This community service activity aimed to conduct HBsAg screening and provide education regarding hepatitis B among the community. A total of 155 participants were involved, with a mean age of 46.49 ± 10.29 years and an age range of 19–80 years. Most participants were female, accounting for 109 individuals (70.3%), while males accounted for 46 individuals (29.7%). Screening results showed that 153 participants (98.7%) were HBsAg negative and 2 participants (1.3%) were HBsAg positive. Gender-based distribution demonstrated that all positive cases were found among female participants. The low proportion of HBsAg-positive results indicates that most screened individuals did not have active hepatitis B infection. Nevertheless, the identification of positive cases highlights the importance of regular screening and health education as strategies for early detection, prevention of liver disease complications, and control of hepatitis B transmission within the community.

papers.title: Antiviral activity of novel chemical compound 0411, derived from FUBP1-IN-1 against hepatitis B virus by upregulation of DUSP5
papers.abstract: Current first-line drugs rarely achieve functional curesfor chronic hepatitis B patients, which urges us to explore novel anti-HBV therapeutic strategies. In this study, we found that the novel chemical compound 0411, a derivative of the FUBP1 inhibitor, FUBPI-IN-1, significantly suppressed HBV transcription both in vitro and in vivo. Transcriptome sequencing demonstrated that 0411 treatment markedly upregulated the expression of the dual-specificity phosphatase 5 (DUSP5) gene, a crucial regulator of the MAPK pathway. Further functional studies illustrated that the antiviral activity of compound 0411 was dependent on DUSP5. Mechanismly, 0411 treatment in HepG2-NTCP cells enhances the deposition of active histone modifications on the promoter of DUSP5 significantly. In conclusion, our findings demonstrate the potential of 0411 as an effective agent against HBV transcription.

papers.title: Seroprevalence and associated risk factors of Hepatitis B and C in a cross sectional study from North Kashmir
papers.abstract: India has a high burden of endemic HBV and HCV infections, with national seroprevalence of 0.95% for HBV and 0.32% for HCV. In Jammu and Kashmir, the prevalence of HBV and HCV is believed to be elevated much higher than the national average. The ever-increasing incidence of both HBV and HCV infections demand region-specific screening to assess the burden of disease, risk factors and plan control measures. A cross- sectional study was conducted at a tertiary-care hospital in North Kashmir, India, from September 2023-November 2024.Enzyme linked immunosorbent assay(ELISA) method was used for screening Hepatitis B surface antigen and antibodies against HCV. The risk factors associated with HBV and HCV infections were analyzed statistically by using logistic regression model. The model was evaluated using AUC-ROC and F1 score. A total of 1081 and 1087 samples were analyzed for HBsAg and anti-HCV, which showed prevalence of 3.42% and 18.30%, respectively. Among the identified risk factors, intra venous drug usage (aOR = 18.4, P =0.000) represents the most common means of HCV transmission. Additionally, other risk factors like fever, patient type, age group of 20–40 years, and planned surgery showed statistically significant associations with HCV infection. The study highlights the alarming burden of HBV and HCV infection in North Kashmir compared to the national prevalence. The high prevalence of HCV infection and HBV/HCV co-infection particularly among the young population, calls for urgent, region specific screening and early diagnosis to prevent further spread of viral hepatitis infection.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 印度地方性 HBV 和 HCV 感染负担较高,全国 HBV 感染 血清流行率 为 0.95%,HCV 感染率为 0.32%。在查谟和克什米尔,乙肝病毒和丙肝病毒的 患病率 被认为远高于全国平均水平。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2023 年 9 月至 2024 年 11 月在印度北克什米尔的一家三级医院进行了一项横断面研究。该研究分别分析了 1081 个和 1087 个样本的 HBsAg 和抗 HCV。
elements_zh.methods: 采用Logistic回归模型对HBV、HCV感染的危险因素进行统计分析。使用 AUC-ROC 和 F1 评分评估模型。采用酶联免疫吸附试验(ELISA)方法筛查乙型肝炎表面抗原和抗HCV抗体。
elements_zh.main_results: 总共对 1081 份和 1087 份样本进行了 HBsAg 和抗 HCV 分析,结果显示 患病率 分别为 3.42% 和 18.30%。在已确定的危险因素中,静脉注射药物(aOR = 18.4,P = 0.000)代表 HCV 传播 最常见的手段。此外,发烧、患者类型、20-40 岁年龄组和计划手术等其他危险因素与 HCV 感染存在统计学显着相关性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调了与全国 患病率 相比,克什米尔北部的 HBV 和 HCV 感染负担令人震惊。HCV 感染和 HBV/HCV 混合感染的高 患病率,特别是在年轻人中,需要进行紧急、区域特定的筛查和早期 诊断,以防止病毒性肝炎感染的进一步传播。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为特定区域的筛查和早期 诊断 策略提供信息,以防止病毒性肝炎感染的进一步传播。HBV 和 HCV 感染的 发病率 不断增加,需要针对特定​​区域进行筛查,以评估疾病负担、危险因素并计划控制措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告该研究的局限性。证据仅是抽象的,并对研究结果提供了适度的评估。

papers.title: Epidemiological characteristics of emergency situations among medical workers and the detection of markers of HBV‐infection in donors of blood and its components in the Republic of Tatarstan
papers.abstract: The aim of this study was to epidemiologically characterize medical emergencies and analyze the detection of hepatitis B markers in blood and blood component donors at the regional level. Materials and methods. Descriptive epidemiological study with data processing in Excel, 2016. The frequency, structure, and causes of emergency situations among healthcare workers, as well as information on the frequency of detection of HBsAg and/or anti-HBc totals in donors of blood and its components for 2015–2024 in the Republic of Tatarstan, were analyzed. From 2015 to 2022, a downward trend in the incidence of chronic HBV infection was observed (9.2 and 4.1 per 100,000 population, respectively), while in 2023–2024, an upward trend was observed (7.1 and 10.8, respectively). Positive HBsAg is detected in the serum of 2–12 bloodand blood component donors annually, representing 0.1–0.4 cases per 1,000 donors; anti-HBc total is detected in 64–606 donors, representing 2.3–26.2 cases per 1,000 donors. Of all registered emergency situations, 75–90 % were medical, with nursing staff accounting for the majority of casualties (57.1 %), and needlestick injuries (74.4 %) being the primary cause. The persistent prevalence of HBV infection markers in blood and blood component donors and ongoing workplace emergencies in healthcare organizations highlight the importance of further research into the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of hepatitis B.

papers.title: Efficacy and safety of tenofovir alafenamide in HBeAg-positive and negative chronic hepatitis B patients aged over 30 years with normal ALT and detectable HBV DNA: a 96-week retrospective two-center study
papers.abstract: Background The 2022 update of Chinese Guidelines for Chronic Hepatitis B (CHB) Management advocates initiating antiviral therapy regardless of alanine aminotransferase (ALT) status in HBV DNA-positive patients aged > 30 years. This study aimed to investigate the virological response and renal safety profile of tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) in this specific population through both short-term (48-week) and extended (96-week) observations. Methods In this multicenter retrospective cohort study, 122 treatment-naïve CHB patients meeting inclusion criteria from two tertiary hospitals (Yantai Qishan Hospital and Yantai Yuhuangding Hospital) underwent standard TAF monotherapy (25 mg/day). Serial assessments of virological parameters (HBV DNA quantification) and renal function markers (serum creatinine, estimated glomerular filtration rate) were conducted at baseline, week 48, and week 96. Results After 48 weeks of TAF treatment, 74.6% of the 122 enrolled patients achieved HBV DNA conversion (HBV DNA 30 years with normal ALT and active viremia, accompanied by favorable renal tolerability throughout the 96-week treatment period. Extended follow-up is ongoing to establish long-term clinical outcomes.

papers.title: Novel HBx-interacting host cellular factors regulate dynamic nuclear and cytoplasmic localization of Hepatitis B virus X protein (HBx)
papers.abstract: The hepatitis B virus (HBV) X protein (HBx) is a key player in viral transcription, replication, and HBV-associated hepatocarcinogenesis. Several novel HBx-interacting host cellular factors: DDX1, DDX3, MOV10 RNA helicases, INI1/hSNF5 chromatin-remodeling factor, Rad18 DNA repair enzyme, and CPSF6 cleavage factor were identified. DDX1, DDX3, and MOV10 colocalized with HBx in cytoplasmic foci or aggregates. In contrast, INI1/hSNF5 and CPSF6 relocalized with HBx in nuclear speckles, interchromatin granule clusters (IGCs), and/or PML-nuclear bodies. Rad18 sequestered HBx in the nucleoli. Importantly, DDX3, MOV10, and INI1/hSNF5 restricted HBV replication, whereas CPSF6 facilitated HBV replication. Furthermore, DDX1 enhanced HBx-mediated NF-κB transcription, whereas MOV10 and Rad18 inhibited it. Altogether, HBx-interacting host factors determine dynamic nuclear and cytoplasmic localization of HBx and regulate HBV replication and HBx-mediated transcription.

analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in a laboratory setting using human HBV infection models. It involved the identification of host factors interacting with HBx through biochemical and cellular assays.
analysis.methods: The researchers used biochemical and cellular assays to identify HBx-interacting host factors, including colocalization studies in cytoplasmic foci or aggregates and nuclear speckles, interchromatin granule clusters (IGCs), and/or PML-nuclear bodies. They also assessed the impact of these factors on HBV replication and HBx-mediated transcription.
analysis.main_results: DDX1, DDX3, and MOV10 colocalized with HBx in cytoplasmic foci or aggregates. INI1/hSNF5 and CPSF6 relocalized with HBx in nuclear speckles, IGCs, and/or PML-nuclear bodies. Rad18 sequestered HBx in the nucleoli.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that HBx-interacting host factors determine the dynamic nuclear and cytoplasmic localization of HBx and regulate HBV replication and HBx-mediated transcription. analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide insights into the molecular mechanisms of HBV replication and pathogenesis, which could inform the development of targeted therapies and improve understanding of HBV-associated hepatocarcinogenesis.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on abstract-only evidence and does not provide detailed statistical analyses or experimental controls. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the lack of comprehensive data on the functional impact of these factors in vivo.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the interaction of HBV X protein (HBx) with host cellular factors and their role in regulating HBx localization and viral replication. The research identifies several novel factors, including DDX1, DDX3, MOV10, INI1/hSNF5, CPSF6, and Rad18, which interact with HBx in different subcellular compartments. DDX3, MOV10, and INI1/hSNF5 were found to restrict HBV replication, while CPSF6 facilitated it. Additionally, DDX1 enhanced HBx-mediated NF-κB transcription, whereas MOV10 and Rad18 inhibited it. The authors conclude that these HBx-interacting factors determine the dynamic localization of HBx and regulate HBV replication and transcription. The study provides important insights into the molecular mechanisms of HBV pathogenesis, which may have implications for the development of targeted therapies. However, the evidence is based solely on abstract information and lacks detailed experimental validation.

elements_zh.main_results: DDX1、DDX3 和 MOV10 与 HBx 共定位于细胞质灶或聚集体中。INI1/hSNF5 和 CPSF6 与 HBx 一起重新定位于核斑点、IGC 和/或 PML 核体中。Rad18 将 HBx 隔离在核仁中。

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅基于抽象证据,不提供详细的统计分析或实验对照。由于缺乏有关这些因素体内功能影响的全面数据,证据强度中等。

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to assess the current burden of hepatitis B virus infection in the United States from 2017 to 2023, addressing the need for updated epidemiological data to inform public health strategies.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This study was conducted across multiple centers in the United States, including Stanford University, Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center, and Mayo Clinic, focusing on hepatitis B virus infection data from 2017 to 2023.
analysis.methods: The analysis involved reviewing and synthesizing hepatitis B virus infection data using standardized epidemiological methods and statistical analyses to determine burden estimates.
analysis.main_results: The study provided updated estimates of hepatitis B virus infection prevalence and incidence in the United States during the specified period, though specific numerical findings were not detailed in the supplied evidence.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as critical for understanding the evolving landscape of hepatitis B virus infection in the U.S., highlighting the novelty of the most recent data available.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform surveillance, prevention, and treatment strategies for hepatitis B virus infection, particularly in guiding public health interventions and resource allocation.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The supplied evidence does not report specific limitations or the strength of the evidence, though the study's reliance on existing data may introduce potential biases or gaps in completeness.

papers.title: Two Diagnostic Challenges in Hepatitis B Serology: Low HBsAg S/CO Values and Isolated Anti-HBc Positivity
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) signal-to-cutoff (S/CO) values and isolated anti-HBc positivity represent two significant diagnostic challenges in hepatitis B virus (HBV) serology. This retrospective study, conducted in Karabük between 2021 and 2025, aimed to evaluate the correlation between these profiles and HBV DNA positivity to determine the optimal S/CO thresholds for confirmatory testing and clarify the clinical relevance of isolated anti-HBc reactivity. Among 17,356 patients screened for anti-HBc, isolated anti-HBc positivity was identified in 506 patients (2.9%), of whom 3.2% had detectable HBV DNA. Positivity was significantly higher in patients older than 50 years and in the Gastroenterology department. Separately, 213 specimens with HBsAg S/CO values between 1.0 and 10.0 underwent HBV DNA confirmation testing. ROC analysis yielded an excellent area under the curve of 0.937, with an S/CO threshold of ≥3.04, achieving 100% sensitivity for HBV DNA detection. All specimens with S/CO values between 1.0 and 3.0 were HBV DNA-negative. In this study population, no serum HBV DNA positivity was detected among samples with S/CO values below 3.04, suggesting that HBV DNA testing may help avoid unnecessary confirmatory work-up in this range. Anti-HBc screening should be prioritized in older patients. S/CO-based confirmatory algorithm using HBV DNA testing may improve diagnostic accuracy and reduce unnecessary clinical interventions in routine hepatitis B screening programs.

papers.title: Promotion of hepatitis B virus infection by extracellular apolipoprotein E
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major burden to global health, affecting more than 250 million people worldwide. HBV and host interactions determine the HBV chronicity. Our previous studies have found that human apolipoprotein E (apoE) is incorporated in infectious HBV virions and plays important roles in HBV infection and morphogenesis. ApoE mediates HBV cell attachment through its interaction with cell surface receptors such as the low-density lipoprotein receptor (LDLR) family members and heparan sulfate proteoglycans (HSPGs). More importantly, both HBV-associated apoE and its expression in hepatocytes are critical for efficient HBV infection. However, the importance of extracellular apoE in HBV infection has not been examined. In the present study, we have determined the role of extracellular apoE in HBV infection in vitro . ApoE is an exchangeable apolipoprotein and was found to be efficiently transferred to HBV virions when mixed with an apoE-null HBV, as suggested by the results obtained from coimmunoprecipitation experiments. More significantly, extracellular apoE3 lipoproteins significantly promoted HBV infection in a dose-dependent manner when mixed with apoE-null HBV prior to infection. The cell culture supernatants obtained from apoE3-overexpressing HepG2 cells, sera derived from human apoE3-knockin mice, and a purified recombinant apoE expressed in E. coli were all able to significantly promote HBV infection. Additionally, extracellular apoE3 lipoproteins could dose-dependently enhance HBV attachment to HepG2 NTCP cells. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that extracellular apoE3 plays a key role in HBV infection by exchangeable transfer to the HBV envelope and mediation of HBV cell attachment. IMPORTANCE Human apolipoprotein E (apoE) is implicated in the infection of different viruses as an entry-promoting factor. Our previous studies have demonstrated that apoE is enriched in the envelopes of hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV)and promotes their infection and morphogenesis in vitro . In the present study, we have uncovered a previously unrecognized role of extracellular apoE3 in the promotion of HBV infection. Extracellular apoE3 was efficiently transferred to the HBV envelope when incubated with an apoE-deficient HBV. Strikingly, apoE-null HBV infection was proportionally enhanced by the increasing amounts of apoE3-containing mouse sera, as well as the supernatants of apoE3-overexpressing HepG2 cells. Likewise, a lipidated recombinant apoE3 significantly promoted HBV infection in a dose-dependent manner. Additionally, extracellular apoE3 promoted regular HBV infection. Moreover, extracellular apoE3 enhanced HBV cell attachment. These findings suggest that apoE3 lipoproteins with various densities in the plasma of chronic hepatitis B patients may play a key role in HBV infection and pathogenesis in vivo .

papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major burden to global health, affecting more than 250 million people worldwide. HBV and host interactions determine the HBV chronicity. Our previous studies have found that human apolipoprotein E (apoE) is incorporated in infectious HBV virions and plays important roles in HBV infection and morphogenesis. ApoE mediates HBV cell attachment through its interaction with cell surface receptors such as the low-density lipoprotein receptor (LDLR) family members and heparan sulfate proteoglycans (HSPGs). More importantly, both HBV-associated apoE and its expression in hepatocytes are critical for efficient HBV infection. However, the importance of extracellular apoE in HBV infection has not been examined. In the present study, we have determined the role of extracellular apoE in HBV infection in vitro . ApoE is an exchangeable apolipoprotein and was found to be efficiently transferred to HBV virions when mixed with an apoE-null HBV, as suggested by the results obtained from coimmunoprecipitation experiments. More significantly, extracellular apoE3 lipoproteins significantly promoted HBV infection in a dose-dependent manner when mixed with apoE-null HBV prior to infection. The cell culture supernatants obtained from apoE3-overexpressing HepG2 cells, sera derived from human apoE3-knockin mice, and a purified recombinant apoE expressed in E. coli were all able to significantly promote HBV infection. Additionally, extracellular apoE3 lipoproteins could dose-dependently enhance HBV attachment to HepG2 NTCP cells. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that extracellular apoE3 plays a key role in HBV infection by exchangeable transfer to the HBV envelope and mediation of HBV cell attachment. IMPORTANCE Human apolipoprotein E (apoE) is implicated in the infection of different viruses as an entry-promoting factor. Our previous studies have demonstrated that apoE is enriched in the envelopes of hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV)and promotes their infection and morphogenesis in vitro . In the present study, we have uncovered a previously unrecognized role of extracellular apoE3 in the promotion of HBV infection. Extracellular apoE3 was efficiently transferred to the HBV envelope when incubated with an apoE-deficient HBV. Strikingly, apoE-null HBV infection was proportionally enhanced by the increasing amounts of apoE3-containing mouse sera, as well as the supernatants of apoE3-overexpressing HepG2 cells. Likewise, a lipidated recombinant apoE3 significantly promoted HBV infection in a dose-dependent manner. Additionally, extracellular apoE3 promoted regular HBV infection. Moreover, extracellular apoE3 enhanced HBV cell attachment. These findings suggest that apoE3 lipoproteins with various densities in the plasma of chronic hepatitis B patients may play a key role in HBV infection and pathogenesis in vivo .

papers.title: Development and validation of a risk prediction model for preterm birth in women concurrent with Hepatitis B virus carrier status and gestational diabetes mellitus
papers.abstract: Preterm birth is a major adverse neonatal outcome that has been associated with maternal hepatitis B virus carrier status. Co-occurrence of hepatitis B virus carrier status carrier status and gestational diabetes mellitus is associated with an increased risk of preterm birth compared with hepatitis B virus carrier status alone. This study aimed to develop and externally validate a clinically applicable multivariable prediction model incorporating both clinical risk factors and maternal blood biomarkers to estimate preterm birth risk among women with concurrent hepatitis B virus carrier status and gestational diabetes mellitus. A retrospective analysis was performed using clinical data and maternal blood biomarkers from 882 pregnant women with hepatitis B virus carrier status and gestational diabetes mellitus who delivered at Women’s Hospital, in Zhejiang Province, China, from January 2015 to December 2024. Following data preprocessing, participants were randomly allocated to training and validation sets at a 7:3 ratio. Variable selection was performed using the least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO), and univariate and multivariable logistic regression analyses were subsequently conducted to assess the associations of clinical variables and maternal blood biomarkers with preterm birth in women with concurrent hepatitis B virus carrier status and gestational diabetes mellitus. A nomogram was developed to facilitate clinical application. Model discrimination and calibration were evaluated using receiver operating characteristic curve analysis and calibration plots, respectively, while clinical utility was assessed through decision curve analysis. A total of 847 women with hepatitis B virus carrier status and gestational diabetes mellitus were included in this study, of whom 187 (22%) experienced preterm birth. Multivariable logistic regression analysis identified pre-pregnancy body mass index, diastolic blood pressure, systolic blood pressure, alanine aminotransferase, placenta previa, white blood cell count, and maternal blood biomarkers—including total protein, total bile acid, total thyroxine, mode of membrane rupture, and prothrombin time—as independent predictors of preterm birth. These variables were incorporated into a nomogram, which demonstrated good calibration and discrimination. The area under the curve was 0.854 (95% CI: 0.823–0.881) in the training set and 0.754 (95% CI: 0.697–0.806) in the validation set. Decision curve analysis indicated that the nomogram provided favorable clinical utility for predicting preterm birth. The model demonstrated good discriminative ability and calibration, enabling accurate prediction of preterm birth risk in women with concurrent hepatitis B virus carrier status and gestational diabetes mellitus.

papers.title_zh: 患有 乙型肝炎病毒 携带者状态和妊娠糖尿病的女性早产风险预测模型的开发和验证

Co-occurrence of hepatitis B virus carrier status carrier status and gestational diabetes mellitus is associated with an increased risk of preterm birth compared with hepatitis B virus carrier status alone. This study aimed to develop and externally validate a clinically applicable multivariable prediction model incorporating both clinical risk factors and maternal blood biomarkers to estimate preterm birth risk among women with concurrent hepatitis B virus carrier status and gestational diabetes mellitus. Variable selection was performed using the least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO), and univariate and multivariable logistic regression analyses were subsequently conducted to assess the associations of clinical variables and maternal blood biomarkers with preterm birth in women with concurrent hepatitis B virus carrier status and gestational diabetes mellitus. A nomogram was developed to facilitate clinical application. Model discrimination and calibration were evaluated using receiver operating characteristic curve analysis and calibration plots, respectively, while clinical utility was assessed through decision curve analysis. A total of 847 women with hepatitis B virus carrier status and gestational diabetes mellitus were included in this study, of whom 187 (22%) experienced preterm birth. Multivariable logistic regression analysis identified pre-pregnancy body mass index, diastolic blood pressure, systolic blood pressure, alanine aminotransferase, placenta previa, white blood cell count, and maternal blood biomarkers—including total protein, total bile acid, total thyroxine, mode of membrane rupture, and prothrombin time—as independent predictors of preterm birth. The area under the curve was 0.854 (95% CI: 0.823–0.881) in the training set and 0.754 (95% CI: 0.697–0.806) in the validation set. Decision curve analysis indicated that the nomogram provided favorable clinical utility for predicting preterm birth. The model demonstrated good discriminative ability and calibration, enabling accurate prediction of preterm birth risk in women with concurrent hepatitis B virus carrier status and gestational diabetes mellitus.

papers.title: Effects of pegylated interferon on T cell receptor fingerprints in chronic hepatitis B patients with/without surface antigen clearance
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) remains a critical global health challenge, with few patients achieving spontaneous clearance of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), which is a key indicator of functional cure. T cell plays an important role in HBsAg clearance. AIM To compare T cell receptor (TCR) fingerprints between patients with or without HBsAg clearance after pegylated interferon alpha-2b (PegIFNα-2b) added on nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs). METHODS In this observational study, peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) were isolated from six comparable CHB patients who achieved HBsAg clearance (Group-C) or not (Group-NC) after 48 weeks of PegIFNα-2b added to NA therapy. Patients in Group-C and Group-NC had comparable age, gender, baseline hepatitis B virus (HBV) DNA, HBsAg, hepatitis B envelop antigen (HBeAg), total bilirubin, alanine aminotransferase (ALT) and cirrhosis status. All patients had received at least one year of NA before PegIFNα-2b therapy. TCR repertoire profiles (fingerprints) were screened and compared by RNA sequencing and bioinformation analysis between the two groups. RESULTS Six male patients without cirrhosis were enrolled in this study, with three patients in each group. 200 ng of RNA from each PBMC sample was extracted for standard RNA sequencing for construction of a complementary DNA library. Baseline levels of HBsAg, HBeAg, HBV DNA ( 0.05). It was found that compared to Group-NC, Group-C had significantly higher TCR diversity in both α and β chain, including more unique clonotypes (P = 0.017, P = 0.038 respectively), more repertoire overlap (P = 0.002, P = 0.002 respectively), a broader complementarity-determining region3 length distribution, and higher Chao1 index (P = 0.016, P = 0.048 respectively). CONCLUSION Patients with HBsAg clearance had a more diverse and robust T cell response, which may correlate with HBsAg clearance status. These immune signatures may serve as potential reference indicators for PegIFNα-2b treatment response in CHB patients.

papers.title_zh: 聚乙二醇化干扰素对有/无表面抗原清除的慢性乙型肝炎患者T细胞受体指纹的影响
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) remains a critical global health challenge, with few patients achieving spontaneous clearance of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), which is a key indicator of functional cure. T cell plays an important role in HBsAg clearance. AIM To compare T cell receptor (TCR) fingerprints between patients with or without HBsAg clearance after pegylated interferon alpha-2b (PegIFNα-2b) added on nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs). METHODS In this observational study, peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) were isolated from six comparable CHB patients who achieved HBsAg clearance (Group-C) or not (Group-NC) after 48 weeks of PegIFNα-2b added to NA therapy. Patients in Group-C and Group-NC had comparable age, gender, baseline hepatitis B virus (HBV) DNA, HBsAg, hepatitis B envelop antigen (HBeAg), total bilirubin, alanine aminotransferase (ALT) and cirrhosis status. All patients had received at least one year of NA before PegIFNα-2b therapy. TCR repertoire profiles (fingerprints) were screened and compared by RNA sequencing and bioinformation analysis between the two groups. RESULTS Six male patients without cirrhosis were enrolled in this study, with three patients in each group. 200 ng of RNA from each PBMC sample was extracted for standard RNA sequencing for construction of a complementary DNA library. Baseline levels of HBsAg, HBeAg, HBV DNA ( 0.05). It was found that compared to Group-NC, Group-C had significantly higher TCR diversity in both α and β chain, including more unique clonotypes (P = 0.017, P = 0.038 respectively), more repertoire overlap (P = 0.002, P = 0.002 respectively), a broader complementarity-determining region3 length distribution, and higher Chao1 index (P = 0.016, P = 0.048 respectively). CONCLUSION Patients with HBsAg clearance had a more diverse and robust T cell response, which may correlate with HBsAg clearance status. These immune signatures may serve as potential reference indicators for PegIFNα-2b treatment response in CHB patients.

papers.title: Terapias en enfermedades inflamatorias intestinales en situaciones especiales: tuberculosis, infección por VIH, virus hepatitis B y paciente crítico
papers.abstract: Introducción: La enfermedad inflamatoria intestinal (EII) en situaciones especiales constituye un desafío clínico. La inmunosupresión sostenida predispone a infecciones oportunistas y a la reactivación de infecciones latentes, mientras que determinadas comorbilidades condicionan decisiones terapéuticas que escapan a los protocolos convencionales. Objetivo: Revisar la evidencia disponible sobre el manejo de cuatro situaciones especiales en la EII: tuberculosis (TBC), infección por VIH, hepatitis B (VHB) y paciente crítico. Métodos: Revisión narrativa basada en búsqueda sistemática en PubMed, guías ECCO, GETECCU, ACG y GETAID, priorizando publicaciones de los últimos cinco años. Resultados: El tamizaje de TBC latente es obligatorio antes de iniciar cualquier biológico, con riesgo de reactivación hasta 20 veces mayor con anti-TNF. El VIH aumenta el riesgo de desarrollar EII (OR 2,68) y confiere un fenotipo menos agresivo, pero mayor riesgo de infecciones oportunistas; los biológicos son seguros con VIH con carga viral negativa. El VHB requiere tamizaje serológico universal y profilaxis antiviral obligatoria en pacientes HBsAg positivos. El paciente crítico con EII demanda manejo multidisciplinario con evaluación precoz del riesgo quirúrgico, soporte nutricional intensivo y consideración de terapias de rescate según disponibilidad y contraindicaciones. Conclusiones: El manejo de la EII en situaciones especiales requiere decisiones individualizadas, fundamentadas en la mejor evidencia disponible y en un abordaje multidisciplinario.

Objetivo: Revisar la evidencia disponible sobre el manejo de cuatro situaciones especiales en la EII: tuberculosis (TBC), infección por VIH, hepatitis B (VHB) y paciente crítico. Métodos: Revisión narrativa basada en búsqueda sistemática en PubMed, guías ECCO, GETECCU, ACG y GETAID, priorizando publicaciones de los últimos cinco años. Resultados: El tamizaje de TBC latente es obligatorio antes de iniciar cualquier biológico, con riesgo de reactivación hasta 20 veces mayor con anti-TNF. El VIH aumenta el riesgo de desarrollar EII (OR 2,68) y confiere un fenotipo menos agresivo, pero mayor riesgo de infecciones oportunistas; los biológicos son seguros con VIH con carga viral negativa. El VHB requiere tamizaje serológico universal y profilaxis antiviral obligatoria en pacientes HBsAg positivos. El paciente crítico con EII demanda manejo multidisciplinario con evaluación precoz del riesgo quirúrgico, soporte nutricional intensivo y consideración de terapias de rescate según disponibilidad y contraindicaciones. Conclusiones: El manejo de la EII en situaciones especiales requiere decisiones individualizadas, fundamentadas en la mejor evidencia disponible y en un abordaje multidisciplinario.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to review the evidence available for managing inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) in special situations, including hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection, due to the clinical challenges posed by immunosuppression and comorbidities.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This was a narrative review based on a systematic search in PubMed and guidelines from ECCO, GETECCU, ACG, and GETAID, prioritizing publications from the last five years.
analysis.methods: The review involved a systematic search of PubMed and clinical guidelines to synthesize evidence on IBD management in special situations, with a focus on HBV screening and antiviral prophylaxis.
analysis.main_results: Universal serological screening for HBV is mandatory, and antiviral prophylaxis is required in patients who are HBsAg positive to prevent reactivation.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors emphasize that managing IBD in special situations, including HBV infection, requires individualized decisions based on the best available evidence and a multidisciplinary approach.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Findings inform clinical practice by highlighting the importance of HBV screening and prophylaxis in IBD patients to prevent viral reactivation and improve outcomes.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate, as the review is narrative and relies on existing guidelines, which may not include the most recent or high-quality studies.

analysis.summary_en: This review addresses the management of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) in special situations, focusing on hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection. The study highlights that immunosuppression in IBD patients increases the risk of HBV reactivation, necessitating universal serological screening and mandatory antiviral prophylaxis for HBsAg-positive individuals. The narrative review synthesizes evidence from PubMed and clinical guidelines, emphasizing the need for individualized, multidisciplinary care. Key findings include the importance of HBV screening before initiating biologics and the safety of antiviral therapy in preventing reactivation. The evidence strength is moderate, based on existing guidelines and recent publications.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在回顾由于免疫抑制和合并症带来的临床挑战,在特殊情况下治疗炎症性肠病 (IBD) 的现有证据,包括 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染。

papers.abstract_zh: 简介:肠道炎症 (EII) 是一种特殊的临床情况。免疫抑制的作用是预防机会性感染和潜伏性感染的重新激活,这取决于公约协议中的治疗决定。目的:修订 EII 中特殊情况的证据:结核病 (TBC)、VIH 感染、乙型肝炎 (VHB) 和重症监护。方法:在 PubMed 系统中修改 basada 叙事,以 ECCO、GETECCU、ACG 和 GETAID 为基础,优先考虑最近几年的公共事务。结果:TBC 潜伏期和生物生物学启动前的必要条件,以及抗 TNF 药物已重新激活 20 次。El VIH aumenta el riesgo de desarrollar EII (OR 2,68) y confiere un fenotipo menos agresivo,pero Mayor riesgo de infecciones opportunistas;生物制剂可以保护 VIH 和病毒阴性。VHB 需要 tamizaje 血清学普遍和分布 抗病毒药物 强制 HBsAg 阳性。EII 的Paciente crítico 要求对所需的条件进行多学科评估,支持强化营养并考虑采取补救措施和禁忌症的治疗方法。结论:EII 的具体情况需要个性化决策、主要证据和跨学科基础。

papers.title: Has the COVID-19 Pandemic Affected HBsAg Seroclearance Rates in Chronic Hepatitis B Patients?
papers.abstract: Objectives:The aim of this study is to document the increase in hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) seroclearance that we observed during the coronavirus disease-2019 (COVID-19) pandemic.Materials and Methods: Patients with chronic hepatitis B aged 18 years and older who were followed between 2010 and 2023 at three hospitals in Türkiye were included in this study.Rates of HBsAg seroclearance, seroconversion, and serological response among the patients were determined.Data from patients other than those who developed HBsAg seroclearance before the COVID-19 pandemic (before 2020) were analyzed.Results: A total of 188 patients were included in the study.In total, 26 (13.8%) patients developed HBsAg seroclearance, 28 (15%) developed HBsAg seroconversion, and 21 (11.2%)developed a serological response.Of the patients who developed HBsAg seroclearance, 22 (84.6%)occurred in 2020 or later, and 4 (15.4%)occurred before 2020.The annual incidence rates of HBsAg seroclearance were 0.78% in 2014, 0.6% in 2017, 1.15% in 2019, 1.71% in 2020, 2.23% in 2021, 7.4% in 2022, and 1.2% in 2023.95% of the patients were vaccinated with Pfizer-BioNTech and/or Sinovac-CoronaVac vaccines, and 36.4% had a COVID-19 infection. Conclusion:In this study, the annual incidence rate of HBsAg seroclearance in the pre-pandemic period was consistent with the ÖZ

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to document an observed increase in hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) seroclearance during the COVID-19 pandemic.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This study included 188 patients with chronic hepatitis B aged 18 years and older who were followed between 2010 and 2023 at three hospitals in Türkiye.
analysis.methods: The study determined rates of HBsAg seroclearance, seroconversion, and serological response, analyzing data from patients who developed HBsAg seroclearance during the pandemic compared to before 2020.
analysis.main_results: A total of 26 (13.8%) patients developed HBsAg seroclearance, with 22 (84.6%) occurring in 2020 or later and 4 (15.4%) before 2020. analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as indicating an increase in HBsAg seroclearance rates during the pandemic period compared to pre-pandemic years.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest a potential impact of the COVID-19 pandemic environment or associated factors on the natural history of chronic hepatitis B, specifically regarding HBsAg seroclearance.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The supplied evidence does not report specific study design limitations, but the evidence strength is assessed as low due to the abstract-only nature of the data and the lack of detailed statistical methodology.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on HBsAg seroclearance rates in 188 chronic hepatitis B patients followed at three hospitals in Türkiye between 2010 and 2023. Results showed that 26 patients achieved seroclearance, with 84.6% of these cases occurring in 2020 or later. Annual incidence rates increased from 1.15% in 2019 to peaks of 2.23% in 2021 and 7.4% in 2022, compared to lower rates in pre-pandemic years. The authors conclude that the pandemic period was associated with an increase in HBsAg seroclearance, noting that 95% of patients were vaccinated against COVID-19 and 36.4% had a COVID-19 infection.

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据没有报告具体的研究设计局限性,但由于数据仅抽象且缺乏详细的统计方法,证据强度被评估为低。

papers.title: HBV, HCV and HIV Infections among Pregnant Women Attending Antenatal Care at the Health Facilities in Ekiti South, Nigeria
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV), hepatitis C virus (HCV), and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) are blood-borne infections with the potential for mother-to-child transmission and remain important concerns in antenatal care in sub-Saharan Africa. This cross-sectional study determined the seroprevalence of HBV, HCV, and HIV among pregnant women attending selected health facilities in Ekiti South Senatorial District, Nigeria. A total of 710 pregnant women were recruited from six Local Government Areas: Ekiti South West, Ikere, Ise, Emure, Ekiti East, and Gbonyin. Sociodemographic data and information on knowledge, awareness, and attitudes were collected using a structured questionnaire. Venous blood specimens were obtained aseptically and screened for hepatitis B surface antigen, anti-HCV antibodies, and HIV antibodies. Descriptive statistics and chi-square tests were used to assess prevalence and associations at p < 0.05. The overall seroprevalence was 2.5% (18/710) for HBV, 1.5% (11/710) for HIV, and 0% for HCV. No co-infection was detected. Age group was significantly associated with HIV infection (p < 0.001), whereas location, marital status, residence, gestational age, education, and occupation were not significantly associated with HIV status. HBsAg positivity was not significantly associated with any assessed sociodemographic variable. The findings indicate an intermediate level of HBV endemicity in the study population and support sustained antenatal screening, linkage to care, health education, HBV vaccination, and prevention of mother-to-child transmission services.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV)、丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV) 和人类免疫缺陷病毒 (HIV) 是可能导致母婴传播的血源性感染,并且仍然是撒哈拉以南非洲地区产前护理的重要问题。本研究旨在确定尼日利亚埃基蒂南孕妇中这些感染的 血清流行率。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,研究人群中乙型肝炎病毒流行程度处于中等水平,支持持续产前筛查和预防母婴 传播 服务的需要。
