papers.title: Optimizing Hepatitis B screening: A comparison of ELISA and rapid tests
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B remains a major global public health problem, particularly in areas of high endemicity such as Madagascar, where prevalence exceeds 8%. Diagnosis relies primarily on the ELISA immunoenzymatic technique, which is recognized for its reliability but is not widely available in resource-limited laboratories. Rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs) offer a practical alternative, but their performance in this context has yet to be evaluated. This prospective descriptive and analytical study compared the performance of the Virucheck® rapid test and the Wantai Bio Pharm ELISA for the detection of hepatitis B virus surface antigen (HBsAg). The sample consisted of 74 serum samples from patients with sickle cell disease and subjects followed at the JRA University Hospital. The results showed a seroprevalence of 6.75% by TDR versus 9.45% by ELISA. The TDR had a sensitivity of 71.41% and a specificity of 100%, while the ELISA confirmed its superiority with sensitivities exceeding 95% and specificities close to 98%. Beyond technical performance, the study highlighted a predominantly young population, reflecting the significance of mother-to-child transmission, as well as a notable seroprevalence among young adults linked to risky sexual behaviors. These findings underscore the urgency of early and targeted screening, combined with a strengthened vaccination strategy. In conclusion, optimizing hepatitis B screening in Madagascar relies on the complementary use of rapid tests—suitable for community-based screening—and ELISA, which is essential for diagnostic confirmation and clinical follow-up. This approach represents a strategic pathway to reduce transmission, improve vaccination coverage, and strengthen the fight against hepatitis B in a context of high endemicity.

analysis.summary_en: This prospective study evaluated the performance of rapid diagnostic tests versus ELISA for hepatitis B screening in Madagascar, using 74 serum samples from patients with sickle cell disease and hospital subjects. ELISA demonstrated superior performance with sensitivities exceeding 95% and specificities near 98%, detecting a seroprevalence of 9.45% compared to 6.75% by the rapid test, which showed 71.41% sensitivity and 100% specificity. papers.full_text: Abstract It is estimated that more than 5 million people in Ethiopia are living with chronic Hepatitis B virus and only 41.54% of individuals had good practice towards hepatitis B virus infection prevention. There are research and methodological gap on the HBV infection prevention practices in the country. Therefore, the aim of this study was to assess hepatitis B prevention practices and associated factors among medical and health sciences students at the University of Gondar, Northwest Ethiopia. An institution-based mixed-methods cross-sectional study was conducted among Medical and Health Sciences students at the University of Gondar from March to August 2025. Stratified sampling technique was used. A self-administered questionnaire was used to collect the data. Furthermore, key informants interview guides were used to collect qualitative data among instructors and students at college of medicine and health science. The quantitative data were analyzed using STATA version 20. Bi-variable and multivariable analysis were performed to identify factors associated with practice towards HBV infection prevention. The qualitative data were analyzed by inductive thematic analysis. Among 666 participants, 51.8% (95% CI: 48.0, 55.6) of them had good HBV prevention practice. In multivariable analysis, being 20–24 years old was 2.54 times more likely to have good prevention practice compared to 25–29 age group (95% CI: 1.42–4.54, p = 0.002). Similarly, Physiotherapy student exhibited 5.41times more likely to adhere to preventive measures (95% CI: 1.78–16.42, p = 0.003) compared with other departments. Furthermore, Students with favorable attitude were 2.63 times more likely to have good practice compared to those with an unfavorable attitude (95% CI: 1.81–3.82, p = 0.000). Qualitative data from instructors highlighted inadequate awareness, personal protective equipment (PPE) and vaccine shortages, and gap between theory and practice. Student interviews revealed a strong reliance on traditional medicine which often superseded modern health care due to cultural beliefs and perceptions of faster healing. The study revealed that knowledge, attitude and practice regarding HBV prevention practice is low among medical and health science students. Thus, we suggest that the University and Ministry of Health needs to provide practical training, address (PPE) shortages, and bridge the theory-practice gaps, ensure HBV screening and vaccination for students, create culturally sensitive awareness campaign that may be involving the community. Qualitative data from instructors highlighted inadequate awareness, personal protective equipment (PPE) and vaccine shortages, and gap between theory and practice. Student interviews revealed a strong reliance on traditional medicine which often superseded modern health care due to cultural beliefs and perceptions of faster healing. The study revealed that knowledge, attitude and practice regarding HBV prevention practice is low among medical and health science students. Thus, we suggest that the University and Ministry of Health needs to provide practical training, address (PPE) shortages, and bridge the theory-practice gaps, ensure HBV screening and vaccination for students, create culturally sensitive awareness campaign that may be involving the community. papers.title_original: Hepatitis B prevention practices and associated factors among medical and health sciences students at university of Gondar, Northwest Ethiopia

analysis.research_question_and_background: More than 5 million people in Ethiopia are living with chronic Hepatitis B virus, yet only 41.54% of individuals had good practice towards prevention, and there are research gaps on prevention practices in the country.
analysis.study_design_and_population: An institution-based mixed-methods cross-sectional study was conducted among 666 Medical and Health Sciences students at the University of Gondar from March to August 2025 using stratified sampling.
analysis.methods: Data were collected via a self-administered questionnaire and key informant interviews with instructors and students, analyzed using bi-variable and multivariable logistic regression and inductive thematic analysis.
analysis.main_results: 51.8% (95% CI: 48.0, 55.6) of participants had good HBV prevention practice; being 20–24 years old (AOR 2.54), a Physiotherapy student (AOR 5.41), and having a favorable attitude (AOR 2.63) were significantly associated with good practice.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as indicating low knowledge, attitude and practice regarding HBV prevention among students, with qualitative data highlighting inadequate awareness, PPE shortages, and a reliance on traditional medicine.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest the University and Ministry of Health should provide practical training, address PPE shortages, ensure HBV screening and vaccination, and create culturally sensitive awareness campaigns.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The supplied evidence does not report specific design limitations or a detailed assessment of evidence strength beyond the cross-sectional nature of the study.

analysis.summary_en: This institution-based mixed-methods cross-sectional study assessed hepatitis B prevention practices among 666 Medical and Health Sciences students at the University of Gondar, Ethiopia, from March to August 2025. Data were collected using self-administered questionnaires and key informant interviews. The study found that 51.8% of participants had good HBV prevention practice. Multivariable analysis showed that being aged 20–24, being a Physiotherapy student, and having a favorable attitude were significantly associated with good prevention practices. Qualitative findings highlighted inadequate awareness, personal protective equipment shortages, and a reliance on traditional medicine. The authors recommend that the University and Ministry of Health provide practical training, address resource shortages, ensure vaccination, and develop culturally sensitive awareness campaigns to improve prevention practices.

papers.title: Longitudinal Renal Function Changes and Pilot Mitochondrial Epigenetic Analysis in Chronic Hepatitis B Patients Treated with Nucleos(t)ide Analogues
papers.abstract: Objectives: Long-term use of nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs) has been associated with mitochondrial dysfunction and potential adverse effects.This study aimed to evaluate nephrotoxicity in treated and treatment-naïve chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients and to explore DNA methyltransferase 1 (DNMT1) expression as a potential epigenetic mechanism.Materials and Methods: Adult CHB patients receiving tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF) or entecavir (ETV) for ≥12 months comprised the "under-treatment'" group, while untreated patients formed the "treatment-naïve" group.Renal parameters at baseline and months 3, 6, and 12 were analyzed retrospectively.Longitudinal changes in glomerular filtration rate (GFR) were assessed using linear mixed-effects modeling.DNMT1 expression in peripheral blood mononuclear cells was evaluated as a pilot analysis.Results: A total of 158 patients were analyzed; 91 were treated and 67 were treatment-naïve.Median GFR values declined significantly from 102.3 at the baseline to 102.1 at the 12 th month in the treated group (p=0.012).In longitudinal analysis, each additional time point was associated with a mean GFR decline of 1.65 mL/min/1.73m 2 (95% confidence interval: -3.13 to -0.16; p=0.030).Age was independently associated with a reduction in GFR (β=-0.75 per year; p<0.001).No significant differences in renal outcomes were observed between TDF and ETV.In the pilot epigenetic analysis (n=25), DNMT1 expression was comparable between treated and treatment-naïve patients (median 1.1789 vs. ÖZAmaç: Nükleos(t)id analoglarının (NA) uzun süreli kullanımı, mitokondriyal işlev bozukluğu ve olası yan etkilerle ilişkilendirilmiştir. Bu çalışmada, tedavi altındaki ve tedavi-naiv kronik hepatit B (KHB) hastalarında nefrotoksisitenin değerlendirilmesi ve potansiyel bir epigenetik mekanizma olarak DNA metiltransferaz 1 (DNMT1) ekspresyonunun araştırılması amaçlanmıştır.Gereç ve Yöntemler: Tenofovir disoproksil fumarat (TDF) veya entekavir (ETV) tedavisini ≥12 ay boyunca alan yetişkin KHB hastaları "tedavi altındaki" grubu oluştururken, tedavi görmemiş hastalar ise "tedavinaiv" grubu oluşturdu.Başlangıçta ve 3., 6. aylarda ölçülen böbrek parametreleri retrospektif olarak analiz edildi.Glomerüler filtrasyon hızındaki (GFR) uzunlamasına değişiklikler, doğrusal karışık etki modellemesi kullanılarak değerlendirildi.Pilot çalışma olarak, periferik kan mononükleer hücrelerinde DNMT1 ekspresyonu değerlendirildi.Bulgular:

Bu çalışmada, tedavi altındaki ve tedavi-naiv kronik hepatit B (KHB) hastalarında nefrotoksisitenin değerlendirilmesi ve potansiyel bir epigenetik mekanizma olarak DNA metiltransferaz 1 (DNMT1) ekspresyonunun araştırılması amaçlanmıştır.Gereç ve Yöntemler: Tenofovir disoproksil fumarat (TDF) veya entekavir (ETV) tedavisini ≥12 ay boyunca alan yetişkin KHB hastaları "tedavi altındaki" grubu oluştururken, tedavi görmemiş hastalar ise "tedavinaiv" grubu oluşturdu.Başlangıçta ve 3., 6. aylarda ölçülen böbrek parametreleri retrospektif olarak analiz edildi.Glomerüler filtrasyon hızındaki (GFR) uzunlamasına değişiklikler, doğrusal karışık etki modellemesi kullanılarak değerlendirildi.Pilot çalışma olarak, periferik kan mononükleer hücrelerinde DNMT1 ekspresyonu değerlendirildi.Bulgular:

papers.title_original: Longitudinal Renal Function Changes and Pilot Mitochondrial Epigenetic Analysis in Chronic Hepatitis B Patients Treated with Nucleos(t)ide Analogues

analysis.research_question_and_background: Long-term use of nucleos(t)ide analogues has been associated with mitochondrial dysfunction and potential adverse effects. This study aimed to evaluate nephrotoxicity in treated and treatment-naïve chronic hepatitis B patients and to explore DNA methyltransferase 1 expression as a potential epigenetic mechanism.
analysis.study_design_and_population: Adult chronic hepatitis B patients receiving tenofovir disoproxil fumarate or entecavir for at least 12 months comprised the under-treatment group, while untreated patients formed the treatment-naïve group. A total of 158 patients were analyzed, including 91 treated and 67 treatment-naïve individuals.
analysis.methods: Renal parameters at baseline and months 3, 6, and 12 were analyzed retrospectively, and longitudinal changes in glomerular filtration rate were assessed using linear mixed-effects modeling. DNA methyltransferase 1 expression in peripheral blood mononuclear cells was evaluated as a pilot analysis.
analysis.main_results: Median glomerular filtration rate values declined significantly from 102.3 at baseline to 102.1 at the 12th month in the treated group. Longitudinal analysis showed each additional time point was associated with a mean GFR decline of 1.65 mL/min/1.73m2, and age was independently associated with a reduction in GFR. No significant differences in renal outcomes were observed between tenofovir disoproxil fumarate and entecavir, and DNA methyltransferase 1 expression was comparable between groups.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as indicating a significant decline in renal function over time in treated patients, with age identified as an independent factor. The study suggests that while nephrotoxicity is present, it does not differ significantly between the two specific nucleos(t)ide analogues studied.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings cautiously inform the monitoring of renal function in chronic hepatitis B patients undergoing long-term nucleos(t)ide analogue therapy. The results suggest that vigilance regarding kidney health is warranted regardless of the specific agent used.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate due to the retrospective design and the abstract-only nature of the available data. The pilot epigenetic analysis was limited to a small sample size of 25 patients.

analysis.summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated nephrotoxicity and DNA methyltransferase 1 expression in 158 chronic hepatitis B patients, comparing those treated with tenofovir disoproxil fumarate or entecavir for at least 12 months to treatment-naïve controls. Longitudinal analysis revealed a statistically significant decline in median glomerular filtration rate in the treated group over 12 months, with age identified as an independent factor for reduced renal function. No significant differences in renal outcomes were observed between the two nucleos(t)ide analogues, and the pilot epigenetic analysis found comparable DNA methyltransferase 1 expression between groups. These findings suggest the need for renal monitoring during long-term therapy, though the evidence is limited by the retrospective design and small pilot sample.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 长期使用核苷(酸)类似物与线粒体功能障碍和潜在的不良反应有关。本研究旨在评估经治疗和未接受过 治疗 治疗的 慢性乙型肝炎 患者的肾毒性,并探索 DNA 甲基转移酶 1 表达作为潜在的表观遗传机制。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 接受富马酸替诺福韦二吡呋酯或恩替卡韦治疗至少 12 个月的成人 慢性乙型肝炎 患者构成 治疗 治疗不足组,而未经治疗的患者构成 治疗 初治组。总共对 158 名患者进行了分析,其中包括 91 名接受过治疗的患者和 67 名未接受过 治疗 治疗的患者。
elements_zh.methods: 回顾性分析基线以及第 3、6 和 12 个月的肾脏参数,并使用线性混合效应模型评估肾小球滤过率的纵向变化。作为初步分析,评估了外周血单核细胞中 DNA 甲基转移酶 1 的表达。
elements_zh.main_results: 治疗组的中位肾小球滤过率值从基线时的 102.3 显着下降至第 12 个月时的 102.1。纵向分析显示,每个额外的时间点都与平均 GFR 下降 1.65 mL/min/1.73m2 相关,并且年龄与 GFR 下降独立相关。富马酸替诺福韦二吡呋酯和恩替卡韦之间的肾脏结局没有观察到显着差异,并且组间 DNA 甲基转移酶 1 表达具有可比性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为,随着时间的推移,治疗患者的肾功能显着下降,其中年龄被确定为独立因素。该研究表明,虽然存在肾毒性,但所研究的两种特定核苷(酸)类似物之间没有显着差异。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为接受长期核苷(酸)类似物治疗的 慢性乙型肝炎 患者的肾功能监测提供了谨慎的信息。结果表明,无论使用何种特定药物,都需要对肾脏健康保持警惕。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于回顾性设计和可用数据仅抽象的性质,证据强度中等。试点表观遗传学分析仅限于 25 名患者的小样本量。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 长期使用核苷(酸)类似物与线粒体功能障碍和潜在的不良反应有关。本研究旨在评估经治疗和未接受过 治疗 治疗的 慢性乙型肝炎 患者的肾毒性,并探索 DNA 甲基转移酶 1 表达作为潜在的表观遗传机制。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 接受富马酸替诺福韦二吡呋酯或恩替卡韦治疗至少 12 个月的成人 慢性乙型肝炎 患者构成 治疗 治疗不足组,而未经治疗的患者构成 治疗 初治组。总共对 158 名患者进行了分析,其中包括 91 名接受过治疗的患者和 67 名未接受过 治疗 治疗的患者。
analysis_zh.methods: 回顾性分析基线以及第 3、6 和 12 个月的肾脏参数,并使用线性混合效应模型评估肾小球滤过率的纵向变化。作为初步分析,评估了外周血单核细胞中 DNA 甲基转移酶 1 的表达。
analysis_zh.main_results: 治疗组的中位肾小球滤过率值从基线时的 102.3 显着下降至第 12 个月时的 102.1。纵向分析显示,每个额外的时间点都与平均 GFR 下降 1.65 mL/min/1.73m2 相关,并且年龄与 GFR 下降独立相关。富马酸替诺福韦二吡呋酯和恩替卡韦之间的肾脏结局没有观察到显着差异,并且组间 DNA 甲基转移酶 1 表达具有可比性。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为,随着时间的推移,治疗患者的肾功能显着下降,其中年龄被确定为独立因素。该研究表明,虽然存在肾毒性,但所研究的两种特定核苷(酸)类似物之间没有显着差异。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为接受长期核苷(酸)类似物治疗的 慢性乙型肝炎 患者的肾功能监测提供了谨慎的信息。结果表明,无论使用何种特定药物,都需要对肾脏健康保持警惕。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于回顾性设计和可用数据仅抽象的性质,证据强度中等。试点表观遗传学分析仅限于 25 名患者的小样本量。

papers.full_text: Abstract The new deoxyguanine nucleoside analogue Entecavir (ETV) specifically inhibits the replication of the hepatitis B virus. Around 275 million individuals globally continue to be affected by chronic hepatitis B virus infections, which can be deadly despite the presence of effective vaccines. The medical field has employed drug delivery clusters based on nanocomposite. Therefore, we have investigated the adsorption behaviour of the hepatitis B drug ETV on silica infused with Au/Ag/Pt nano cluster composites (NCCs) using DFT linked to the B3LYP functional with combined basis set of 6-311 + + g(d, p)&LANL2DZ. ETV adsorbs on Ag/Au/Pt...SiO2 via its NH2 group with counterpoise-corrected energies of − 60.13, − 39.39, and − 48.33 kcal/mol, respectively. NBO analysis indicates electron transfer from Au/Ag/ Pt...SiO2 to the NH2 group of ETV, with net charges of 0.082|e|, 0.105|e|, and 0.032|e|, respectively, confirming SiO2 acts as an electron donor. MEP analysis reveals that doped metals in ETV@Ag/Au/Pt...SiO2 create active sites for drug adsorption, with electrophilic regions located on O, F, and N atoms of ETV and nucleophilic zones on C and H atoms, highlighting the potential interaction sites between the drug and NCCs. Molecular docking revealed that ETV@Ag/Au/Pt...SiO2 effectively binds to proteins 3OX8 and 3OXR, with binding energies of − 4.87, − 6.11, − 9.72, and − 9.35 kcal/mol for ETV and ETV@Pt...SiO2, respectively, and multiple hydrogen bonds at key active site residues, demonstrating enhanced stability and potential biological activity. full_text_sections.full_text: Abstract The new deoxyguanine nucleoside analogue Entecavir (ETV) specifically inhibits the replication of the hepatitis B virus. Around 275 million individuals globally continue to be affected by chronic hepatitis B virus infections, which can be deadly despite the presence of effective vaccines. The medical field has employed drug delivery clusters based on nanocomposite. Therefore, we have investigated the adsorption behaviour of the hepatitis B drug ETV on silica infused with Au/Ag/Pt nano cluster composites (NCCs) using DFT linked to the B3LYP functional with combined basis set of 6-311 + + g(d, p)&LANL2DZ. ETV adsorbs on Ag/Au/Pt...SiO2 via its NH2 group with counterpoise-corrected energies of − 60.13, − 39.39, and − 48.33 kcal/mol, respectively. NBO analysis indicates electron transfer from Au/Ag/ Pt...SiO2 to the NH2 group of ETV, with net charges of 0.082|e|, 0.105|e|, and 0.032|e|, respectively, confirming SiO2 acts as an electron donor. MEP analysis reveals that doped metals in ETV@Ag/Au/Pt...SiO2 create active sites for drug adsorption, with electrophilic regions located on O, F, and N atoms of ETV and nucleophilic zones on C and H atoms, highlighting the potential interaction sites between the drug and NCCs. Molecular docking revealed that ETV@Ag/Au/Pt...SiO2 effectively binds to proteins 3OX8 and 3OXR, with binding energies of − 4.87, − 6.11, − 9.72, and − 9.35 kcal/mol for ETV and ETV@Pt...SiO2, respectively, and multiple hydrogen bonds at key active site residues, demonstrating enhanced stability and potential biological activity. papers.title_original: Effects of Silica Infused with Gold/Silver/Platinum on the Hepatitis B Drug Entecavir by Theoretical Investigation

analysis.research_question_and_background: Chronic hepatitis B virus infection remains a deadly global health issue affecting around 275 million individuals despite the availability of effective vaccines. This study investigated the adsorption behavior of the hepatitis B drug Entecavir on silica infused with gold, silver, and platinum nanocomposites to explore potential drug delivery improvements.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The supplied evidence does not report a specific study design, setting, dates, or human or animal population. The research utilized a theoretical computational approach involving density functional theory and molecular docking simulations to analyze the interaction between the drug Entecavir and metal-infused silica nanocomposites.
analysis.methods: The study employed density functional theory linked to the B3LYP functional with a combined basis set of 6-311++g(d,p) and LANL2DZ to optimize geometry and calculate adsorption energies. Natural Bond Orbital and Molecular Electrostatic Potential analyses were conducted to assess electron transfer and active sites, while molecular docking was performed to evaluate binding interactions with proteins 3OX8 and 3OXR.
analysis.main_results: Entecavir adsorbed on silver, gold, and platinum-infused silica via its NH2 group with counterpoise-corrected energies of -60.13, -39.39, and -48.33 kcal/mol, respectively. Molecular docking revealed that the drug-nanocomposite complexes effectively bind to proteins 3OX8 and 3OXR, with binding energies of -4.87, -6.11, -9.72, and -9.35 kcal/mol for Entecavir and the platinum complex, respectively, forming multiple hydrogen bonds.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the electron transfer from the nanocomposites to the drug and the favorable binding energies as confirmation of silica's role as an electron donor and the enhanced stability of the complexes. The novelty lies in the theoretical demonstration that metal-doped silica nanocomposites can create active sites for effective Entecavir adsorption and potentially improve its biological activity.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings suggest that silica infused with gold, silver, or platinum could serve as effective nanocarriers for the delivery of Entecavir. This theoretical insight may inform the future development of optimized drug delivery systems to enhance the treatment efficacy for chronic hepatitis B virus infection.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is low because the study is entirely theoretical and computational, lacking in vitro or in vivo validation. The supplied evidence does not report experimental data, sample sizes, or physical synthesis of the nanocomposites, which limits the ability to confirm the biological relevance of the calculated interactions.

analysis.summary_en: This theoretical study investigated the adsorption of the hepatitis B drug Entecavir on silica infused with gold, silver, and platinum nanocomposites using density functional theory and molecular docking. Results showed that Entecavir adsorbed via its NH2 group with energies ranging from -60.13 to -39.39 kcal/mol and formed stable complexes with target proteins, exhibiting binding energies between -4.87 and -9.72 kcal/mol. The authors concluded that these metal-doped nanocomposites act as electron donors and enhance drug stability, suggesting their potential as effective nanocarriers for hepatitis B treatment. However, the evidence strength is low due to the absence of experimental validation.

elements_zh.methods: 该研究采用与 B3LYP 泛函相关的密度泛函理论,结合 6-311++g(d,p) 和 LANL2DZ 的组合基组来优化几何结构并计算吸附能。进行自然键轨道和分子静电势分析以评估电子转移和活性位点,同时进行分子对接以评估与蛋白质 3OX8 和 3OXR 的结合相互作用。
elements_zh.main_results: 恩替卡韦通过其 NH2 基团吸附在银、金和铂注入的二氧化硅上,平衡校正能量分别为 -60.13、-39.39 和 -48.33 kcal/mol。分子对接显示,药物-纳米复合物有效结合蛋白3OX8和3OXR,恩替卡韦和铂配合物的结合能分别为-4.87、-6.11、-9.72和-9.35 kcal/mol,形成多个氢键。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将电子从纳米复合材料到药物的转移和有利的结合能解释为二氧化硅作为电子供体的作用的确认以及复合物稳定性的增强。新颖之处在于理论证明金属掺杂的二氧化硅纳米复合材料可以为恩替卡韦的有效吸附创造活性位点,并有可能提高其生物活性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,注入金、银或铂的二氧化硅可以作为恩替卡韦的有效纳米载体。这一理论见解可能为未来开发优化的药物递送系统提供信息,以增强 治疗 对 慢性乙型肝炎 病毒感染的功效。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度较低,因为该研究完全是理论和计算的,缺乏体外或体内验证。提供的证据没有报告纳米复合材料的实验数据、样本大小或物理合成,这限制了确认计算的相互作用的生物相关性的能力。

papers.full_text: Abstract Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) remains a major global health burden with persistently high morbidity and mortality. Dysregulation of the tumor microenvironment (TME) associated with chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV)/hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection and inflammation contributes to tumor progression, therapeutic resistance, and adverse clinical outcomes. Many existing HCC prognostic models do not systematically integrate infection-associated molecular signatures with immune and genomic features, which may limit their predictive performance in infection-associated HCC populations. In this study, we established an integrated predictive framework based on multi-cohort transcriptomic, somatic mutation, immune infiltration, and clinical data, together with artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted analysis. Here, “infection-associated” refers to a combined gene set covering HBV/HCV infection, antiviral and inflammatory responses, and immune regulation. We first constructed a comprehensive 248-gene infection-associated set, identified two robust HCC molecular subtypes with distinct infection-status annotations, immune infiltration features, genomic alteration profiles, and clinical prognosis through unsupervised consensus clustering, and screened 12 core prognostic genes that were significantly enriched in key oncogenic pathways via three complementary machine learning algorithms. The prognostic risk model was developed in the TCGA-LIHC training cohort and externally validated in ICGC-LIRI-JP and GSE14520, with 1-year area under the curve (AUC) values reaching 0.82, 0.78, and 0.75, respectively; it also showed independent prognostic value for HCC (hazard ratio (HR) = 2.87, P < 0.001) and higher clinical net benefit than traditional clinicopathological models in retrospective decision curve analysis (DCA). These results suggest associations among infection-associated molecular characteristics, TME remodeling, and HCC prognosis. Together, the infection-associated signature may support retrospective HCC risk stratification, although prospective validation is required before routine clinical application. papers.title: Seroprevalence Trends of HBV, HCV, and HIV Before and During the COVID-19 Pandemic: Five-Year Retrospective Data from a Tertiary Hospital in Northern Cyprus
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND/AIMS: To assess five-year seroreactivity trends of hepatitis B virus (HBV), hepatitis C virus (HCV), and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) in Northern Cyprus, with emphasis on the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) and post-pandemic periods. MATERIALS AND METHODS:This retrospective cross-sectional study evaluated 278,016 serological test results for hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), anti-HCV, and anti-HIV between 2020 and 2024.All tests were carried out using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay technology on the ARCHITECT Plus ci4100 system (Abbott Laboratories, Chicago, IL, USA).The annual rate of seroreactivity was calculated and compared across years and sex groups.The results were also categorised based on signal-to-cut-off (S/CO) ratios for HCV and HIV and on IU/mL for HBsAg. RESULTS:Overall seroreactivity rates were 1.2% for HBsAg, 0.6% for anti-HCV, and 0.2% for anti-HIV.HBV seroreactivity declined significantly from 1.5% in 2020 to 1.0% in 2023-2024 (p=0.001).HCV prevalence remained below 1%, increasing non-significantly from 0.5% to 0.7% (p=0.192);most positive samples fell within the low S/CO category.HIV prevalence remained stable at 0.2% across the study period (p=0.043). CONCLUSION:HBV seroreactivity exhibited a declining trend over the years; HCV levels remained low but exhibited a rising trend; HIV levels remained stable and low.The results indicate that Northern Cyprus remains a low-endemic region and highlight the importance of sustained surveillance and prevention in the post-COVID-19 era.The results need to be interpreted cautiously, as they may not entirely indicate the levels of infection.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to assess five-year seroreactivity trends of hepatitis B virus (HBV), hepatitis C virus (HCV), and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) in Northern Cyprus, with emphasis on the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) and post-pandemic periods.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This retrospective cross-sectional study evaluated 278,016 serological test results from a tertiary hospital in Northern Cyprus between 2020 and 2024.
analysis.methods: Tests for hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), anti-HCV, and anti-HIV were performed using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay technology on the ARCHITECT Plus ci4100 system, with annual rates of seroreactivity calculated and compared across years and sex groups.
analysis.main_results: Overall seroreactivity rates were 1.2% for HBsAg, 0.6% for anti-HCV, and 0.2% for anti-HIV; HBV seroreactivity declined significantly from 1.5% in 2020 to 1.0% in 2023-2024 (p=0.001), while HCV prevalence increased non-significantly from 0.5% to 0.7% (p=0.192) and HIV prevalence remained stable at 0.2% (p=0.043).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as indicating that Northern Cyprus remains a low-endemic region, noting a declining trend in HBV seroreactivity, a rising trend in HCV levels, and stable low levels of HIV.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings highlight the importance of sustained surveillance and prevention efforts for these blood-borne infections in the post-COVID-19 era.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The authors stated that results need to be interpreted cautiously as they may not entirely indicate the levels of infection, and the evidence is assessed as moderate due to the retrospective design and reliance on serological data from a single center.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估北塞浦路斯 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV)、丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV) 和人类免疫缺陷病毒 (HIV) 的五年血清反应趋势,重点关注 2019 年冠状病毒病 (COVID-19) 和大流行后时期。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项回顾性横断面研究评估了 2020 年至 2024 年间北塞浦路斯一家三级医院的 278,016 份血清学检测结果。
elements_zh.methods: 乙型肝炎表面抗原 (HBsAg)、抗 HCV 和抗 HIV 检测是在 ARCHITECT Plus ci4100 系统上使用酶联免疫吸附测定技术进行的,计算并比较了不同年份和性别组的年度血清反应性率。
elements_zh.main_results: HBsAg 的总体血清反应率为 1.2%,抗 HCV 的总体血清反应率为 0.6%,抗 HIV 的总体血清反应率为 0.2%;HBV 血清反应性从 2020 年的 1.5% 显着下降至 2023-2024 年的 1.0% (p=0.001),而 HCV 患病率 无显着增加,从 0.5% 增至 0.7% (p=0.192),HIV 患病率 保持稳定在 0.2% (p=0.043)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为表明北塞浦路斯仍然是一个低流行地区,并指出乙型肝炎病毒血清反应性呈下降趋势,丙型肝炎病毒水平呈上升趋势,并且艾滋病毒水平稳定在低水平。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了在后 COVID-19 时代持续 监测 和预防这些血源性感染的努力的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 作者表示,需要谨慎解释结果,因为它们可能无法完全表明感染水平,并且由于回顾性设计和对单个中心血清学数据的依赖,证据被评估为中等。

papers.title: Supramolecular Self-Assembly of Lycorine with Glycyrrhizic Acid into a Nanodrug for Safe and Sustained Anti-HBV Therapy
papers.abstract: Achieving a functional cure for chronic hepatitis B remains a major challenge, as conventional therapies struggle to eliminate the hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) and subsequently restore adaptive antiviral immunity. Lycorine (LY), a compound with broad-spectrum antiviral activity, has shown particular promise inhibiting HBsAg secretion. However, its clinical application is severely limited by significant cytotoxicity, the induction of apoptosis, a short half-life, and adverse in vivo effects. analysis.summary_en: This study addresses the challenge of achieving a functional cure for chronic hepatitis B by developing a self-assembled nanomedicine (LGN) using lycorine and glycyrrhizic acid. LGN overcomes the limitations of lycorine, such as cytotoxicity and short half-life, by enabling sustained release and reducing systemic toxicity. The nanomedicine effectively suppresses HBsAg secretion with a higher selectivity index than lycorine alone and inhibits multiple stages of the HBV life cycle, including DNA replication and viral protein expression. Transcriptomic analysis reveals LGN disrupts critical HBV lifecycle stages through a host-dependent mechanism. This approach highlights the potential of natural products and self-assembly technology for safer and more effective HBV therapy.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 为 慢性乙型肝炎 实现 功能性治愈 仍然是一个重大挑战,因为传统疗法难以消除乙型肝炎表面抗原 (HBsAg) 并随后恢复适应性 抗病毒药物 免疫力。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究通过将石蒜碱与甘草酸共组装,设计了一种自组装纳米药物(LGN),以克服石蒜碱的局限性,增强其抗乙肝病毒的治疗潜力。
elements_zh.methods: 该策略涉及将石蒜碱与甘草酸共同组装,以创建一种纳米药物,可保护石蒜碱免于过早降解,使其能够在结肠中持续释放,并减弱全身毒性。
elements_zh.main_results: LGN 有效抑制 HBsAg 分泌 (IC 50 = 2.15 ± 0.09 μM),选择性指数 (SI > 93) 比单独使用石蒜碱 (SI = 39.26) 高两倍以上,同时抑制 HBV DNA 复制、pgRNA 转录以及病毒蛋白 HBc 和 HBx 的表达。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,LGN 诱导了一种独特的 宿主 转录程序,该程序破坏了 HBV 生命周期的多个关键阶段,包括病毒进入、共价闭合环状 DNA 维持、基因转录和免疫逃避,代表了一种与核苷(酸)类似物不同的多靶点、宿主 依赖机制。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为利用石蒜碱等天然产物进行 抗病毒药物 治疗提供了宝贵的见解,并强调了自组装技术在改善 HBV 治疗 药物安全性和药代动力学特征方面的潜力。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究证明了在 HDI 模型中针对 HBV 的治疗潜力和明显的安全性,但证据强度中等,因为它基于仅摘要的报告,没有详细的方法或长期临床数据。

papers.title: Willingness to accept the HBV vaccine and related factors: Administering the vaccination attitudes examination scale to Urban Vietnamese adults
papers.abstract: Vietnam has low hepatitis B vaccination coverage among adults, posing a threat to the healthcare system. To mitigate negative impacts, it is essential to identify vaccine hesitancy and refusal levels and their sociodemographic correlates. We conducted a cross-sectional survey of 926 adults in Ho Chi Minh City (January–March 2025) using a self-administered questionnaire and the Vaccination Attitudes Examination (VAX) scale. Descriptive analysis was performed, and associations between variables were explored using a chi-square test. Multinomial logistic regression identified correlates of vaccine hesitancy and refusal, statistical significance was set at p < 0.05. When analyzing general vaccine intentions regardless of vaccination status, 65.6% of participants indicated acceptance, 19.3% hesitancy, and 15.1% refusal. The overall Cronbach’s alpha was 0.833 (range = 0.812–0.919), and the McDonald’s omega coefficients ranged from 0.820 to 0.920. The uniqueness values (0.115–0.422) indicated that substantial variances were explained by latent factors, with significant unstandardized loadings of 0.94 to 1.31 ( p < 0.001). A unique “knowledge paradox” was identified: poor knowledge about the HBV vaccine predicted outright refusal (AOR = 2.42), whereas higher factual knowledge was positively correlated with mistrust of vaccine benefits (r = 0.23, p < 0.01), worries about future effects (r = 0.19, p < 0.01), and total VAX scores (r = 0.19, p < 0.01). This suggests that limited knowledge contribute to refusal, while greater factual knowledge coexisting with “informed skepticism” or cautious hesitancy. Vaccine refusal was primarily associated with a preference for natural immunity, while mistrust of vaccine benefits and commercial concerns were specifically linked to increased hesitancy. The VAX scale serves as a reliable instrument for assessing vaccine attitudes among urban Vietnamese adults. It helps identify key vaccine-related concerns and supports continuous monitoring of public attitudes, which is essential for designing effective vaccination programs and enhancing public trust in vaccines.

papers.title_zh: 接受 HBV 疫苗 的意愿及相关因素:对城市越南成年人实施 疫苗接种 态度检查量表
papers.source_body_en: Vietnam has low hepatitis B vaccination coverage among adults, posing a threat to the healthcare system. To mitigate negative impacts, it is essential to identify vaccine hesitancy and refusal levels and their sociodemographic correlates. We conducted a cross-sectional survey of 926 adults in Ho Chi Minh City (January–March 2025) using a self-administered questionnaire and the Vaccination Attitudes Examination (VAX) scale. Descriptive analysis was performed, and associations between variables were explored using a chi-square test. Multinomial logistic regression identified correlates of vaccine hesitancy and refusal, statistical significance was set at p < 0.05. When analyzing general vaccine intentions regardless of vaccination status, 65.6% of participants indicated acceptance, 19.3% hesitancy, and 15.1% refusal. The overall Cronbach’s alpha was 0.833 (range = 0.812–0.919), and the McDonald’s omega coefficients ranged from 0.820 to 0.920. The uniqueness values (0.115–0.422) indicated that substantial variances were explained by latent factors, with significant unstandardized loadings of 0.94 to 1.31 ( p < 0.001). A unique “knowledge paradox” was identified: poor knowledge about the HBV vaccine predicted outright refusal (AOR = 2.42), whereas higher factual knowledge was positively correlated with mistrust of vaccine benefits (r = 0.23, p < 0.01), worries about future effects (r = 0.19, p < 0.01), and total VAX scores (r = 0.19, p < 0.01). This suggests that limited knowledge contribute to refusal, while greater factual knowledge coexisting with “informed skepticism” or cautious hesitancy. Vaccine refusal was primarily associated with a preference for natural immunity, while mistrust of vaccine benefits and commercial concerns were specifically linked to increased hesitancy. The VAX scale serves as a reliable instrument for assessing vaccine attitudes among urban Vietnamese adults. It helps identify key vaccine-related concerns and supports continuous monitoring of public attitudes, which is essential for designing effective vaccination programs and enhancing public trust in vaccines.

papers.title: Polygenic risk score and risk of drug-induced liver injury after initiating antiretroviral therapy in people living with HIV.
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Drug-induced liver injury affects some people living with HIV (PWH) during antiretroviral therapy (ART). We examined associations of polygenic risk scores (PRS) with liver injury during ART. METHODS: We derived PRS using summary statistics from the Veterans Affairs Million Veteran Program (MVP) and the Penn Medicine BioBank (PMBB). We constructed PRS for individuals of African (AFR) and European (EUR) ancestry in 3,619 treatment-naïve participants from ART-naive studies of the Advancing Clinical Therapeutics Globally (ACTG) network. Liver injury was defined as incident grade 3 or greater alanine aminotransferase (ALT) within 48 weeks. Associations were evaluated by multivariable regression models. RESULTS: Clinical variables associated with higher baseline ALT values included hepatitis B or C virus infection, increasing BMI and age, and male sex. In analyses of liver injury among 1,897 EUR participants (28 cases, 1869 controls) and 1722 AFR participants (21 cases, 1701 controls), HBV was associated with liver injury in both EUR and AFR participants, and HCV in EUR participants (p < 0.001 for each). PRSALT was not independently associated with incident liver injury in either EUR or AFR participants. CONCLUSION: No association was observed between baseline PRSALT and subsequent liver injury following initiation of ART.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated whether polygenic risk scores (PRS) for alanine aminotransferase (ALT) could predict drug-induced liver injury in people living with HIV (PWH) initiating antiretroviral therapy (ART). Using data from 3,619 treatment-naïve participants of African and European ancestry, the researchers derived PRS and defined liver injury as grade 3 or greater ALT within 48 weeks. Clinical variables associated with higher baseline ALT included hepatitis B or C virus infection, increasing BMI and age, and male sex. While HBV was associated with liver injury in both ancestry groups and HCV in European participants, PRSALT was not independently associated with liver injury. The findings suggest that genetic risk for ALT may not predict liver injury in PWH starting ART, emphasizing the role of clinical factors like HBV and HCV in monitoring liver health.

papers.title_zh: HIV感染者开始抗逆转录病毒治疗后的多基因风险评分和药物性肝损伤的风险。
papers.source_body_en: INTRODUCTION: Drug-induced liver injury affects some people living with HIV (PWH) during antiretroviral therapy (ART). We examined associations of polygenic risk scores (PRS) with liver injury during ART. METHODS: We derived PRS using summary statistics from the Veterans Affairs Million Veteran Program (MVP) and the Penn Medicine BioBank (PMBB). We constructed PRS for individuals of African (AFR) and European (EUR) ancestry in 3,619 treatment-naïve participants from ART-naive studies of the Advancing Clinical Therapeutics Globally (ACTG) network. Liver injury was defined as incident grade 3 or greater alanine aminotransferase (ALT) within 48 weeks. Associations were evaluated by multivariable regression models. RESULTS: Clinical variables associated with higher baseline ALT values included hepatitis B or C virus infection, increasing BMI and age, and male sex. In analyses of liver injury among 1,897 EUR participants (28 cases, 1869 controls) and 1722 AFR participants (21 cases, 1701 controls), HBV was associated with liver injury in both EUR and AFR participants, and HCV in EUR participants (p < 0.001 for each). PRSALT was not independently associated with incident liver injury in either EUR or AFR participants. CONCLUSION: No association was observed between baseline PRSALT and subsequent liver injury following initiation of ART.

papers.title: Spatial Total RNA Sequencing of Formalin-Fixed Paraffin-Embedded Tissue by spRandom-seq.
papers.abstract: The molecular pathogenesis of infectious diseases and cancer is orchestrated by nanoscale of host and microbial RNA transcripts within the tissue microenvironment. Nevertheless, spatially resolving the comprehensive transcriptional landscape within complex clinical tissues, like formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) specimens, still poses a formidable challenge. Here, we present spRandom-seq, a random primer-based spatial total RNA sequencing technology designed to spatially resolve complete transcriptomes from host, bacteria, and even nanoscale viruses in FFPE tissues. Capitalizing on the random primer design, our technology not only facilitated the discovery of specific lncRNAs and alternative splicing events in mouse brain and olfactory bulb, but also delineated pronounced spatial heterogeneity in clinical FFPE sections-across distinct tumor regions in breast cancer and microbial infection sites in Klebsiella pneumoniae-infected tissues. Importantly, integrated analysis of host and viral RNAs in FFPE samples from hepatitis B virus (HBV)‐positive hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) demonstrated that complement and coagulation pathways were specifically activated across expansive HBV‐infected tumor areas, which also exhibited an increased burden of copy number variations (CNVs). Owing to its compatibility with existing spatial transcriptomics platforms and minimal operational complexity, spRandom-seq represents a practical and scalable approach for clinical pathology applications and infection diagnostics.

analysis.methods: spRandom-seq uses a random primer-based design to spatially resolve complete transcriptomes from host, bacteria, and nanoscale viruses in FFPE tissues, enabling discovery of lncRNAs, alternative splicing events, and spatial heterogeneity analysis.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces spRandom-seq, a spatial total RNA sequencing technology designed to resolve comprehensive transcriptomes from host, microbial, and viral RNAs in FFPE tissues. papers.title_zh: 通过 spRandom-seq 对福尔马林固定石蜡包埋组织进行空间总 RNA 测序。
papers.source_body_en: The molecular pathogenesis of infectious diseases and cancer is orchestrated by nanoscale of host and microbial RNA transcripts within the tissue microenvironment. Nevertheless, spatially resolving the comprehensive transcriptional landscape within complex clinical tissues, like formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) specimens, still poses a formidable challenge. Here, we present spRandom-seq, a random primer-based spatial total RNA sequencing technology designed to spatially resolve complete transcriptomes from host, bacteria, and even nanoscale viruses in FFPE tissues. Capitalizing on the random primer design, our technology not only facilitated the discovery of specific lncRNAs and alternative splicing events in mouse brain and olfactory bulb, but also delineated pronounced spatial heterogeneity in clinical FFPE sections-across distinct tumor regions in breast cancer and microbial infection sites in Klebsiella pneumoniae-infected tissues. Importantly, integrated analysis of host and viral RNAs in FFPE samples from hepatitis B virus (HBV)‐positive hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) demonstrated that complement and coagulation pathways were specifically activated across expansive HBV‐infected tumor areas, which also exhibited an increased burden of copy number variations (CNVs). Owing to its compatibility with existing spatial transcriptomics platforms and minimal operational complexity, spRandom-seq represents a practical and scalable approach for clinical pathology applications and infection diagnostics.
papers.abstract_zh: 传染病和癌症的分子 发病机制 是由纳米级的 宿主 和组织微环境中的微生物 RNA 转录本精心策划的。然而,在空间上解析复杂临床组织(如福尔马林固定石蜡包埋(FFPE)标本)内的全面转录景观仍然面临着巨大的挑战。在这里,我们提出了 spRandom-seq,一种基于随机引物的空间总 RNA 测序技术,旨在空间解析来自 宿主、细菌甚至 FFPE 组织中纳米级病毒的完整转录组。利用随机引物设计,我们的技术不仅促进了小鼠大脑和嗅球中特定 lncRNA 和选择性剪接事件的发现,而且还描​​绘了临床 FFPE 切片中明显的空间异质性 - 跨越乳腺癌的不同肿瘤区域和肺炎克雷伯菌感染组织的微生物感染部位。重要的是,对 宿主 和 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 阳性肝细胞癌 (HCC) 的 FFPE 样本中的病毒 RNA 进行综合分析表明,补体和凝血途径在广泛的 HBV 感染肿瘤区域中被特异性激活,这也表现出拷贝数变异 (CNV) 负担增加。由于其与现有空间转录组学平台的兼容性和最小的操作复杂性,spRandom-seq 代表了临床病理学应用和感染诊断的实用且可扩展的方法。

papers.title: Tumorigenesis of Hepatocellular Carcinoma Related to Metabolic Disorders With a Focus on the Hippo Pathway.
papers.abstract: The Hippo pathway has been implicated in the tumorigenesis of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). We aimed to determine the expression of Hippo pathway-related proteins in HCC using immunohistochemical staining and compare the data among patients with different underlying clinical background diseases. We collected 40 resected HCC formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded samples and categorized them into 4 groups according to pre-existing conditions [17 samples of alcohol consumption (HCC-A) and 6, 8, and 9 samples with hepatitis B virus infection (HCC-B), hepatitis C virus infection (HCC-C), and metabolic diseases (HCC-M), respectively]. Using immunohistochemistry, we investigated the Hippo pathway-related proteins YAP1, CADM1, and SOX9. Hypertension was the most common disease (72.5%) among patients with HCC, followed by diabetes mellitus (47.5%). Regarding the background liver disease, significant findings of steatohepatitis (SH) were observed in the HCC-A (35.3%) and HCC-M (88.9%) groups compared with those in the HCC-B (16.7%) and HCC-C (0%) groups. A significant finding of metabolic dysfunction-associated SH (MASH) was also observed in the HCC-M group (88.9%), and liver cirrhosis was predominantly observed in the HCC-C group (100%). Twenty-seven patients had Hippo-inactive status, and 13 patients had active status. SH was more predominant in the HCC-M group with Hippo inactivity (100%) than in the HCC-A group (50.0%). The average tumor size was significantly larger in the Hippo-inactive group than in the Hippo-active group. Hippo pathway-associated proteins could serve as potential therapeutic targets for MASH and MASH-related HCC if the Hippo pathway is inactivated.

papers.title_zh: 与代谢紊乱相关的肝细胞癌的肿瘤发生,重点关注 Hippo 通路。
papers.source_body_en: The Hippo pathway has been implicated in the tumorigenesis of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). We aimed to determine the expression of Hippo pathway-related proteins in HCC using immunohistochemical staining and compare the data among patients with different underlying clinical background diseases. We collected 40 resected HCC formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded samples and categorized them into 4 groups according to pre-existing conditions [17 samples of alcohol consumption (HCC-A) and 6, 8, and 9 samples with hepatitis B virus infection (HCC-B), hepatitis C virus infection (HCC-C), and metabolic diseases (HCC-M), respectively]. Using immunohistochemistry, we investigated the Hippo pathway-related proteins YAP1, CADM1, and SOX9. Hypertension was the most common disease (72.5%) among patients with HCC, followed by diabetes mellitus (47.5%). Regarding the background liver disease, significant findings of steatohepatitis (SH) were observed in the HCC-A (35.3%) and HCC-M (88.9%) groups compared with those in the HCC-B (16.7%) and HCC-C (0%) groups. A significant finding of metabolic dysfunction-associated SH (MASH) was also observed in the HCC-M group (88.9%), and liver cirrhosis was predominantly observed in the HCC-C group (100%). Twenty-seven patients had Hippo-inactive status, and 13 patients had active status. SH was more predominant in the HCC-M group with Hippo inactivity (100%) than in the HCC-A group (50.0%). The average tumor size was significantly larger in the Hippo-inactive group than in the Hippo-active group. Hippo pathway-associated proteins could serve as potential therapeutic targets for MASH and MASH-related HCC if the Hippo pathway is inactivated.

papers.title: Incidence, risk factors and tumor spectrum of second primary cancers after gastric cancer: a multicenter cohort study with long-term follow-up.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: The development of second primary cancers (SPCs) has become an important late effect in gastric cancer (GC) survivors, yet its incidence, risk factors, and clinical implications remain poorly defined. This study aimed to evaluate the long-term risk of SPCs, identify clinical factors associated with SPC occurrence, and describe detection patterns and stage distribution of SPCs during long-term follow-up. METHODS: Patients with GC who underwent curative-intent radical gastrectomy between 2007 and 2021 were identified from the Multidisciplinary Alliance of Gastric Integrative Studies (MAGIS) cohort. Clinical factors associated with SPC occurrence were selected using LASSO-penalized Cox regression, and exploratory risk-based stratification was performed. Stage distribution was descriptively compared between SPCs detected during asymptomatic surveillance and those diagnosed after symptom onset. RESULTS: Among 11,027 GC survivors (8,519 men and 2,508 women), 241 (2.19%) developed SPCs during a follow-up of up to 16 years. The cumulative incidence of SPCs was 1.25% (95% CI, 1.03%-1.46%) at 5 years, 2.97% (95% CI, 2.55%-3.39%) at 10 years, and 4.15% (95% CI, 3.40%-4.91%) at 15 years after gastrectomy. The most frequent SPCs were lung (23.2%), colorectal (21.6%), and esophageal (12.9%) cancers, showing marked sex-specific differences: lung cancer predominated in males, whereas cervical cancer was most common in females. Factors associated with SPC occurrence included older age at time of gastrectomy (HR 1.04, 95% CI 1.02-1.05; p < 0.001), chronic HBV/HCV infection (HR 2.15, 95% CI 1.29-3.58; p = 0.003), family history of cancer (HR 1.57, 95% CI 1.16-2.12; p = 0.003), and elevated preoperative systemic inflammation (Log-SIRI; HR 1.86, 95% CI 1.31-2.65; p < 0.001). The derived model stratified patients into low-, intermediate-, and high-risk groups with corresponding 10-year SPC risks of 2.07%, 3.61%, and 4.33%. SPCs detected during asymptomatic surveillance were more frequently diagnosed at stage I than those identified after symptom onset (47.4% vs 17.6%; p < 0.001). CONCLUSIONS: SPCs represent an important long-term health burden among GC survivors, with distinct sex-specific disease patterns. The exploratory risk-scoring model showed preliminary risk stratification, and SPCs detected during asymptomatic surveillance were more often diagnosed at an earlier stage. These findings support further evaluation of risk-adapted, organ- and sex-specific surveillance strategies in methodologically rigorous studies.

papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: The development of second primary cancers (SPCs) has become an important late effect in gastric cancer (GC) survivors, yet its incidence, risk factors, and clinical implications remain poorly defined. METHODS: Patients with GC who underwent curative-intent radical gastrectomy between 2007 and 2021 were identified from the Multidisciplinary Alliance of Gastric Integrative Studies (MAGIS) cohort. Clinical factors associated with SPC occurrence were selected using LASSO-penalized Cox regression, and exploratory risk-based stratification was performed. Stage distribution was descriptively compared between SPCs detected during asymptomatic surveillance and those diagnosed after symptom onset. RESULTS: Among 11,027 GC survivors (8,519 men and 2,508 women), 241 (2.19%) developed SPCs during a follow-up of up to 16 years. The cumulative incidence of SPCs was 1.25% (95% CI, 1.03%-1.46%) at 5 years, 2.97% (95% CI, 2.55%-3.39%) at 10 years, and 4.15% (95% CI, 3.40%-4.91%) at 15 years after gastrectomy. The most frequent SPCs were lung (23.2%), colorectal (21.6%), and esophageal (12.9%) cancers, showing marked sex-specific differences: lung cancer predominated in males, whereas cervical cancer was most common in females. Factors associated with SPC occurrence included older age at time of gastrectomy (HR 1.04, 95% CI 1.02-1.05; p < 0.001), chronic HBV/HCV infection (HR 2.15, 95% CI 1.29-3.58; p = 0.003), family history of cancer (HR 1.57, 95% CI 1.16-2.12; p = 0.003), and elevated preoperative systemic inflammation (Log-SIRI; HR 1.86, 95% CI 1.31-2.65; p < 0.001). The derived model stratified patients into low-, intermediate-, and high-risk groups with corresponding 10-year SPC risks of 2.07%, 3.61%, and 4.33%. SPCs detected during asymptomatic surveillance were more frequently diagnosed at stage I than those identified after symptom onset (47.4% vs 17.6%; p < 0.001). CONCLUSIONS: SPCs represent an important long-term health burden among GC survivors, with distinct sex-specific disease patterns. The exploratory risk-scoring model showed preliminary risk stratification, and SPCs detected during asymptomatic surveillance were more often diagnosed at an earlier stage. These findings support further evaluation of risk-adapted, organ- and sex-specific surveillance strategies in methodologically rigorous studies.

papers.title: Droplet Digital PCR Measurement of HBV DNA in On-Treatment Chronic HBV Patients: Association With HCC Development and Outcomes.
papers.abstract: Low-level residual viremia can be present in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients on nucleos(t)ide analogues (NUCs). Due to the detection limits of current HBV DNA assays, the association between residual viremia and HBV-related HCC has not been well studied. This study included NUC-treated HBV-related HCC patients with unquantifiable serum HBV DNA by the conventional Cobas-Taqman assay (< 20 IU/mL) at HCC diagnosis. The HCC patients were matched in a 1:1 ratio with NUC-treated non-HCC controls. Serum samples at the time of HCC diagnosis, 1 year before, and 2 years before diagnosis were retrospectively retrieved and tested for residual viremia by a validated high-sensitivity droplet digital polymerase chain reaction assay (lower limit of detection 1.6 IU/mL). Among 208 patients (104 HCC vs. 104 controls; mean age 63.1, 80.8% male, 54.3% cirrhosis), residual viremia within 2 years was observed in 82.7% of HCC patients and 49.0% of controls (p < 0.001), and was independently associated with HCC occurrence (OR 7.243, 95% CI 1.862-28.170, p = 0.004). In HCC patients, residual viremia was associated with histological microvascular invasion (44.4% vs. 9.1% in patients without residual viremia, p = 0.033) and lower probability of presenting with Barcelona Clinic Liver Cancer stage 0 HCC (OR 0.281, 95% CI 0.094-0.838, p = 0.023). After median follow-up for 7.2 years, residual viremia within 2 years before HCC diagnosis was independently associated with liver-related mortality (HR 4.472, 95% CI 1.212-16.504, p = 0.025). Residual viremia in NUC-treated CHB patients is associated with a higher risk of HCC development, more advanced tumour staging and poorer outcomes. High-sensitivity HBV DNA assays may be utilized for monitoring in NUC treatment.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate the association between low-level residual viremia in chronic hepatitis B patients on nucleos(t)ide analogues and the development of HBV-related hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC).
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was a retrospective case-control analysis comparing 104 HCC patients with 104 non-HCC controls who were both on nucleos(t)ide analogues (NUCs) and had unquantifiable serum HBV DNA by the conventional Cobas-Taqman assay at HCC diagnosis.
analysis.methods: Residual viremia was measured using a validated high-sensitivity droplet digital polymerase chain reaction assay, which had a lower limit of detection of 1.6 IU/mL. Serum samples were collected at the time of HCC diagnosis, 1 year before, and 2 years before diagnosis.
analysis.main_results: Residual viremia within 2 years before HCC diagnosis was observed in 82.7% of HCC patients and 49.0% of controls (p < 0.001). It was independently associated with HCC occurrence (OR 7.243, 95% CI 1.862-28.170, p = 0.004).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that residual viremia is a significant factor in the development of HCC and its progression, highlighting the need for more sensitive monitoring methods.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings suggest that high-sensitivity HBV DNA assays could improve the monitoring of patients on NUCs, potentially leading to better management of HBV-related HCC risk.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective design and potential for confounding factors, but the evidence is strong due to the use of a validated high-sensitivity assay and clear statistical associations.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the association between residual viremia in chronic hepatitis B patients on nucleos(t)ide analogues (NUCs) and the development of HBV-related hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). It found that residual viremia within 2 years before HCC diagnosis was significantly more common in HCC patients compared to non-HCC controls, with an independent association with HCC occurrence. The study used a high-sensitivity droplet digital PCR assay to detect HBV DNA, revealing that residual viremia was also linked to more advanced tumor staging and poorer outcomes. These results suggest that improved monitoring with sensitive assays may be crucial for managing HCC risk in NUC-treated patients. However, the study's retrospective design and potential confounding factors limit the strength of the conclusions, though the evidence remains robust due to the clear statistical associations observed.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨使用核苷(酸)类似物的 慢性乙型肝炎 患者的低水平残留病毒血症与 HBV 相关肝细胞癌(HCC)发展之间的关系。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是一项回顾性病例对照分析,对 104 名 HCC 患者与 104 名非 HCC 对照进行了比较,这些患者均服用核苷(酸)类似物 (NUC),并且在 HCC 诊断 中通过传统 Cobas-Taqman 检测无法定量血清 HBV DNA。
elements_zh.methods: 使用经过验证的高灵敏度液滴数字聚合酶链反应测定法测量残留病毒血症,该测定法的检测下限为 1.6 IU/mL。血清样本采集于 HCC 诊断 发生时、诊断 发生前 1 年和 诊断 发生前 2 年。
elements_zh.main_results: Residual viremia within 2 years before HCC diagnosis was observed in 82.7% of HCC patients and 49.0% of controls (p < 0.001). It was independently associated with HCC occurrence (OR 7.243, 95% CI 1.862-28.170, p = 0.004).
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,残留病毒血症是 HCC 发生及其进展的一个重要因素,强调需要更灵敏的监测方法。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,高灵敏度 HBV DNA 检测可以改善对 NUC 患者的监测,从而有可能更好地管理 HBV 相关的 HCC 风险。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其回顾性设计和潜在的混杂因素而受到限制,但由于使用了经过验证的高灵敏度测定和明确的统计关联,因此证据充足。

papers.title_zh: On-治疗 慢性 HBV 患者中 HBV DNA 的微滴数字 PCR 测量:与 HCC 发展和结果的关联。
papers.source_body_en: Low-level residual viremia can be present in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients on nucleos(t)ide analogues (NUCs). Due to the detection limits of current HBV DNA assays, the association between residual viremia and HBV-related HCC has not been well studied. This study included NUC-treated HBV-related HCC patients with unquantifiable serum HBV DNA by the conventional Cobas-Taqman assay (< 20 IU/mL) at HCC diagnosis. The HCC patients were matched in a 1:1 ratio with NUC-treated non-HCC controls. Serum samples at the time of HCC diagnosis, 1 year before, and 2 years before diagnosis were retrospectively retrieved and tested for residual viremia by a validated high-sensitivity droplet digital polymerase chain reaction assay (lower limit of detection 1.6 IU/mL). Among 208 patients (104 HCC vs. 104 controls; mean age 63.1, 80.8% male, 54.3% cirrhosis), residual viremia within 2 years was observed in 82.7% of HCC patients and 49.0% of controls (p < 0.001), and was independently associated with HCC occurrence (OR 7.243, 95% CI 1.862-28.170, p = 0.004). In HCC patients, residual viremia was associated with histological microvascular invasion (44.4% vs. 9.1% in patients without residual viremia, p = 0.033) and lower probability of presenting with Barcelona Clinic Liver Cancer stage 0 HCC (OR 0.281, 95% CI 0.094-0.838, p = 0.023). After median follow-up for 7.2 years, residual viremia within 2 years before HCC diagnosis was independently associated with liver-related mortality (HR 4.472, 95% CI 1.212-16.504, p = 0.025). Residual viremia in NUC-treated CHB patients is associated with a higher risk of HCC development, more advanced tumour staging and poorer outcomes. High-sensitivity HBV DNA assays may be utilized for monitoring in NUC treatment.

papers.title: Monitoring of the Cascade of Care in Patients With Chronic HBV in Primary Care Clinics in Australia.
papers.abstract: To achieve hepatitis B virus (HBV) elimination in Australia, a shift from hospital to community-based care is needed. This study aimed to describe the prevalence of chronic HBV and uptake of the cascade of care in primary care patients. This prospective cohort study was conducted in 76 urban and regional primary care clinics across Victoria, Australia between 1/7/2020 and 30/6/2023. Anonymised socio-demographic, clinical and laboratory data from general practice (GP) clinics' electronic medical records (EMR) were extracted. Descriptive analysis of the cohort of clinic clients with HBV was performed. A total of 346,927 individuals attended appointments across the study period. Of these, 25,212 had records indicating HBV-related testing. 491 (0.14%) individuals had evidence of current HBV infection defined as HBV surface antigen (HBsAg) positive and/or HBV DNA positive. 469 attended the clinics during the study period, among whom 239 (51%) were female. In the GP EMR, only 59 (13%) had evidence of at least one HBV DNA test and at least one ALT test ordered. Fourteen patients (3%) had record of being reviewed for HBV management by the clinic nurse or GP and 78 (17%) reviewed by a viral hepatitis specialist. Ninety-two (20%) were on treatment for HBV. Of people receiving treatment, 23 (25%) had a record of linkage to specialist care. Our data show that significant gaps in the cascade of care remain for people with chronic HBV in primary care settings, with a low proportion of patients having evidence of participating in all stages of the HBV cascade of care.

The results highlight the need for improved primary care management to achieve HBV elimination goals.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本研究重点关注澳大利亚初级保健诊所的 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染,旨在描述慢性 HBV 的 患病率 以及患者对级联护理的接受情况。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 这项前瞻性 队列研究 研究于 2020 年 1 月 7 日至 2023 年 6 月 30 日在澳大利亚维多利亚州 76 个城市和地区初级保健诊所进行,使用来自全科电子病历的匿名社会人口统计、临床和实验室数据。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 研究发现,只有 13% 的 HBV 患者有至少一项 HBV DNA 检测和一项 ALT 检测的证据,其中 3% 由临床工作人员进行审查,17% 由病毒性肝炎专家进行审查,20% 接受 治疗,级联护理存在显着差距。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该研究强调了初级保健机构对慢性乙型肝炎患者的级联护理存在显着差距,参与所有阶段护理的患者比例较低,但没有详细说明具体的争议或未解决的机制。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究结果表明,需要改进初级保健机构中乙肝病毒的监测和管理,以弥补级联护理中的差距,并支持澳大利亚消除乙肝病毒的目标。

papers.abstract_zh: 为了在澳大利亚消除 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV),需要从医院护理转向社区护理。本研究旨在描述慢性乙型肝炎的 患病率 以及初级保健患者对级联护理的接受。这项前瞻性 队列研究 研究于 2020 年 1 月 7 日至 2023 年 6 月 30 日在澳大利亚维多利亚州 76 个城市和地区初级保健诊所进行。从全科医生 (GP) 诊所的电子病历 (EMR) 中提取匿名的社会人口统计、临床和实验室数据。对临床 HBV 患者的 队列研究 进行了描述性分析。在整个研究期间,共有 346,927 人参加了预约。其中,25,212 人有 HBV 相关检测记录。491 名 (0.14%) 个体有当前 HBV 感染的证据,定义为 HBV 表面抗原 (HBsAg) 阳性和/或 HBV DNA 阳性。研究期间有 469 人到诊所就诊,其中 239 人(51%)为女性。在 GP EMR 中,只有 59 名患者 (13%) 拥有至少一项 HBV DNA 检测和至少一项 ALT 检测的证据。14 名患者 (3%) 曾接受过诊所护士或全科医生的 HBV 管理检查记录,78 名患者 (17%) 接受过病毒性肝炎专家的检查记录。九十二 (20%) 因 HBV 而接受 治疗 治疗。在接受 治疗 的人中,23 人 (25%) 有与专科护理联系的记录。我们的数据显示,初级保健机构中慢性乙型肝炎患者的级联护理仍存在显着差距,有证据表明参与乙型肝炎级联护理所有阶段的患者比例很低。
papers.summary_zh: 为了在澳大利亚消除 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV),需要从医院护理转向社区护理。本研究旨在描述慢性乙型肝炎的 患病率 以及初级保健患者对级联护理的接受。这项前瞻性 队列研究 研究于 2020 年 1 月 7 日至 2023 年 6 月 30 日在澳大利亚维多利亚州 76 个城市和地区初级保健诊所进行。从全科医生 (GP) 诊所的电子病历 (EMR) 中提取匿名的社会人口统计、临床和实验室数据。对临床 HBV 患者的 队列研究 进行了描述性分析。在整个研究期间,共有 346,927 人参加了预约。其中,25,212 人有 HBV 相关检测记录。491 名 (0.14%) 个体有当前 HBV 感染的证据,定义为 HBV 表面抗原 (HBsAg) 阳性和/或 HBV DNA 阳性。研究期间有 469 人到诊所就诊,其中 239 人(51%)为女性。在 GP EMR 中,只有 59 名患者 (13%) 拥有至少一项 HBV DNA 检测和至少一项 ALT 检测的证据。14 名患者 (3%) 曾接受过诊所护士或全科医生的 HBV 管理检查记录,78 名患者 (17%) 接受过病毒性肝炎专家的检查记录。九十二 (20%) 因 HBV 而接受 治疗 治疗。在接受 治疗 的人中,23 人 (25%) 有与专科护理联系的记录。我们的数据显示,初级保健机构中慢性乙型肝炎患者的级联护理仍存在显着差距,有证据表明参与乙型肝炎级联护理所有阶段的患者比例很低。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 本研究重点关注澳大利亚初级保健诊所的 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染,旨在描述慢性 HBV 的 患病率 以及患者对级联护理的接受情况。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 这项前瞻性 队列研究 研究于 2020 年 1 月 7 日至 2023 年 6 月 30 日在澳大利亚维多利亚州 76 个城市和地区初级保健诊所进行,使用来自全科电子病历的匿名社会人口统计、临床和实验室数据。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 研究发现,只有 13% 的 HBV 患者有至少一项 HBV DNA 检测和一项 ALT 检测的证据,其中 3% 由临床工作人员进行审查,17% 由病毒性肝炎专家进行审查,20% 接受 治疗,级联护理存在显着差距。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该研究强调了初级保健机构对慢性乙型肝炎患者的级联护理存在显着差距,参与所有阶段护理的患者比例较低,但没有详细说明具体的争议或未解决的机制。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究结果表明,需要改进初级保健机构中乙肝病毒的监测和管理,以弥补级联护理中的差距,并支持澳大利亚消除乙肝病毒的目标。

news.content: Skip to main content Help Log in ReliefWeb Search Content Search What are you looking for? Search|t Updates Countries Disasters Organizations Topics Jobs Training Informing humanitarians worldwide 24/7 — a service provided by UN OCHA World Prevention, Diagnosis and Management of Hepatitis B: Operational Toolkit for Healthcare Workers Across All Levels of Care Format Manual and Guideline Source Africa CDC Posted 23 Jul 2026 Originally published 23 Jul 2026 Origin View original Attachments Download Report (PDF | 1.11 MB | Operational guide) Download Report (PDF | 415.62 KB | Reference guide) EXECUTIVE SUMMARY Globally, an estimated 240 million people are living with chronic hepatitis B (PLWHB). The WHO Africa region is disproportionately affected, accounting for 68% of new hepatitis B virus (HBV) infections but having the lowest coverage of timely hepatitis B birth-dose (HepB-BD) vaccination (17%). Of the 64 million PLWHB in Africa, only 6% (3.9 million) had been diagnosed, and just 1.6% (1 million) had received treatment by 2024, despite the availability of accurate WHO prequalified diagnostics and effective, low-cost antiviral therapy. Hepatitis B caused an estimated 308,000 deaths in Africa in 2024. We need to urgently scale up prevention, diagnosis and treatment to prevent new infections and liver-related deaths. In 2024, the WHO African region recorded 612 000 new HBV infections and together with the Western Pacific region accounted for three quarters of the global 1.1 million HBV related deaths. Chronic hepatitis B is a silent disease and is typically asymptomatic until complications such as cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) develop. It is essential to improve diagnosis, linkage to care, treatment uptake and long term follow up for PLWHB. The operational toolkit should be used alongside the WHO 2024 Hepatitis B Guidelines, the WHO HBV Policy Brief, and the WHO Consolidated Guidance on Hepatitis B and C prevention, testing, treatment, service delivery and monitoring: an implementation handbook for a public health approach. This Africa CDC HBV operational toolkit is based on the WHO 2024 Hepatitis B Guidelines.[2] The toolkit provides practical, easy-to-use management algorithms for healthcare workers across all levels of the health system in Africa, including for those practicing at community, primary care and rural settings. Companion Mobile App This toolkit is accompanied by an App available on the App store for iOS (Apple devices) and the Google Play store for Android devices. The app provides all the materials included in this toolkit and has an interactive treatment advisor to help clinicians determine if treatment is recommended. It includes a calculator for the APRI score and creatinine clearance, and recommendations on doses for renal impairment. Search for “Africa CDC Hepatitis B toolkit” in the App Store or Google Play on your device to download it. In this toolkit, management and referral pathway algorithms are adapted to different levels of care, reflecting the available resources at each level and enabling HBV treatment and care at all levels. Healthcare systems in Africa are stratified into 5 levels based on the resources available for HBV prevention, diagnosis, treatment and monitoring. Each level offers progressively more advanced and comprehensive diagnostic and therapeutic capabilities. Levels of care: Level 0: Community and Outreach Focuses on awareness, basic screening, and referral. Often facilitated by community health workers and outreach programmes. Level 1: Primary Care Provides essential health services including initial screening, basic laboratory tests, and vaccination. Level 2: District Hospital Equipped for basic diagnostics, limited imaging, and some specialised services. Level 3: Regional Hospital Offers more advanced diagnostics and imaging, and specialist services. Level 4: Tertiary Level Hospital/Academic Centres Provides comprehensive diagnostics, advanced imaging, specialised care, research and training. Why it's important Viral hepatitis affects nearly 300 million people globally, with approximately 1.3 million deaths each year from hepatitis B and hepatitis C. Despite effective vaccines, evidence-based prevention strategies and medications, deaths from viral hepatitis are increasing globally. CDC and other organizations around the world recognize WHD by raising awareness about viral hepatitis, the burdens people with hepatitis face, ongoing work to combat viral hepatitis across the globe, and actions people can take to prevent future transmission. Goals CDC is working to eliminate viral hepatitis in the United States and around the world. CDC collaborates with international partners to help countries experiencing high rates of infection to prevent, control, and eliminate viral hepatitis as a global public health threat. Campaign origins WHD is recognized annually on July 28, the birthday of Dr. Baruch Blumberg, who discovered the hepatitis B virus in 1967. Two years later, he developed the first hepatitis B vaccine. Dr. Blumberg won the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine in 1976. What success looks like CDC provides scientific and public health leadership in the United States and to countries around the world in advancing efforts to eliminate viral hepatitis as a public health threat. CDC helps countries build capacity for viral hepatitis surveillance, testing, care, and treatment and assists with development and implementation of national control and elimination programs. CDC's global viral hepatitis work protects the United States. Persons who were not born in the United States account for 3 out of 4 people with hepatitis B virus infections. Simulation studies suggest that since 2000, progress in expanding global hepatitis B vaccination among all countries with people who immigrate to the United States could prevent almost 900,000 hepatitis B virus infections and over 67,000 hepatitis B-related deaths if global 2030 vaccination targets are achieved and sustained; this would save the United States $8.1 billion in estimated costs by 2070. CDC's support to other countries makes America stronger by fortifying international partnerships, advancing innovation, and using lessons from other countries to advance the elimination of hepatitis C in the United States. Notably, global work has provided examples of the usefulness for tests at point-of-care, such as a viral test for hepatitis C diagnosis that can be used to link people to care and curative treatment in real time. Evaluations of use of hepatitis C self-testing (i.e. for antibody to hepatitis C virus) has shown strong usability and acceptance in the country of Georgia providing lessons for potential use in other low- and middle-income countries to identify persons exposed to hepatitis C who do not typically access health care services. CDC has supported the first national viral hepatitis serosurveys to estimate the burden of hepatitis B, hepatitis C, and hepatitis D in Georgia, the Kyrgyz Republic, Uzbekistan, Malawi, and Botswana, providing data that guide the development of national strategic plans, identify strategic priorities needed to achieve elimination of viral hepatitis, and measure progress toward the elimination of hepatitis B and hepatitis C. To learn more about how CDC is working globally to eliminate global death and disease caused by viral hepatitis, see CDC Collaborates Worldwide to Eliminate Viral Hepatitis. CDC conducting a site visit to monitor implementation of newly developed guidelines to prevent and manage hepatitis B and hepatitis C in hemodialysis and hematology-oncology clinics in Uzbekistan. analysis.brief_en: World Hepatitis Day, observed annually on July 28, is a global awareness campaign led by the CDC and other organizations to combat viral hepatitis, which affects nearly 300 million people worldwide and causes approximately 1.3 million deaths each year. Despite available vaccines and treatments, hepatitis-related deaths are rising. The CDC collaborates internationally to eliminate hepatitis as a public health threat, supporting countries in building surveillance and treatment capacity. Achieving global vaccination targets could prevent nearly 900,000 hepatitis B infections and 67,000 deaths in the U.S. by 2070, saving $8.1 billion. The agency also promotes innovative testing strategies, such as point-of-care and self-testing, lessons from which are applied domestically to advance hepatitis C elimination.
